jobs.title: Professional Services Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Are you ready to shape the future of data? Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform.
jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the future of data?

Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform.

In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding. Manual data engineering can’t keep up. Maia fixes that by combining 15 years of data expertise with agentic AI to eliminate the manual work that slows data teams down. Organisations like Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack are already using it to deliver real business impact, faster.

We started in Manchester and now we’re global - with teams across the UK, US and India.

We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We’re here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we’re looking for people who want to be part of it.

About the role

The Professional Services Engineer is a customer-embedded services delivery professional responsible for the deployment, implementation, and optimization of Maia Foundation platform, driving adoption, solving complex technical challenges, and enablement of Maia agentic AI capabilities. The PSE leads the technical deployment and implementation of the Maia Foundation platform by architecting production-grade integrations and distributed data systems that transform legacy ETL workflows into modern, autonomous data pipelines.
This role is based in Sydney, Australia. While the position is remote, we're looking for someone located in-region to support our customers and build our presence as the region becomes an increasingly important growth market for Matillion.

What you will be doing

  • Own the deployment: Architect and implement production-grade integrations and distributed data systems for enterprise customers, using Python, SQL, and modern API development.
  • Modernise legacy data: Transform legacy ETL/ELT workflows into modern, autonomous data pipelines, working across cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP) and Kubernetes.
  • Build with AI, not just for it: Integrate AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and use AI code generation tools to accelerate delivery and enable Maia's agentic capabilities.
  • Deliver at pace: Take technical solutions from kickoff to production within an 8-12 week Accelerator window, owning outcomes even when the path isn't straightforward.
  • Move between altitudes: Alternate between deep technical problem-solving and strategic alignment conversations with customer executives.

What we are looking for

  • Demonstrable experience building production-grade software, with strong programming ability in Python, SQL, and API development or equivalent.
  • Data engineering background: Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT tools, gained as a Data Engineer, DBA, or similar.
  • Data architecture depth: Strong grasp of data architecture and data structures, with the ability to assess and redesign customer data environments as part of a migration.
  • Comfortable wearing multiple hats: Ready to flex across technical delivery, customer communication, and (initially, in newer markets like Sydney) commercial support until dedicated resources are in place.
  • Delivery under pressure: Track record of completing migration and deployment outcomes to a defined timeline, working directly with customer stakeholders.
At Matillion, we are committed to providing compensation in line with market standards based on the role, job family, job level and country. This role’s estimated annual salaried pay range for this position is $112,000 - $168,000. The final salary will be based on your relevant skills, experience, and qualifications demonstrated in the hiring process.

More about Matillion

We operate a flexible working culture that promotes work-life balance, with benefits including:

  • Company Equity
  • 30 days holiday + bank holidays
  • 5 days paid volunteering leave
  • Access to mental health support

Your Safety

Matillion recruiters will only contact you from @matillion.com email addresses. We occasionally work with trusted recruiting partners; they will always tell you they are working on our behalf. We will never ask for money, fees, or bank details at any point in the hiring process. If something feels off, trust that instinct. Don't click any links. Go straight to to verify open roles or reach us at .

Want to know more?

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential, not just experience. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.

Cannot find anything suitable role right now? We still want to hear from you. Drop us a line at .

Find out more about life on #TeamGreen here.

Matillion is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all of our team. Matillion prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. Matillion does not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: About Pendulum:Pendulum is on a mission to help people improve physical and mental health by creating a new category of products that target the microbiome.
jobs.description:
About Pendulum:

Pendulum is on a mission to help people improve physical and mental health by creating a new category of products that target the microbiome. We are researching, developing and commercializing a novel class of rationally-designed Live Synbiotics (probiotics + prebiotics) that have demonstrated utility in addressing conditions like metabolic syndrome, inflammation and neurodegeneration.

Pendulum has created a unique discovery platform that utilizes genome sequencing and advanced computational approaches to identify novel, proprietary bacterial strains that augment key functions within the gut microbiome relevant to the respective disease state.

We are a highly collaborative team of scientists, engineers, physicians, manufacturing professionals, and marketing specialists interested in improving human health by leveraging the latest research from diverse fields, such as microbiology, molecular biology, high-throughput genomics, distributed computing, pharmaceutical development and nutrition. We believe strongly in an individual’s transparency and strong communication to enable the most effective and efficient path to team success.

If you’re interested in building a new category of products that will help improve the lives of people globally and you love working in a fast-paced, cross-functional, collaborative, inspiring environment, please continue reading!

The Opportunity:
We are seeking a Revenue Operations Manager to drive the day-to-day operational engine of Pendulum's Revenue Operations team, ensuring every channel runs with precision and accountability as Pendulum scales. Reporting directly to the Sr. Director, Revenue Operations, this person will own the execution and operational infrastructure across Amazon, third-party marketplaces, retail, MAP compliance, and our growing HCP (Healthcare Practitioner) sales channel. You will drive cross-functional alignment, support building scalable processes, and ensure that each channel operates with precision and accountability as Pendulum scales. This is a high-ownership role for someone who is equally strategic and hands-on - comfortable designing systems and getting into the details to make them work.

What You'll Do

    Amazon & Marketplace Operations

  • Own day-to-day Amazon channel operations including catalog integrity, listing maintenance, content updates, and case management, ensuring a best-in-class brand presence on the platform.

  • Lead promotional planning and execution across Amazon and third-party marketplaces: manage deal submissions, coupon activations, Lightning Deal requests, and post-promotion reporting.

  • Monitor inventory health, partner with Supply Chain on demand planning inputs, and proactively flag stockout or overstock risks to leadership.

  • Drive the operational launch of new marketplace channels, building onboarding checklists, managing item setup, and configuring platform portals from initiation through go-live.

  • Own product listing quality across third-party marketplace platforms, ensuring content accuracy, pricing alignment, and brand consistency at scale.

  • Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities across listings and fulfillment workflows to drive channel efficiency.

    • MAP Compliance & Unauthorized Reseller Enforcement

  • Own MAP compliance and unauthorized reseller enforcement programs across all online channels, ensuring consistent price integrity and brand protection.

  • Manage Trackstreet and internal monitoring tools to proactively identify violations across platforms, maintain enforcement logs, and report on compliance trends.

  • Lead seller outreach and remediation efforts, coordinating directly with unauthorized sellers and escalating to legal or platform partners as needed.

  • Develop and maintain enforcement SOPs and escalation frameworks to ensure a consistent, scalable approach to MAP and reseller issues as Pendulum grows.

  • Partner with the Sr. Director, Revenue Operations and legal team on policy updates, platform enforcement actions, and strategic decisions related to brand protection.

    • Retail Operations & Partner Execution

  • Execute the full operational workflow for retail partner onboarding, including completing new item setup forms and managing retailer vendor portals.

  • Process and track purchase orders across retail accounts, ensuring accurate and timely fulfillment in alignment with retailer requirements.

  • Maintain up-to-date records across retailer portals, item catalogs, and compliance documentation for current and future retail partners.

  • Support cross-functional coordination between Sales, Operations, Marketing, and Supply Chain on retail execution needs and timelines, flagging issues to the Sr. Director, Revenue Operations as they arise.

  • Serve as a day-to-day operational point of contact for routine retailer and wholesale partner inquiries, coordinating responses internally and escalating as needed.

  • Follow and help maintain SOPs and playbooks for retail operations, flagging opportunities to improve or update processes as new partners are onboarded.

    • HCP Sales Operational Support

  • Partner with the Sr. Director, Revenue Operations and HCP Sales leadership to build the operational infrastructure required to support and scale Pendulum's Healthcare Practitioner channel.

  • Design and implement systems, workflows, and tools that enable the HCP sales team to operate efficiently — including order management processes, partner onboarding workflows, and sales support documentation.

  • Coordinate with Finance, Supply Chain, and Marketing to ensure HCP-specific operational needs (pricing, fulfillment, materials) are met and scalable.

  • Identify operational gaps and bottlenecks within the HCP channel and develop solutions that enable the sales team to focus on growth rather than process friction.

  • Build and maintain SOPs and enablement resources that support a consistent and professional experience for HCP partners.

Who We’re Looking For

    Required

  • 2–4 years of experience in revenue operations, e-commerce operations, marketplace management, or a related multi-channel operations function.

  • Demonstrated experience with Amazon Seller Central or Vendor Central, including catalog management, advertising programs, and performance reporting.

  • Strong analytical skills — proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets required; experience with BI tools (Tableau, Databricks, or similar) strongly preferred.

  • Proven ability to build and manage cross-functional workflows, SOPs, and operational infrastructure in a fast-scaling environment.

  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple complex workstreams simultaneously and drive them to completion.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable coordinating across Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain, Sales, and external partners.

    • Preferred

  • Familiarity with MAP enforcement tools (e.g., Trackstreet) and unauthorized seller programs.

  • Familiarity with EDI systems, vendor portals, and retail partner onboarding workflows.

  • Experience supporting or building operational infrastructure for a B2B or HCP/medical sales channel.

  • Experience in consumer health, wellness, or CPG industries.

  • Exposure to cold-chain or refrigerated product logistics.

What Success Looks Like

    In the first year, success means that:

  • Amazon, marketplace, and retail operations run with high reliability — minimal compliance issues, clean catalogs, and consistent performance reporting delivered on time.

  • The HCP channel has a clear operational foundation: defined workflows, reporting, and support infrastructure that allows the sales team to scale without operational friction.

  • MAP compliance is proactive, not reactive — violations are caught early, enforcement is consistent, and brand integrity is protected across channels.

  • New marketplace and retail partners are onboarded smoothly, with cross-functional teams aligned and execution hitting milestones on schedule.

  • The Sr. Director, Revenue Operations can rely on this role to own execution across channels, surface issues proactively, and bring solutions — not just problems.

  • You are recognized across Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, and Marketing as a high-accountability, operationally excellent partner.

Salary & Benefits

  • $95,000-$120,000
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Life & STD Insurance
  • Company match on 401 (k)
  • Flexible Time Off (FTO)
  • Equity

jobs.title: Solution Architect, Strategic Portfolio & Enterprise Architecture
jobs.excerpt: This Solution Architect is a functional and technical expert who shapes and governs enterprise-wide ServiceNow architectures across complex, multi-product customer portfolios.
jobs.description:
This Solution Architect is a functional and technical expert who shapes and governs enterprise-wide ServiceNow architectures across complex, multi-product customer portfolios. The role requires a strategic mindset focused on long-range platform roadmaps, cross-domain integration patterns, and governance frameworks – providing advisory leadership during pre-sales, delivering enterprise architecture guidance on direct customer engagements, and representing strategic portfolio priorities within ServiceNow (e.g., Product Management, Customer & Partner Excellence, Engineering).

The Solution Architect will bring strategic portfolio management expertise, enterprise architecture leadership, and deep cross-domain product knowledge to drive transformational outcomes for our customers and partners

Responsibilties:

  • Serve as the architectural authority on customer engagement teams owning the strategic platform portfolio across multiple ServiceNow workflow domains, ensuring alignment to each customer's long-term technology landscape, and establishing enterprise governance frameworks and architecture standards.
  • Define and govern enterprise-grade ServiceNow architectures, applying TOGAF or equivalent frameworks alongside ServiceNow technical standards to produce scalable, maintainable, and future-ready platform deployments.
  • Build and sustain strategic relationships with product owners, platform stakeholders, and customer architecture teams influencing ServiceNow product roadmaps and championing multi-domain workflow capabilities.
  • Engage regularly with senior leadership and CXO stakeholders to shape enterprise architecture vision, align multi-year ServiceNow portfolio roadmaps to business strategy, and advise on organizational change management and platform scaling for large, complex environments.
  • Drive enterprise architecture thought leadership through executive briefings, formal presentations, and strategic portfolio workshops showcasing platform transformation outcomes and portfolio scaling success stories.
  • Develop and continuously refine enterprise architecture frameworks, portfolio governance standards, and reusable reference architectures in partnership with the Customer & Partner Excellence Team and field delivery organization.
  • Mentor and elevate enterprise architecture capabilities across the ServiceNow delivery team and partner ecosystem cultivating a community of practice around strategic portfolio management and platform governance.
  • Maintain and advance expertise in enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman) and ServiceNow certifications spanning ITSM, ITOM, App Engine, and cross-domain workflow capabilities.
  • Lead executive architecture workshops, multi-product roadmap definition, and implementation complexity assessments during pre-sales cycles partnering with Services Account Executives, Solution Sales Executives/Consultants, and Partner Sales Organizations to shape winning strategies for complex enterprise opportunities.

​​​​​​​

To be successful in this role, we need someone who has:

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, strategic IT portfolio management, or senior technical advisory roles within a professional services or consulting organization; or equivalent education and experience.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman) and strategic portfolio governance, with a track record of managing complex, multi-domain technology portfolios across Fortune 500 or similarly scaled organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to shape enterprise strategy at the C-suite level. Translating complex multi-domain portfolio decisions into executive narratives, identifying platform investment risks and trade-offs, and delivering architectural thought leadership that accelerates enterprise transformation.
  • Proven ability to produce enterprise architecture artifacts; including platform portfolio roadmaps, reference architectures, and governance frameworks tailored to executive, architectural, and technical audiences across all organizational levels.
  • Experienced in leading strategic architecture reviews and portfolio governance sessions with enterprise customers, driving executive alignment on multi-product platform strategies and long-term architectural vision.
  • Experience leveraging or critically evaluating AI integration within enterprise architecture frameworks; including AI-powered workflow orchestration, agentic automation, and AI governance within complex multi-product portfolios, and assessing AI's strategic impact on enterprise operating models.
  • Skilled at navigating both technical and business stakeholder environments synthesizing enterprise requirements, portfolio constraints, and architectural standards into cohesive, scalable platform strategies across large, complex organizations.
  • Exceptional ability to communicate complex enterprise architecture concepts through visual modeling, architecture blueprints, and structured frameworks that resonate with both executive and technical audiences.
  • Ability to operate independently on complex, ambiguous engagements managing competing priorities, driving issues through to resolution, and making sound architectural decisions without requiring close direction.
  • A demonstrated curiosity for emerging technologies and a drive to apply new capabilities to real-world platform challenges.
  • Strong ability to build trusted relationships with remote and in-person stakeholders across all organizational levels.
  • ServiceNow Certifications:
    • Certified System Administrator (required or must be achieved within the first 60 days)
    • At least 2 relevant Certified Implementation Specialist certifications (required or must be achieved within the first 90 days).
  • Desired ServiceNow Certifications:
    • Certified Technical Architect (required or must be achieved within the first 365 days)

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact for assistance.

All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

jobs.title: Furniture & Fabric Claims Representative
jobs.excerpt: The Furniture and Fabric Claims Representative investigates, evaluates, and resolves product and installation claims for fabrics, trims, and wallcoverings.
jobs.description:
The Furniture and Fabric Claims Representative investigates, evaluates, and resolves product and installation claims for fabrics, trims, and wallcoverings. Serves as the primary liaison between clients, Purchasing, and installers to ensure accurate flaw assessments, fair vendor accountability, and swift, high-satisfaction resolutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the single point of contact for sellers and customers who report a claim with their delivered and applied/installed Fabric, Trim, or Wallcovering order.

  • Manage daily communications via phone and email through Zendesk with customers, Sales Support associates, vendors, service technicians, freight partners, and internal departments.

  • Assess photographic evidence, physical samples, and technical reports for material defects, shade variations, pattern misprints, and physical damage across all three product lines.

  • Determine liability and authorize remedies—including returns, remakes, field repairs, or labor allowances—in accordance with company policies and vendor warranty guidelines.

  • Collaborate with sales reps, Purchasing (mill vendors), and professional installers to de-escalate customer concerns and clarify installation specifications.

  • Coordinate transportation and service provider scheduling to support timely claim resolution.

  • Adhere to Furniture Customer Service processes and procedures.

  • Participate in Furniture Customer Service department meetings and ongoing training.

  • Perform any other duties as assigned by Manager/Supervisor/Lead.

Decision-Making/Scope/Financial Responsibilities:

  • Balance customer satisfaction with company policies and financial interests.

  • Handle escalations, credits, RMAs, and accommodations decisions with sound judgment.

  • Support financial operations through accurate order entry, billing, and application of discounts.

Abilities/Key Competencies/Skills:

  • Strong customer service orientation with clear, professional communication.

  • Proficiency in furniture quoting, order management, fabric sales processes, and analyzing reporting from internal and external partners.

  • Knowledge of cross-department workflows (Operations including Claims, Credit, Purchasing, Showrooms, etc.).

  • Critical thinking and problem-solving with a focus on efficiency and seller outcomes.

  • High attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.

  • Ability to multi-task and adapt to changing priorities.

  • Collaborative, team-oriented mindset with a positive, professional attitude.

  • Solid organizational and time management skills.

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, contact center environment with measurable performance goals.

  • Ability to troubleshoot for solutions before escalating.

  • Ability to remain open minded and agile when new business decisions change a process or procedure.

Requirements

High School Diploma or equivalent

A minimum of 3 years experience in Customer Service claims.

jobs.description:
Misión del puesto

Como Desarrollador/a Senior en SISnet, serás responsable de participar activamente en el análisis, desarrollo y mantenimiento de soluciones tecnológicas sobre la plataforma SISnet. Trabajarás en colaboración con arquitectos técnicos, analistas funcionales y equipos multidisciplinares para asegurar entregas de alto valor y calidad.

Responsabilidades clave

  • Participar en el análisis técnico y funcional de los requerimientos del negocio.

Formación y experiencia

  • Más de 4 años de experiencia en desarrollo sobre la plataforma SISnet.
  • Conocimiento práctico de las versiones recientes de SISnet (idealmente SISnet 11 o superior).
  • Experiencia previa en entornos aseguradores y conocimiento funcional del negocio

Dominio de la Plataforma SISnet

  • Desarrollo y mantenimiento de componentes nativos de SISnet:
    • Pantallas de usuario (TLI1 y TLI2), reglas de negocio, procesos batch y BPM, servicios internos y configuraciones del motor de negocio, Zero Code..
  • Personalización de módulos clave:
    • Emisión, Siniestros, CRM, Cobros, Reaseguro, Multitarificación, Recibos, entre otros.
  • Uso experto del BackOffice de SISnet para configuración funcional y técnica.
  • Experiencia con entornos SISnet (nueva arquitectura basada en servicios).

Lenguajes de Programación y Frameworks

  • Desarrollo y scripting con:
    • Java: desarrollo de lógica personalizada, conectores e integración con sistemas externos.

Base de Datos y SQL

  • Manejo avanzado de bases de datos relacionales:
    • Creación y optimización de stored procedures, triggers, funciones y vistas
    • Realización de joins, filtros, agrupaciones (GROUP BY) y subconsultas simples o correlacionadas.
    • Interpretación de datos desde vistas y tablas del modelo de datos de SISnet.
    • Creación y ejecución de consultas para análisis funcional y validación de datos.

Integración y Conectividad

  • Desarrollo y consumo de servicios web SOAP y RESTful.

  • Experiencia en integraciones con sistemas de terceros:
    • Gestores documentales, plataformas de firma digital, BI/Reporting, ERP, etc.

Gestión del Ciclo de Vida del Software (SDLC)

  • Experiencia con entornos de integración continua y despliegue continuo (CI/CD pipelines).

Pruebas y Calidad del Software

  • Pruebas unitarias y de integración.
  • Validaciones funcionales.
  • Control de calidad y code review colaborativo.

Metodologías y Herramientas de Gestión

  • Trabajo bajo marcos ágiles (Scrum, Kanban) con herramientas como JIRA, Trello o Azure Boards.

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Become a part of our caring community and help us put health first. Humana's ability to put health first starts with a strong culture and associate experience. We are committed to a workplace where associates feel included, connected, engaged, and empowered to do their best work. Network Resource Groups play a key role in advancing inclusion, belonging, engagement, and the Humana Way across the enterprise. They build community, elevate associate voice, support development, and provide insights that help Humana better serve associates, members, patients, and communities.
The Senior Network Resource Group Professional is a key partner in supporting the operations, governance, measurement, and enterprise alignment of Humana’s Network Resource Groups (NRGs). Working closely with the Inclusion and Engagement Director, NRG Lead, NRG leaders, executive sponsors, HR Business Partners, and other stakeholders, this role helps turn NRG strategy and enterprise priorities into practical actions that strengthen inclusion, belonging, engagement, and associate connection. This role helps position Network Resource Groups as strategic accelerators that strengthen associate experience, talent outcomes, leadership capability, culture priorities, and enterprise business objectives. Working closely with NRG leaders, executive sponsors, HR partners, and business stakeholders, the Senior Professional helps translate NRG strategy into action through governance, leader enablement, project execution, measurement, and continuous improvement. The role helps ensure NRGs operate consistently, demonstrate impact, and deliver meaningful value for associates, leaders, and the enterprise.

Serves as an experienced inclusion advisor responsible for leading complex initiatives, assessments, and governance activities. Applies broad expertise in inclusion, organizational effectiveness, employee experience, and workforce practices to deliver data-informed recommendations that address business challenges and mitigate organizational, workforce, regulatory, and reputational risks. Independently manages significant projects, influences cross-functional stakeholders, and contributes to the evolution of enterprise inclusion strategies, frameworks, and practices.

Key Responsibilities

NRG Operations, Governance, and Enablement

  • Partner with NRG leaders, executive sponsors, and stakeholders to align NRG activities with enterprise priorities, culture goals, talent outcomes, and business needs, helping position NRGs as strategic accelerators that drive associate engagement, leadership development, and organizational impact.
  • Support and strengthen NRG governance, operating standards, resources, and accountability practices.
  • Maintain core tools and materials, including playbooks, charters, onboarding resources, templates, and guidance.
  • Ensure NRG resources remain current, accessible, and easy to use.

Cross-NRG Collaboration and Initiative Support

  • Coordinate cross-NRG initiatives, programs, events, and engagement activities aligned with enterprise and Inclusion & Engagement priorities.

  • Share best practices and lessons learned to strengthen NRG effectiveness and help evolve activities from standalone events to more strategic, measurable experiences.

Data, Insights, and Measurement

  • Track, analyze, and report on NRG membership, participation, engagement, and impact while identifying actionable insights and opportunities that support culture, talent, and business priorities.

Stakeholder Partnership and Communication

  • Serve as a key operational contact for NRG leaders, providing guidance, coordination, and support.

  • Manage communication channels and support updates, agendas, summaries, and briefing materials, ensuring messaging is clear, inclusive, and aligned with enterprise priorities.
  • Exercise sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive information.

Project Management and Continuous Improvement

  • Manage project plans, timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder coordination for NRG initiatives and enterprise projects, including complex workstreams across multiple leaders, communities, and functions.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that strengthen governance, efficiency, and leader experience.
  • Surface risks, barriers, and resource needs, and support continuous improvement efforts while adapting to shifting priorities and maintaining alignment with enterprise expectations and culture strategy.

What makes you successful

  • Strong project management and execution skills, with the ability to organize work, manage timelines, coordinate stakeholders, identify risks, and deliver high-quality results in a matrixed environment.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships and collaborate effectively with leaders, associates, HR partners, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Ability to analyze information, identify themes and insights, and translate data or feedback into clear recommendations and action steps.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to develop clear, practical, audience-appropriate materials.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism in handling sensitive or confidential information.
  • Adaptability and resilience in managing transformation, ambiguity, competing priorities, and evolving business needs.

  • 5+ years of experience in inclusion and engagement, culture, associate experience, human resources, community engagement, project management, communications, organizational effectiveness, or a related human capital or business discipline.

Preferred skills:

jobs.description:
As the global leader in AI-powered customer experience assurance, we help some of the world's most recognized brands deliver seamless, reliable, and engaging interactions across voice, digital, messaging, and AI-powered channels. Cyara is the confidence layer that answers that question, testing AI agents with AI agents to detect hallucinations, validate decisions, and ensure compliance before failures ever reach your customers.

Joining Cyara means helping shape the future of customer experience, partnering with some of the world’s biggest brands, and working alongside passionate, talented people who are committed to making every customer interaction better.

The Role

Cyara is the assurance layer that makes enterprise AI investment defensible. Our customers are deploying AI agents into contact centers that handle millions of conversations, and they need proof those agents behave the way they promised the board they would. AI Trust and the Cyara Agentic Platform are how they get it.

You own the marketing for a specific set of product lines. That means the positioning, the messaging that sales actually uses, the launches, and the competitive story. jobs.description:
About the Client

Our client is a global leading, end-to-end enterprise volunteer engagement platform powering over 100 million volunteer hours. They exist to connect communities to events and causes they are passionate about. Used by over 3 million volunteers across 26 different countries, their SaaS platform powers mass volunteer programs across the globe for Not-for-Profits, local government, sporting federations, and major events. Our all-in-one solution helps our clients to recruit, retain, reward and train their volunteers, whilst also ensuring compliance.

About Teamified

Teamified is a talent partner helping companies build exceptional remote teams across IT, software, product, and digital innovation. We collaborate with leading enterprises and fast-scaling tech businesses worldwide to help them access world class talent and accelerate growth. With operations across the globe our mission is to make building high performing global teams simple, fast, and cost-effective. Teamified has hundreds of clients with more than 200 engineers, testers, product managers,designers, and technology experts delivering impactful solutions every day.

About The Role:

Reporting to your Technical Lead, this role will be responsible for delivering high-quality software across the Rosterfy stack as part of a growing SaaS engineering team. You’ll contribute to the evolution of our platform architecture, influence engineering practices, and ship features that support some of the world’s largest volunteer programs. You’ll play a key role in our transition to a principle-led, product-focused engineering model — with a strong emphasis on scalability, quality, documentation, and collaboration. This is a senior-level role requiring demonstrated experience in SaaS, cloud-native environments, and modern software development practices. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer you’re comfortable transitioning between front and back end development using your systems thinking skills to create world class experiences for our customers. You will play an important role in Rosterfy’s evolution towards version 3 (event driven architecture and domain driven development)

Key Responsibilities:

  • As a full stack Senior Engineer you will design and deliver scalable features using Laravel, PHP, React/Next.js, and AWS
  • Collaborate closely with QA, Product, and Design to deliver features with user impact in mind
  • Build and evolve APIs, integrations, and reusable components
  • Participate in improving CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and system performance
  • Lead by example in code quality, documentation, and peer mentorship
  • Contribute to architectural improvements, technical discovery (feature scoping) and execution of our engineering strategy
  • Ensure accessibility and localisation across our multi-region SaaS platform
  • Maintain compliance-minded engineering practices (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2)

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years building SaaS products end-to-end, ideally in multi-region environments.
  • Comfortable working across the full stack — from frontend to backend.

Technical

  • Strong with Laravel (or modern PHP frameworks) and modern frontend tools (React, Next.js, or Vue), XDebug, writing unit tests.
  • Front and Back end Engineering expertise.
  • Mobile (React Native)
  • Experience working in ISO/SOC2 compliant environments
  • Understands accessibility, scalability, and localisation for global users
  • Comfortable operating in cloud-native stacks using AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling
  • Experienced in designing within and around a modular monolith architecture
  • Skilled in relational databases (Aurora MySQL, PostgreSQL), with a strong focus on data modelling for scale and performance

AI Driven Skills (Big Plus)

  • Feature delivery velocity (Copilot, Gemini, test automation, scaffolding)
  • Building AI-augmented product experiences (LLM API usage, prompt design)
  • Coaching others on integrating GenAI into workflows

Character & Mindset

  • Resilient and adaptable – You embrace change and help others navigate ambiguity with calm and confidence.
  • Proactive problem solver – You identify issues early, take ownership, and push solutions forward without waiting to be asked.
  • Clear communicator – You articulate ideas clearly, write well, and listen with intent. You create shared understanding.
  • Product-minded – You’re curious about customer needs, ask “why?”, and advocate for solutions that deliver real value.
  • Leads through influence – You raise the bar by mentoring others, setting standards, and sharing knowledge — not by authority.
  • Documentation-first thinker – You value written clarity, and help your team by documenting decisions, code, and processes.

Shift-Left QA Expectation

  • Lead by example in test strategy and validation
  • Own test coverage, pipeline health, and regression control

Success Measures

  • High-impact technical delivery
  • Maintains or improves product quality
  • Influences architecture and engineering standards
  • Contributes to and influences medium term architectural decisions

Nice to have:

  • Experience with data products like Looker, BigQuery, or analytics pipelines
  • Exposure to event-driven systems, asynchronous workflows, or message queues (e.g. AWS SQS, Kafka, Pub/Sub)
  • Experience with design systems | frontend architecture
  • Passionate about product quality and customer experience
  • Experience with platform engineering or building shared infrastructure in modular monoliths
  • Any exposure to AI driven tooling, systems

Benefits

  • Flexibility in work hours and location, with a focus on managing energy rather than time.
  • Access to online learning platforms and a budget for professional development
  • A collaborative, no-silos environment, encouraging learning and growth across teams
  • A dynamic social culture with team lunches, social events, and opportunities for creative input
  • Health insurance
  • Leave Benefits
  • Provident Fund
  • Gratuity

If you possess the required skills and are eager to contribute to our team's success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Apply now!

jobs.description:
**PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH**

Location: Remote – Latin America
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time
Compensation:$2,000–$3,000 USD/month
English Proficiency:C2 / Near-Native English Required
Schedule:9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time availability required
Industry: Investment Management / Alternative Investments

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing U.S.-based investment management firm building institutional-quality alternative investment solutions for investors, financial advisory firms, and multi-family offices.

The company operates a sophisticated investment platform that includes its own investment funds as well as customized fund-of-funds solutions for financial partners. With assets under management growing rapidly and additional investment products in development, the firm is expanding its operational infrastructure to support its next stage of growth.

The organization combines the innovation and agility of a technology-driven company with the rigor, controls, and sophistication of institutional investment management.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Fund Operations Manager to take hands-on ownership of the operational processes that keep a growing investment fund platform running accurately and efficiently.

This is a specialized fund operations role with responsibility across the monthly NAV cycle, fund accounting, investor transactions, KYC/AML, capital activity, investor reporting, management-company accounting, fund launches, and external provider coordination.

You will work closely with the Head of Operations and serve as a trusted operational partner capable of independently managing critical fund processes from beginning to end.

This is not a traditional back-office role. You will have significant ownership, direct exposure to investors and leadership, and the opportunity to improve and automate fund operations as the platform scales.

What You'll Do

NAV & Fund Accounting

  • Own the monthly NAV process and drive the close through final review and sign-off.

  • Coordinate month-end activities with fund administrators and other external providers.

  • Prepare and review monthly NAVs, identifying and resolving discrepancies before leadership review.

  • Reconcile positions and cash across internal calculations, shadow records, and official administrator records.

  • Manage outstanding manager NAVs and help maintain an efficient and timely close process.

  • Maintain accurate fund performance records, including returns, positions, and expenses.

  • Ensure fund accounting records remain complete, accurate, and audit-ready.

Investor Operations

  • Process investor subscriptions, redemptions, and transfers accurately and on time.

  • Own KYC/AML onboarding processes and maintain an accurate investor register.

  • Coordinate capital calls, distributions, fee calculations, payments, and wire approvals.

  • Serve as a front-line point of contact for investors, handling operational questions with accuracy, professionalism, and discretion.

  • Coordinate directly with external administrators, managers, and service providers to resolve investor-related requests.

Investor Reporting

  • Produce quarterly fact sheets and investor performance reporting using fund control-book data.

  • Support quarterly fund-of-funds reporting and commentary processes.

  • Maintain complete and organized shadow and official NAV records.

  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and data processes.

Management Company Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Manage the management company's books, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, bookkeeping, and month-end close.

  • Prepare recurring management financial reporting, including KPIs, management-fee tracking, and expense reporting.

  • Coordinate invoices, payments, expense management, and financial records.

  • Help bring recurring bookkeeping and reporting processes in-house while improving and automating them wherever possible.

Fund Formation & Launch

  • Support the operational setup and launch of new funds.

  • Coordinate account openings, documentation, and required registrations.

  • Help establish the operational infrastructure for new funds and feeder structures.

  • Ensure new fund launches are executed accurately without disrupting existing fund operations.

Providers, Controls & Operational Infrastructure

  • Manage day-to-day coordination with fund administrators, transfer agents, prime brokers, and banks.

  • Maintain strong controls around operating accounts, fund accounts, and wire approvals.

  • Document fund operations procedures and build scalable operational playbooks.

  • Create reliable processes that provide operational continuity and reduce dependency on any single team member.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve, streamline, and automate fund operations.

Required Qualifications

  • C2 / Near-native English proficiency, written and spoken.

  • 5+ years of hands-on fund operations experience within a fund administrator, hedge fund, private markets manager, fund-of-funds, asset manager, or similar investment environment.

  • Strong hands-on experience managing the NAV cycle, investor transactions, and capital activity.

  • Strong fund accounting foundation, including NAV review, position and cash reconciliation, P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow.

  • Ability to independently identify and resolve errors in monthly NAVs before final approval.

  • Hands-on experience with subscriptions, redemptions, transfers, KYC/AML, capital calls, distributions, and fee calculations.

  • Experience coordinating with fund administrators, transfer agents, prime brokers, and banks.

  • Hands-on accounting experience with accounts payable, accounts receivable, bookkeeping, month-end close, and financial reporting.

  • Experience communicating directly with investors or external financial partners.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and a strong controls mindset.

  • High level of ownership, judgment, discretion, and follow-through.

  • Ability to work independently and manage critical financial processes from beginning to end.

  • Availability during U.S. Eastern business hours (9:00 AM–5:00 PM ET).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within alternative investments or asset management.

  • Fund-of-funds or multi-strategy investment experience.

  • Experience working with multiple funds simultaneously.

  • Experience with feeder funds, holding-company structures, or onshore/offshore investment structures.

  • Experience supporting new fund launches and fund formation.

  • Experience working directly with founders, investors, and external financial service providers.

  • Experience using AI and automation to improve reconciliation, reporting, or recurring fund operations processes.

Tools & Systems

Experience with every platform is not required, but candidates should be comfortable learning sophisticated financial and operational systems quickly.

Relevant tools may include:

  • Fund administration and NAV platforms

  • Fund performance tracking systems

  • Prime brokerage platforms

  • Accounting and expense-management systems

  • SharePoint

  • Google Workspace

  • Slack

  • Notion

  • Linear

  • Claude, Codex, and AI automation tools

What Success Looks Like

The ideal candidate combines deep fund operations expertise with exceptional precision and ownership.

You are someone who:

  • Owns the close: You manage the monthly NAV cycle end to end, proactively resolve issues, and keep the close on schedule.

  • Operates with precision: You reconcile before approving, identify discrepancies others may miss, and build controls that prevent errors.

  • Can be trusted with investor capital: You handle sensitive financial and investor information with exceptional judgment and discretion.

  • Takes complete ownership: Once a responsibility is handed to you, leadership can trust that it will be completed accurately and on time.

  • Improves the system: You continuously look for opportunities to streamline, document, and automate recurring fund operations.

Why Join Us

  • Competitive compensation paid in USD.

  • Fully remote opportunity.

  • Work directly with senior leadership at a growing U.S. investment management firm.

  • Significant ownership over critical fund operations.

  • Exposure to sophisticated alternative investment and fund-of-funds structures.

  • Opportunity to help build and scale the operational infrastructure behind a growing investment platform.

  • Technology-forward environment with opportunities to automate and improve traditional fund operations.

Important Notes

Please submit your CV in English.

Candidates should have direct, hands-on experience in fund operations and fund accounting. General business operations or accounting experience without meaningful exposure to investment fund operations will not be sufficient for this position.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

  • This is a remote/telecommute position.

jobs.description:
About the company

Hi, we're Ondo Finance. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We were the first company to tokenize exposure to US Treasuries, and have since expanded into several other assets. We are also focused on incubating protocols that can support both tokenized real-world assets and traditional crypto.
Founded by folks from Goldman Sachs Digital Assets Team, we’re backed by some of the best investors in the world including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are currently the leaders in the space in terms of AUM and are well capitalized to continue growing the firm. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.

About the role

Ondo Finance is looking for a Growth PM to own user-facing product strategy across our unified platform interface, Ondo Finance App. This role is the growth counterpart to our platform PMs — and will be the primary driver of user acquisition, activation, and retention across Ondo's expanding product suite (Stocks, Treasuries, Portfolios, and more).

You will work at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and marketing to build world-class user journeys for a new generation of on-chain financial products.

What You'll Own

  • User acquisition: Identify and build product-led growth loops, referral mechanisms, onboarding flows, and entry points that bring new users into the Ondo ecosystem
  • Activation: Design and optimize the end-to-end onboarding experience — from first visit to first meaningful transaction — across Ondo Finance Web App and eventually mobile
  • Retention & engagement: Build features and feedback loops that keep users active, informed, and deepening their relationship with Ondo's product lines
  • User journey design: Map and continuously improve user journeys across all Ondo products surfaced through Ondo Finance Web App
  • Experimentation: Drive a structured A/B testing and experimentation culture; define success metrics and own the growth analytics stack alongside data and engineering
  • Cross-product growth: Collaborate with product line PMs to ensure growth initiatives are coordinated and reinforced across product surfaces

Requirements

  • 4–7+ years of product management experience with a clear focus on consumer-facing or growth-oriented products
  • Experience in fintech, crypto, or financial products — particularly products involving real-world assets, trading, or investment platforms
  • Personal experience using financial products similar to ours, with a genuine desire to walk in the customer's shoes
  • Demonstrated track record of owning and improving acquisition, activation, and/or retention metrics at scale
  • Strong product instincts — you care deeply about user experience and are willing to do whatever it takes to make the product successful
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to write sharp, well-reasoned PRDs and present clearly to engineers and leadership
  • Data-driven mindset with hands-on experience defining KPIs, running experiments, and translating data into product decisions
  • US-hours based (preference per current team structure)

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with on-chain / Web3 user onboarding challenges (wallet setup, KYC flows, etc.)
  • Experience working on a unified platform serving multiple financial product lines
  • Prior exposure to developer-facing or API-adjacent products

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation including salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) — we're well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation
  • Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO)
  • Small remote-first team across many countries — you'll be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices
  • A+ colleagues — our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, Pinterest, McKinsey, Circle, Uniswap, Phantom
  • Best-in-class investors — we are proud to be backed by leading crypto experts and VCs, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund and Coinbase Ventures

jobs.description:

On our team, everyone plays a critical role in creating confidence and excitement by personally equipping all athletes to achieve their dreams. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workforce, reflecting the communities we serve.

If you are ready to make a difference as part of the world’s greatest sports team, apply to join our team today!

OVERVIEW:

At DICK’S Sporting Goods, we take a people-centric approach to everything we do. Our Athletes, how we refer to customers, and our Teammates, how we refer to our employees, are at the center of every decision we make so that we can provide transformational experiences online, in store, and in sport. When you join Technology at DICK’S Sporting Goods, you’re joining a true team that wins together. And, while we work remotely from all over the United States, we provide virtual and in-person events for the team to hangout, from virtual escape rooms to cheering on the Pittsburgh Pirates at beautiful PNC Park.

JOB PURPOSE

Designs and build best in-class-solutions. Perform business/software analysis. May coordinate initiatives within a product team. Supports initiatives that ensure enterprise systems remain best-in-class. Learning to lead teams and bodies of work.

Acts as a product-team problem solver and domain SME to design, test, and deliver best in class solutions. Perform business/software analysis. Coordinate work with moderate complexity within assigned product team.

Works within a Supply Chain technology team supporting warehouse, transportation, and fulfillment systems. The team focuses on event-driven services and system integrations that enable inventory movement, order fulfillment, and warehouse operations. Engineers contribute to API development, message-based processing, and cloud-native services that support high-volume, business-critical workflows.

Preferred Experience:

• Kotlin / Java (Spring Boot) for backend services

• REST APIs and event-driven architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ)

• Apache Camel and/or Spring Integration for service orchestration and system integration

• Distributed systems and microservices architecture

• Microsoft Azure (AKS, Azure Functions, cloud-native services)

• Docker and Kubernetes for containerization and deployment

• CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation

• React and/or React Native experience

• Observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting)

• SQL and NoSQL databases

• Secure software development practices

• AI-forward thinking and adoption

Bonus points / nice-to-have:

RESPONSIBILITIES

Software Development

Drive development of existing software and contribute to development of new software by analyzing and identifying areas for modification and improvement. Develop software that is fast, secure and reliable to meet defined requirements.

Software Maintenance

Monitor, identify, and correct more complex software defects to maintain fully functioning software, leveraging the support and skill of more junior teammates.

Design and Conceptualization

Produce multiple concepts and prototypes to design digital products/services.

Technical Developments Recommendation

Research and suggest ways to optimize solutions to better meet user and/or business, performance, quality needs.

Software Roadmap

Drive maintenance road map to facilitate software development and ensure the development work is prioritized in line with business requirements.

Faults Diagnosis and Correction

Find root cause and resolution to limit and address issues promptly.

Work Scheduling and Allocation

Assign short-term work schedules to a team based on storyboarding/backlog in order to achieve expectations while following established timelines.

Ongoing Learning and Development

Develop own and more junior team member capabilities by participating in assessment and development planning activities as well as formal and informal training and coaching; gain or maintain external professional accreditation where relevant to improve performance and fulfill personal potential. Maintain an understanding of relevant technology, external regulation, and industry best practices through ongoing education, attending conferences, and reading specialist media.

Program/Portfolio Management Support

Contribute to work within an established program management plan to achieve specific goals.

Technical Persistence Layer/Legacy Database Design/Development

Guide and deliver the design distribution of basic database resources and provide physical modeling and design services to tune database solutions for optimum performance.

Functional/Technical Requirements

Support the collection functional requirements using document analysis and workflow analysis to express the requirements in terms of target user roles and goals.

BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES

Tech Savvy

Anticipates and adopts innovations in business-building digital and technology applications. For example, investigates technologies to learn some cutting-edge best practices. Uses digital/social media to benefit the team and add value to the work being done; understands how to avoid misuse of these tools.

Decision Quality

Makes good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward. For example, knows when to act independently and when to escalate issues.

Integrates various inputs, decision criteria, and trade-offs to make effective decisions. Typically makes good independent decisions.

Action Oriented

Takes on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm. For example, takes timely action on important or difficult issues. Identifies and pursues new opportunities that benefit the organization.

Collaborates

Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. For example, readily involves others to accomplish goals; stays in touch and shares information; discourages "us versus them" thinking; shows appreciation for others' ideas and input.

Instills Trust

Gains the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity. For example, demonstrates integrity, upholding professional codes of conduct. Instills trust by following through on agreements and commitments despite competing priorities and by being honest and straightforward.

Customer Focus

Builds strong customer relationships and delivers customer-centric solutions. For example, keeps in contact with customers to ensure problems are resolved, or to improve customer service. Studies customer feedback and emerging customer needs and uses these to determine some creative new ideas.

About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

Location: US Remote (Eastern/Central Preferred)

Reports to: Team Lead, Strategic Deployments

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly organized, data-driven, and client-focused Implementation Consultant to join our growing Customer Success team at AlphaSense. This role will manage the onboarding and rollout of our solutions for both new and existing enterprise clients, serving as the bridge between the pre-sale discussions and the onboarding experience for accounts. This role is foundational to our clients’ success and will be focused on executing large deployments, building processes that have scale in mind, and translating client needs into actionable implementation plans.

Who You Are:

  • At least 4+ years of experience as a client-facing Implementation Consultant or Professional Services Consultant in a B2B SaaS environment
  • Experience with change management best practices, ensuring a successful transition for client organizations after deployment
  • Strong sense of seeing a project through completion and managing tasks. Familiarity with project management tools (Linear, Jira, Asana, Rocketlane, etc.) and CRM software (Salesforce) for tracking deployments and client information is a must
  • Understand how to slice through data, with the ability to look at deployment metrics, understand key trends, and develop both internal and external reports. Must be proficient in Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, complex formulas, data validation)
  • Interest in identifying operational inefficiencies and driving organizational change through the development of scalable processes and documentation.
  • Excellent communication skills to persuade both senior client leadership and internal stakeholders to keep projects on track and mitigate risk

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the entirety of the deployment phase, including the development of detailed project plans, defining critical milestones, and proactively mitigating risks to ensure a successful deployment
  • Serve as the main point of contact for deployment activities, leading regular project status meetings, aligning resources (e.g., Sales, Marketing, Product, etc), and communicating progress, risks, and deployment status
  • Act as a resource for analyzing implementation trends, potential bottlenecks, and translating data into clear, actionable insights for both internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Actively identify areas for improvement in our existing deployment methodologies, develop and document best practices and standardized playbooks, and implement scalable solutions to ensure a smoother, faster onboarding experience for all future clients
  • Develop a strong understanding of the product, the persona of customers, the reason for investment, and how this maps back to the customer lifecycle

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.

Base Compensation Range
$100,000—$125,000 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.

jobs.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Surfaces Moments is a ML team within the Personalization Mission focused on creating moment-based experiences across Spotify surfaces. The team owns and evolves the experiences that help listeners quickly connect with the content that matters most to them, including the Home Shortcuts experience and the underlying intelligence that powers it. By combining cutting-edge machine learning, recommendation systems, and product thinking, the team delivers highly relevant, personalized experiences to millions of listeners around the world.

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will help shape the future of personalized discovery and engagement at Spotify. You'll work at the intersection of recommendation systems, large language models, and production-scale machine learning infrastructure to build experiences that delight users and drive meaningful impact. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys taking models from research to production, driving technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces, and solving complex personalization challenges at global scale.

What You'll Do

    • Own and improve the machine learning models and systems that power the Home feed, including the Shortcuts experience.

    • Design, build, and ship personalized recommendations that serve millions of Spotify listeners globally.

    • Build content recommendation systems for emerging agentic and AI-powered user experiences.

    • Train, fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize large language models using techniques such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), distillation, and parameter-efficient training approaches.

    • Partner closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and designers to define and execute experimentation strategies.

    • Drive A/B testing, monitoring, model evaluation, and continuous optimization of recommendation quality, reliability, and cost efficiency.

    • Improve ML platform capabilities, data pipelines, and production systems that support personalization at Spotify scale.

    • Drive technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces and contribute to the long-term architecture of personalization systems.

    • Mentor and support other machine learning engineers, helping raise the bar across the team.

Who You Are

    • You have 8+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production environments.

    • You have deep expertise in recommendation systems, ranking models, personalization, or large-scale content discovery platforms.

    • You have strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience building machine learning systems with PyTorch.

    • You are experienced with large language model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and optimization techniques including SFT, distillation, and LoRA.

    • You have worked with large-scale inference systems and understand the challenges of latency, reliability, and cost optimization.

    • You care deeply about creating high-quality user experiences through thoughtful application of machine learning.

    • You communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, and you influence technical decisions beyond your immediate team

    • You know how to design, execute, and interpret online experiments and A/B tests to improve user outcomes.

    • You have experience operating distributed machine learning workloads using technologies such as Ray, FSDP, HSDP, or similar frameworks.

    • You are experienced building and maintaining data pipelines and orchestration workflows using technologies such as Flyte, Airflow, BigQuery, and cloud-based storage platforms.

Where You'll Be

    • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location.

    • Data dictionaries and controlled vocabularies

    • Data lineage and traceability

    • Schema versioning and change management

  • Experience implementing data quality frameworks, including validation rules, exception handling, and reconciliation processes.

  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, and/or other relevant languages for data pipeline development.

  • Experience designing systems that support AI/ML and analytics use cases, including unstructured data and document processing pipelines (e.g., OCR/ICR outputs).

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Educational qualifications

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $50/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

About the Company

The mining industry has steadily become worse at finding new ore deposits, requiring >10X more capital to make discoveries compared to 30 years ago. The easy-to-find, near-surface deposits have largely been found, and the industry has chronically under-invested in new exploration technology, relying on the manual techniques of yesteryear – even as demand accelerates for copper, lithium, and other metals to build electric vehicles, renewable energy, and data centers.

KoBold builds AI models for mineral exploration and deploys those models—alongside our novel sensors—to guide decisions on KoBold-owned-and-operated exploration programs. Since our founding in 2018, KoBold has become by far both the largest independent mineral exploration company and the largest exploration technology developer. Our data scientists and software engineers, who come from leading technology companies, jointly lead exploration programs with our renowned exploration geologists.

KoBold has proven its first discovery with materially less capital than the industry average and found one of the best copper deposits ever discovered: the copper is far more concentrated than the global average of copper mines, and this asset alone is expected to generate meaningful revenue for decades. KoBold has a portfolio of more than 60 other projects, each of which has the potential for another high-quality discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

KoBold is seeking an experienced International Tax Senior Manager, to join KoBold’s Global Tax and Finance Team and assist in developing and executing tax planning strategies and maintain global tax compliance in a dynamic mining environment. Analyze tax implications of structural changes, model alternative scenarios, and coordinate with Legal, Finance, and external advisors to implement tax-efficient structures across multiple jurisdictions

  • Partner with Procurement, Supply Chain, Technology, Operations, Finance, and Legal on tax and customs implications of business decisions
  • Partner with non-tax departments and leadership to support legal entity structuring for new operations and business expansion
  • Research and identify tax planning opportunities including incentives, credits, duty relief programs, and treaty benefits and assist with existing mining tax credit and SR&ED calculations in Canada; with an ability to take beginning to end ownership of research to execution
  • Assist with tax audits and controversy matters by coordinating responses and developing technical positions
  • Build scalable processes and documentation as the company transitions from exploration to production

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 8 years of tax experience, with public accounting, law firm and/or in-house experience preferred
  • CPA, JD and LLM (Tax) (or equivalent) preferred
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. and international tax regimes
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and use of Ai applications
  • Strong organizational skills and proactive communicator and collaborator
  • Ability to work effectively across cultures and collaborate with international teams
  • Intellectual curiosity and eagerness to learn about all aspects of mineral exploration, particularly in the geology domain. Enjoys constantly learning such that you are driving insights through using our tools in exploration and willing to work directly with geologists in the field.
  • Ability to explain technical problems to and collaborate on solutions with domain experts who are not within the tax or accounting function. A strong communicator who enjoys working with colleagues across the company.
  • Excitement about joining a fast-growing early-stage company, comfort with a dynamic work environment, and eagerness to take on an evolving range of responsibilities.
  • Keen not just to build cool technology, but to figure out what technical product to build to best achieve the business objectives of the company.

Joining KoBold means getting the opportunity for hands-on exposure to our exploration projects around the world. All employees are expected to travel to project sites, with a minimum of one week per year. Field-facing and technical roles spend significantly more time in the field.
