jobs.description:
As a Software Tester on the InteleShare team, you'll safeguard the quality of the platform that healthcare providers use to share and exchange medical imaging. Working across the full testing lifecycle, you'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to catch issues before they reach customers, strengthen our automation practices, and help ensure every release meets the reliability our industry demands.

The work is automation-first. InteleShare is covered by a BDD test framework written in Java 17 and Maven — Cucumber feature files driving Selenium page objects for the web UI and Rest-Assured clients for the APIs, with Allure and ExtentReports for results and Jira Xray for test management — executed against nine application components and nine environments through GitHub Actions. You will write and own tests in that framework, not just execute them manually.

Key Responsibilities

  • Test Planning & Execution: Participate in the full testing lifecycle — requirements validation, test planning, and test case development — through functional, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing, covering image sharing and exchange workflows end to end: DICOM ingestion and retrieval, HL7-driven order and report flows, storage backends, viewer behaviour, and the web application.
  • Automation & Process Improvement: Write and maintain automated tests in the InteleShare framework — Gherkin feature files, Java step definitions, Selenium page objects, and Rest-Assured API tests — and improve the framework's reliability, coverage, and testability within an Agile Scrum environment.
  • CI & Test Operations: Run and triage regression suites through GitHub Actions across components, environments, browsers, and operating systems; keep results flowing into Jira Xray with useful evidence; and drive down flaky tests so failures mean something.
  • Defect Management: Identify, document, and report defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, and evidence, maintaining traceability in Jira/Xray from business requirements and technical specifications through test cases and executions to resolution.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to formulate test scenarios, reproduce customer escalations, troubleshoot issues across the stack, and support post-release and post-implementation testing.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Interact with clients and internal stakeholders to understand product requirements and translate them into effective test coverage.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Up-to-date knowledge of software test design and testing methodologies
  • 2+ years of experience as a Software Tester or QA Analyst on web applications, including hands-on test automation, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with project management principles and QA methodology

Senior Partner Marketing Manager

Partner marketing is one of Intapp's biggest levers for growth, and this role owns a significant share of how that motion comes to life. AI and innovation partnerships are the ecosystem's fastest-growing segment, and you'll lead the marketing behind them — co-marketing with applied-AI leaders and the emerging agentic partners reshaping professional services.

This is a high-ownership, cross-functional role with real budget responsibility. You'll own Intapp's partner sponsorship program end to end, serve as the senior partner marketing contact across the ecosystem and internally, and bring an AI-native operating model to how the team works. Success is measured in pipeline sourced, partners activated, and revenue influenced. Candidates with B2B partner or alliance marketing experience and genuine fluency in the AI landscape are encouraged to apply.

What you will do

As a Senior Partner Marketing Manager, you can expect to:

  • Own and evolve Intapp's partner marketing strategy across the full ecosystem — turning it into a measurable pipeline and co-sell engine — and lead the marketing behind Intapp's AI and innovation partnerships, including foundation model, applied-AI, and agentic technology partners.   • Shape the category narrative for Firm AI in the partner ecosystem: the positioning, messaging, and thought leadership that make Intapp the reference point for how professional firms adopt AI through partners.   • Own the partner marketing roadmap and annual plan: assess the partner tier structure, identify gaps by partner type and segment, scope investment, set measurable targets, and translate priorities into a quarterly plan leadership can act on. Location

The senior Full-Stack Engineer will be an integral part of our Engineering teams in EMEA.This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.

Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.
Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.
With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The OpportunityAI is the fastest-growing line on our customers' cloud bills - and the hardest one to see. Model APIs, managed inference, GPUs, and a growing fleet of agentic coding tools each report spend differently, and most teams still can't answer the basic questions: what are we spending, on which workloads, for which teams, and is it worth it. Our AI cost visibility product, part of DoiT Cloud Intelligence, exists to answer them.
We're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer into our R&D team to own this product end-to-end - from the Go services that ingest and model AI spend, through the APIs that expose it, to the React interfaces where FinOps practitioners and platform engineers make decisions. This is a young product in a category being defined right now. You'll shape how it works, not just implement someone else's spec, and there is a short line from your work to what customers see.
You'll work AI-augmented from day one. We expect you to use AI across your whole workflow - not as an occasional autocomplete - and to have real opinions about where it earns its place and where it doesn't.

Responsibilities

  • Owning features end-to-end. This is the core of the role. Take a problem from understanding the customer's pain, through design and implementation, to release, monitoring and iteration. You define what done looks like and you own the outcome - reliability, user experience and measurable impact included. Propose the work you think should happen; you're not here to wait for a spec.
  • Knowing the product and the domain. Understand how AI spend actually works - token and model pricing, inference and GPU economics, how usage rolls up to teams and initiatives - and how FinOps practitioners reason about it. You should be able to explain why a feature matters to a customer as clearly as how it's built, and bring that judgement into every design decision.
  • Working AI-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work - exploring the codebase and unfamiliar vendor APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar.
  • Full-stack delivery. Design, build and scale backend services in Go and product experiences in TypeScript and React. Turn large volumes of cost and usage data into interfaces that make the answer obvious - clear, fast and trustworthy enough to base financial decisions on.
  • API-first. Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform.

Raising the bar. As a senior engineer, set the standard for the team: thoughtful design reviews, guard-rails that let customers succeed, and engineering practices that let us move fast without breaking trust. Mentor peers and share what you learn.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including multi-tenant SaaS products, with a track record of owning features or products end-to-end in production
  • Strong Go for backend services - APIs, data processing, and the operational realities of running them
  • Strong TypeScript and modern React, with a good eye for how data should be presented
  • Comfortable across the stack. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the data model through to the interface
  • Experience building on public cloud (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure), and working proficiency in SQL against an analytical store such as BigQuery
  • Product-oriented thinking - you care as much about why you're building something and whether it works for users as you do about how it's built
  • AI-augmented working style - you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them, and where they fell short
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles, and the ability to set direction for others
  • Comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving market - you can figure out the right problem to solve, not just the right solution
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal

Self-organized, goal-oriented and self-motivated; confident, thorough and tenacious

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge of FinOps and FinOps products would be a strong plus.
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrating a portfolio of what you've built in your career so far

Are you a Do'er?
Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.
We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.
What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.
Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.
We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Flexible Working Options
  • Health Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

Many Do'ers, One Team DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal-it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.

Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.

jobs.description:
Part-Time Consulting IGA Engineer (Entra ID Governance)
Remote | Contract (1099) | Part-Time, approximately 20 hours per week | November 1 to January 15
This is a fully remote role.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced identity governance engineer to carry out the hands-on build of identity governance and administration capabilities in a large enterprise environment. Our lead architect owns the solution design and client relationship. You will work under that direction and handle the configuration, testing, validation, and documentation of identity lifecycle and entitlement management workflows.
This is an execution role, not a lead role, but it is client facing. You will join working sessions and status calls, answer questions about the configuration you have built, and be expected to represent the work clearly and professionally. It is well suited to a deeply technical engineer who has done this build work before and is comfortable doing it in front of a client.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform discovery of existing identity sources, target systems, and entitlement structures, and document findings and dependencies for the architect
  • Provide input to the architect on governance design and tool configuration decisions
  • Configure identity lifecycle workflows covering joiner, mover, and leaver events
  • Build and configure entitlement management structures including access packages, catalogs, and approval policies
  • Configure access reviews and certification campaigns, including scope, reviewer assignment, and remediation handling
  • Configure Conditional Access policies aligned to lifecycle states and access risk
  • Run test cycles, then validate provisioning and deprovisioning behavior across users, groups, and service accounts
  • Produce as-built documentation and support administrator training and operational handoff

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years implementing IGA solutions in enterprise environments, including workflow build, testing, and production rollout
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID Governance, including identity lifecycle workflows and entitlement management
  • Detailed working knowledge of joiner, mover, and leaver event patterns and how they translate into automated workflow configuration
  • Experience configuring Conditional Access policies in an enterprise environment, including how those policies interact with lifecycle events
  • Experience configuring access reviews and certification campaigns, including scoping and remediation workflows
  • Working knowledge of on-premises Active Directory as a provisioning target in a hybrid environment, including group and account structures and directory synchronization behavior
  • Understanding of modern authentication (OIDC, SAML, Kerberos) and access control models (RBAC, PBAC, ABAC)
  • Working familiarity with Azure environments
  • Ability to author technical documentation and conduct knowledge transfer sessions
  • Comfortable on client calls, able to explain configuration decisions and status clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior work in manufacturing environments
  • Experience integrating multiple authoritative sources of identity data rather than a single HR system of record
  • Experience with SuccessFactors inbound provisioning to Entra ID
  • Experience building custom or API-based provisioning integrations for systems without a native connector
  • Experience with role modeling or entitlement rationalization
  • Experience with separation of duties controls and policy enforcement
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent training, education, and work experience

Contractor Requirements

  • Hourly 1099 engagement, approximately 20 hours per week, running November 1 through January 15
  • Compensated for hours worked. Reduced or paused hours over the holiday period
  • Must be based in the United States and authorized to work without sponsorship
  • Must be able to pass a background check

jobs.excerpt: **Willkommen bei Glow25! **Wir sind ein dynamisches, schnell wachsendes Beauty- und Pro-Aging-Unternehmen mit Sitz in Berlin.
jobs.description:
**Willkommen bei Glow25!

**Wir sind ein dynamisches, schnell wachsendes Beauty- und Pro-Aging-Unternehmen mit Sitz in Berlin. Unsere Herzensmission: Glow-Momente, die bleiben – für unsere Community und für uns als Team.

Arbeit bei Glow25 soll inspirieren, begeistern und Spaß machen. Deshalb suchen wir kluge, empathische Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und mit uns wachsen.

Werde Teil von Glow25 und hilf uns, Beauty neu zu definieren. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Das sind unsere aktuellen Herausforderungen und perspektivischen Ziele:

Glow25 skaliert: Über Marketplaces (Amazon, Zalando, DM), mehrere Länder, verschiedene Zahlungsdienstleister – und unser Accounting muss mithalten. Unser Finance-Team baut eine moderne A/R-Landschaft auf, die diesen Komplexitäten standhält. Wir brauchen einen erfahrenen Senior A/R Manager (all genders), der Prozesse denkt, Automation treibt und gleichzeitig fachlich führt.

Du wirst den Order2Cash-Prozess neu strukturieren – von automatisiertem Marketplace-Settlement über intelligente Cash Application bis zu fehlersicheren, internationalen Meldungen.

In diesem Bereich brauchen wir Deine Unterstützung:

Prozesse & Skalierung

- Du entwickelst unsere Accounting-Systemlandschaft weiter und treibst die Automatisierung entlang des gesamten Order2Cash-Prozesses voran – vom Marketplace-Settlement bis zur Verbuchung.
- Du strukturierst unser internationales Meldewesen (OSS, USt-VA, Zusammenfassungsmeldung) und führst es in einen einheitlichen, tool-gestützten Prozess für alle Länder zusammen.
- Du optimierst Cash Application und Bankabstimmung über alle Zahlungsdienstleister hinweg (z. B. PayPal, Stripe, Amazon Payments).
- Du bereitest unsere Prozesse auf neue Länder und Kanäle vor und baust ein DSO- & Revenue-Reporting auf, das unsere A/R-Performance messbar macht.

Fachliche Führung

- Du bist Eskalationsinstanz bei komplexen Fällen – von strittigen Rechnungen über Klärfälle mit Marktplätzen bis zu Compliance-Grenzfällen.
- Du sicherst die Qualität unserer Buchungen und Meldungen über Stichproben und klare Standards.
- Du gibst dein Prozess-Know-how ans Team weiter und sorgst für belastbare Vertretungsregelungen.

Operativ

- Du koordinierst und verantwortest den A/R-Anteil am Monatsabschluss und sorgst für einen verlässlichen, schnellen Close.
- Du ermittelst und buchst systematisch Rückstellungen zum Monatsende.
- Du gibst fachlichen Input, wenn neue Vertriebskanäle oder Länder angebunden werden.

Du bringst folgende Erfahrungen mit:

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Accounting (mindestens 5 Jahre) mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Accounts Receivable (A/R) oder Forderungsmanagement.
- Branchenkenntnis E-Commerce / Marketplace / Multichannel: Du verstehst die Besonderheiten von Amazon, Zalando und Co. – Gebührenstrukturen, Settlements, Chargebacks, Retouren.
- Fundierte Kenntnisse im internationalen Umsatzsteuer-Meldewesen – OSS (One-Stop-Shop), Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung (USt-VA), Zusammenfassungsmeldung (ZM) sind für dich Daily Business.
- Sichere Systemkompetenz: DATEV, SAP, NetSuite oder vergleichbare ERP-/Buchhaltungssysteme; Erfahrung mit E-Commerce-Accounting-Tools (z. B. Shopify, WooCommerce Integrationen, Marketplace APIs) ist ein Plus.
- Nachweisbare Erfolge im Aufbau und in der Automatisierung von Finance-Prozessen – du denkst in Systemen, nicht in Einzelfällen.
- Fähigkeit zur fachlichen Führung: Wissen weitergeben, Qualität sichern, in Eskalationen souverän bleiben, Team entwickeln.
- Deutschkenntnisse (C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse – lokale und internationale Anforderungen sprechen dich an.

Das sind Charakterzüge, die dich beschreiben:

- Du denkst strukturiert und systemisch – nicht nur den heutigen Fall lösen, sondern Prozesse so bauen, dass sie auch morgen skalieren.
- Du bist proaktiv und pragmatisch: Wenn ein Tool nicht passt, suchst du nach der nächsten Lösung – dich lähmt keine Komplexität.
- Du arbeiten eigenverantwortlich und bringst Eigeninitiative mit – Fachlichkeit kombiniert mit Ownership.
- Du bist ein echter Teamplayer: Wissen zu teilen macht dir Freude, und du unterstützt dein Team aktiv bei der Weiterentwicklung.
- Du schätzt klare Regeln und Qualität – und sorgst dafür, dass sie auch eingehalten werden.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen:

  • Flexibel arbeiten, wie’s zu dir passt. Arbeite wann und wo du am produktivsten bist - mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und smarter Stundenerfassung.

  • Glow Card – jeden Monat ein Bonus. 50 € Guthaben monatlich für lokale Anbieter – macht 600 € im Jahr extra für dich.

  • Weiterkommen leicht gemacht. Mit unserer Glowcademy und Lernzeit pro Woche bleibst du immer am Ball.

  • 40 % Mitarbeiterrabatt. Auf das komplette Sortiment – das lohnt sich wirklich.

  • Urlaub, der dir guttut. 30 Tage frei + 1 persönlicher Feiertag + bis zu 10 unbezahlte Tage extra, wenn du mal länger abschalten willst.

  • Gesundheit im Fokus. Wir übernehmen bis zu 600 € im Jahr für Zusatzleistungen – von Brille bis Zahnreinigung.

  • Für später gut abgesichert. Nach der Probezeit gibt’s 600 € Zuschuss zur Altersvorsorge – und wenn du selbst mit einzahlst, legen wir nochmal 20 % drauf.

  • Corporate Benefits & FutureBens. Hol dir exklusive Rabatte und Vorteile bei vielen Partnern.

  • Kultur, die wirklich strahlt. Seit fünf Jahren in Folge sind wir als Top Company bei Kununu ausgezeichnet - ein echtes Zeichen für unsere starke, positive und gelebte Kultur.

Yay! Du hast es bis hierher geschafft!

Wenn du jetzt immer noch liest, ist die Wahrscheinlichkeit groß, dass wir ein Match sind.

Eine Sache liegt uns aber noch auf dem Herzen:
Trau dich! Vor allem als Frau, oder als jemand einer unterrepräsentierten Bevölkerungsgruppe. Auch wenn du nicht überall einen Haken setzen kannst, möchten wir dich ermutigen, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Wir glauben, dass eine bunte Vielfalt von Perspektiven und Erfahrungen ein Team stärker macht - und je stärker unser Team ist, desto besser erreichen wir unsere Mission, Menschen zu mehr Energie im Alltag zu verhelfen.

We are seeking a Senior SEO & CRM Manager to own how the group's venues are discovered online, converted into bookings, and brought back through CRM and customer engagement activity.

This is a hands-on senior role. You will be responsible for improving local search visibility, building and optimising venue pages, managing Google Business Profiles, overseeing reviews, and developing CRM campaigns across approximately 10,000 existing customer records.

The ideal candidate will be highly proactive and able to assess a venue, identify opportunities, and determine what needs to be done without waiting for step-by-step instructions. You should be equally comfortable with strategy and execution — from identifying SEO opportunities and implementing structured data to building pages, sending campaigns, and responding to reviews.

Key Responsibilities

Local SEO & Discoverability

  • Own and optimize Google Business Profiles across all venues.
  • Audit and improve local search visibility across multiple Sydney locations.
  • Maintain accurate business listings, NAP consistency, and local citations.
  • Implement and maintain structured data/schema markup, including LocalBusiness, Hotel, and Events
  • Monitor emerging AI search visibility and identify opportunities to improve discoverability.
  • Manage review responses across venues, ensuring responses are handled within 72 hours.
  • Develop and manage UTMs, unique URLs, and QR tracking to measure local activity.

Website & Conversion

  • Build and optimize 60+ function room and accommodation pages across the group's venues.
  • Manage CMS page creation, updates, and optimisation.
  • Improve enquiry and booking pathways to increase conversion.
  • Monitor page performance, redirects, and technical SEO requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve venue, accommodation, event, and function-room pages.

CRM & Customer Engagement

  • Import, clean, organise, and segment approximately 10,000 existing customer records.
  • Manage CRM platform administration and configuration.
  • Build and send email and SMS campaigns.
  • Track engagement, redemptions, and campaign performance.
  • Develop reporting to understand customer behaviour and identify opportunities for repeat visits.

Reporting & Optimisation

  • Provide monthly digital performance reporting for each venue.
  • Monitor discoverability, traffic, enquiries, bookings, reviews, CRM engagement, and other relevant metrics.
  • Identify performance gaps and proactively recommend improvements.
  • Work closely with the onshore Creative Lead and Group Brand, Marketing & Strategy Manager.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on local SEO experience, preferably across multiple locations or sites.
  • Proven experience managing SEO for multi-location businesses. Multi-site experience is more important than agency experience.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of structured data and schema markup, including LocalBusiness, Hotel, and Event schema.
  • Experience building and optimising website pages through a CMS.
  • Proven experience with email marketing and/or CRM platforms, including campaign creation and deployment.
  • Experience managing and responding to reviews at scale.
  • Strong understanding of local SEO, Google Business Profiles, NAP consistency, listings, and local search optimisation.
  • Ability to work independently from business objectives and context rather than requiring step-by-step briefs.
  • Comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills with the ability to identify issues and recommend practical solutions.
  • Excellent written English communication skills.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience working within hospitality, accommodation, retail, or another multi-location business.
  • Experience with Google Ads.
  • Experience tracking or improving visibility within AI search and answer engines.
  • Experience with function, events, accommodation, or venue-based businesses.

What Success Looks Like at 12 Months

By the end of your first 12 months, success will look like:

  • Every venue has a complete, accurate, and optimised Google Business Profile.
  • 100% of reviews receive a response within 72 hours, with overall review volume increased by 50% group-wide.
  • Function rooms are discoverable in search, with dedicated capacity pages built and optimised across venues.
  • The existing database of approximately 10,000 customer records has been successfully activated through CRM campaigns.
  • Every licensee receives a clear, one-page monthly digital performance report — something that does not exist today.

A new venue can be onboarded into the digital and CRM systems in approximately two hours, rather than requiring a lengthy project.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Work exclusively with the client’s business from their hire date and must not have any other ongoing employment, client work, freelance engagements, or side hustles.
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile, clearly marked as “Independent Contractor.”
  • Work full-time and maintain regular overlap with Sydney business hours.
  • Take ownership of digital performance across multiple venues and proactively identify and execute improvements.
  • Be comfortable working independently without requiring detailed, step-by-step instructions.
  • Understand that the role is both strategic and hands-on, with regular output and performance reviewed by the client.
  • Escalate matters involving safety, discrimination, staff conduct, or legal concerns to the onshore team rather than responding independently.

Assessment Heads-Up:

As part of the hiring process, shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a practical assessment. This is designed to assess your ability to think strategically, identify opportunities, and apply your hands-on knowledge across local SEO, structured data, website optimisation, CRM, and multi-site digital management.

Important: This is a senior-level position. We are specifically looking for someone who can independently assess a multi-site business, identify what needs to be improved, and execute those improvements. Candidates who are purely strategy-focused or require detailed instructions are unlikely to be suitable.

jobs.excerpt: Pulmovant is a Roivant-backed clinical-stage biotechnology company committed to transforming the lives of patients with pulmonary diseases.
jobs.description:
Pulmovant is a Roivant-backed clinical-stage biotechnology company committed to transforming the lives of patients with pulmonary diseases. Pulmovant’s first investigational candidate, mosliciguat, is designed to provide a novel, once-daily, inhaled treatment option for patients with pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD). Mosliciguat is a potential first-in-class soluble guanylate cyclase activator with a differentiated mechanism of action currently being evaluated in the Phase 3 PHrontier global clinical trial in PH-ILD, but with potential broad applicability across the PH and ILD disease landscape.

Pulmovant recently announced positive results from its Phase 2 PHocus study evaluating mosliciguat for the treatment of pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD), a progressive and life-threatening condition with significant unmet medical needs for patients. PHocus met both primary and secondary endpoints including the highest ever reported pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR) reduction in any randomized controlled PH trial. The robust results, in conjunction with mosliciguat’s once-daily, inhaled administration and potential first-in-class sGC activator profile, strongly position it as a potential single agent treatment and combination therapy for patients with PH-ILD. These data represent a significant advancement in a devastating disease that affects ~200,000 patients with no or very limited treatment options. A Phase 3 trial is currently underway. More details can be found in the press release here.

As part of the Roivant family of companies, Pulmovant leverages the power of collaboration and innovation to drive progress.

For more information, please visit .

About Roivant:

Roivant specializes in developing transformative medicines at an accelerated pace through the launch of nimble biopharmaceutical and health technology entities, each meticulously tailored to address a specific medical need. Since its inception in 2014, Roivant has achieved the following critical milestones in support of its vision: built over 20 Vants; 12 consecutive positive Phase 3 trials; 9 FDA approvals; 5 successful IPOs; >$6B in capital raised; >$10B in global pharma partnerships and proceeds; and continued pipeline expansion across various modalities and therapeutic areas through in-licensing and acquisition of novel product candidates and technology platforms. In addition to a robust clinical stage pipeline, Roivant also incubates discovery-stage companies and health technology startups complementary to its biopharmaceutical business.

Position: Director, Clinical Supply

Summary: Pulmovant is seeking a leader in Clinical Supply who will provide planning and execution of Clinical Supply Chain activities to support Pulmovant clinical studies globally. This position coordinates operations including clinical packaging, labeling, and distribution. Responsible for actively managing all inventory, logistics and forecasting for the clinical program. This person will be the subject matter expert related to clinical drug supply during all phases of the clinical trial and will support activities leading to the implementation of global clinical inventory management, supply planning and distribution systems consistent with meeting cGMP, clinical development programs, corporate objectives and is responsible for vendor management including performance metrics.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

  • Directly oversee contract manufacturing packaging, labeling, and international shipping/distribution operations for IMP (Investigational Medicinal Product) ensuring on time delivery to support clinical trials
  • Manage, coach and mentor Clinical Supply Managers
  • Act as primary liaison with contractor(s) (CMO's). Complete business and performance metrics
  • Work with CMC, Clinical Operations, QA and Regulatory to develop kits and label text for multiple countries/regions and provide support for IND filings as required
  • Establish SOPs, protocols, and procedures for clinical trial material packaging, labeling and distribution to ensure compliance with cGxP requirements
  • Manage development of pharmacy manuals with appropriate internal subject matter experts
  • Manage vendor selection for clinical study support, including Clinical Packaging and Labeling facilities as required. Work with Regulatory Compliance and QA in selection/qualification of CMO's
  • Subject matter expert for clinical trial supply during regulatory inspections
  • Proactively address risk management issues and implement business continuity plans

Education and Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years of related experience in the pharmaceutical industry with at least 5 years of direct experience in Global Clinical Supply Management
  • Prior investigational drug product experience and prior GCP training is required
  • Recent industry experience with clinical supplies or clinical operations is preferred

EssentialSkills andAbilities

  • Ability to communicate and maintain collaborative relationships effectively with key internal and external stakeholders
  • Proven ability to select, secure and manage external vendors to achieve results and control expenditures
  • Demonstrated experience with global clinical supply forecasting, planning, packaging, labeling, inventory management, IVRS systems, clinical trial designs (randomized, double, blind, placebo controlled)

As is typical of a remote-based role, employees must be able, with or without an accommodation to: use a computer; engage in communications via phone, video, and electronic messaging; engage in problem solving and non-linear thought, analysis, and dialogue; collaborate with others; maintain general availability during standard business hours

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $50/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio. - Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

  • Maintain quality and compliant documentation related to all aspects of site management including quality and ALCOA+ compliant monitoring visit reports, centralized monitoring reports, site contact reports, Trial Master File/Investigator Site File, etc.
  • Serve as the main MapLight point of contact for Investigator sites to support protocol compliance, streamlined communications, timely responses to site staff needs, and training needs.
  • Support the study team and Investigator sites during inspections or audits, as needed.
  • Perform other assigned tasks, as requested.
  • Support the study team(s) in development of study documents and procedures.

As requested:

  • Support the development and maintenance of the study monitoring plan, templates, and tools.
  • Support the set-up, testing, and maintenance of study systems (EDC, eCOA, IRT, etc.) as well as related supporting documents (manuals, eCRF Completion Guidelines, etc.) in collaboration with MapLight and CRO/vendor study team members.
  • Continually review and reconcile the Trial Master File and Investigator Site File for assigned sites to ensure inspection readiness.
  • Maintain current knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry best practices related to monitoring, including centralized monitoring and risk-based monitoring.
  • Support development and process improvement for the MapLight monitoring function.
  • Support development and revision of SOPs, processes, templates, tools, and plans with the aim of continual improvement and streamlining.
  • Contribute to the maintenance and improvement of clinical systems to drive process improvement and efficiency.
  • Embody and demonstrate MapLight’s core values of Integrity, Collaboration, Bravery, and Dedication.

Qualifications:

  • Approximately 5 plus years in the clinical trial industry with at least 4 years of clinical monitoring experience including complex therapeutic areas, in-patient trials, and blinded trials.
  • CNS and/or neuropsychiatry, specifically in-patient schizophrenia and/or Alzheimer’s disease psychosis or Alzheimer's disease agitation experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience working in small/emerging biotech is ideal
  • Experience managing multiple Investigator sites and multiple studies simultaneously.
  • Willingness to travel nationally to assigned Investigator sites as needed for required visits.
  • Ability to build relationships between Investigator sites and MapLight to foster strong collaboration, trust, and positive working relationships.
  • Strong working knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), ALCOA+, and pertinent regulations.
  • Ability to engage collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders in a professional manner.
  • Strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills.
  • A self-starter with the ability to work independently and proactively.
  • Willingness to be a “team player” and take on additional responsibilities as requested.
  • Demonstrates core understanding of medical terminology and clinical trial activities in relation to execution of a clinical development plan.
  • High attention to detail and focus on quality and compliance in all aspects of assigned work.
  • Experience working in various clinical software systems (EDC, CTMS, eTMF, eCOA, EMR).
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Ability to travel independently by air, car and/or train. Location near a major airport preferred.

Compensation for this role may vary within the above range based on many factors including geographic location, candidate experience, and skills. Additional compensation/benefits include annual bonus opportunity, medical, dental, vision, life and AD&D, short term and long term disability, 401(K) plan with match, stock options, flexible non-accrual paid time off, and parental leave.

Responsabilités:

  • Déterminer le niveau adéquat de surveillance de l’assurance de la qualité sur divers systèmes informatiques et de TI.

  • Coordonner, avec les équipes des TI appropriées ou les fournisseurs tiers, l’affinement de la documentation des besoins de l’entreprise/des utilisateurs, ainsi que la préparation, l’élaboration, la tenue à jour et l’exécution d’un large éventail de plans d’essai de qualité complexes, de scénarios d’essai et de scripts d’essai avec une compétence totale du cycle de vie des essais logiciels, dans le cadre du CDS, afin de garantir que les logiciels respectent ou dépassent les normes précisées et les exigences de l’utilisateur final.

  • Examiner et obtenir, de l’équipe de Développement, la documentation des essais unitaires, le cas échéant, pour les systèmes validés, afin de s’assurer que le code autorisé dans l’environnement d’essai a fait l’objet d’essais unitaires adéquats avant de reprendre les essais d’assurance de la qualité et l’essai d’acceptation des utilisateurs (EAU).

  • Créer des plans d’essai et des rapports de synthèse sur les essais. 

  • Concevoir et créer des scénarios d’essai et des données de configuration pour les scripts d’essai qui sont appropriés aux risques et aux objectifs des applications et des améliorations. Les scénarios d’essai peuvent comprendre des essais fonctionnels, des essais d’intégration, des essais de défi et des essais de régression.

  • Mener l’exécution des scénarios d’essai pour les essais fonctionnels, les essais d’intégration, les essais de défi et les essais de régression conformément au plan d’essai et aux scénarios d’essai approuvés.

  • Consigner les défauts et organiser une réunion de triage des défauts avec les parties prenantes requises aux fins de résolution de ceux-ci.

  • Informer l’équipe de Gestion du changement de l’approbation de procéder à la programmation du RFC pour intégrer le code mis à l’essai à la production.

  • Fournir du soutien pour les essais spécialisés selon les besoins, notamment les essais de sécurité, la préparation de l’environnement, la validation du calendrier des lots, les essais de rendement et les essais automatisés.

  • Participer à la création et à la tenue à jour de la documentation pour soutenir les processus ou les applications.

  • Faciliter les activités d’essai d’acceptation des utilisateurs et aider à la supervision par un tiers ou à la tenue à jour des plans d’essai individuels des produits assignés afin d’assurer la qualité du produit d’un point de vue fonctionnel et qualitatif.

  • Assurer la conformité à toutes les politiques, procédures et règles de sécurité appropriées.

  • Exécuter les tâches connexes qui lui sont attribuées.

Expérience:

  • Baccalauréat en génie logiciel ou dans un domaine lié aux soins de santé.

  • Expérience des essais des applications de soins de santé, de la pharmacie, de l’ERP; une expérience de la pharmacovigilance est préférable.

  • Expérience des essais d’intégration ou des essais d’API.

  • Expérience des outils de gestion des essais automatisés.

  • Expérience pratique de travail avec des systèmes validés dans une industrie réglementée.

Compétences et Connaissances

  • Polyvalent et capable d’effectuer plusieurs tâches à la fois; peut travailler dans un environnement ambigu et évoluant rapidement, tout en recherchant la clarté et les solutions; fait preuve d’ingéniosité dans l’établissement des priorités.

  • Une expérience dans la validation des systèmes GxP constitue un atout.

jobs.title: Site Selection Specialist
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionThe Site Selection Specialist is a key collaborator to project teams as the main point of contact for site selection activities (including site identification and feasibility).
jobs.description:
Description

The Site Selection Specialist is a key collaborator to project teams as the main point of contact for site selection activities (including site identification and feasibility).

This role is perfect for you if:

  • You have experience working with clinical research sites;
  • You want to work in a collaborative environment;
  • You want to have an impact in a fast-growing company.

RESPONSIBILITIES

More specifically, the Site Selection Specialist:

  • Develops and maintains positive and productive relationships with key clinical research sites.
  • Participates in the identification of investigators and research sites to expand the investigator database (e.g., performs literature/online searches to identify new investigators).
  • Collects information supporting the definition of an ideal investigator for studies.
  • Identifies and recommends potential investigators for studies.
  • Develops interest survey assessments for studies.
  • Creates and coordinates distribution of study-specific feasibility questionnaires.
  • Reviews completed feasibility questionnaires and recommends sites for qualification visits.
  • Coordinates CRA resource allocation required for site qualification visits.
  • Reviews site qualification visit summaries.
  • Recommends sites for participation in the study, in consultation with the Sponsor and other project team members (as necessary).
  • Tracks key site selection activities in our Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS).
  • Attends internal and external project team meetings, as necessary.
  • Works in collaboration with project teams to identify quality issues related to sites performance on active studies through project meetings, escalation of site communications, and quality assurance audit findings.
  • Participates in internal departmental projects initiated by the site selection and contracting group.
  • May participate in internal departmental projects initiated by other groups to provide insight on site selection activities and overall site intelligence.
  • Supports the Manager, Site Selection to ensure knowledge of the goals, scope and requirements of the internal and external projects and to ensure high quality results are delivered.

Requirements

IDEAL PROFILE

﻿

  • Bachelor’s degree in science or relevant field of study.
  • Excellent oral and written skills in English, French is an asset.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in clinical research in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or CRO industry, including significant and relevant experience in site selection, study start-up activities, site budget/contract negotiation and/or has worked closely with sites or worked in a site environment.
  • Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, Power Point).
  • Experience of dermatological clinical research is an asset.
  • Quick learner, good adaptability and versatile.
  • Ability to work in a team environment and establish good relationships with colleagues, sponsors, and sites.
  • Organized, able to juggle competing priorities, and work in a fast pace and evolving environment.
  • Flexibility, positive attitude, superior attention to detail, and critical thinking skills.
  • Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Home-based position
  • Ongoing learning and development

About Indero

A Global Clinical Leader In Dermatology!

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale.

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in Romania, Bulgaria, Hungary or Portugal

jobs.excerpt: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) - Remote Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
jobs.description:
Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$180,000 Annually
Experience Required: 10+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Site Reliability Engineer to ensure the availability, performance, and operational excellence of large-scale distributed systems in production. As an SRE you will live at the boundary between development and operations, applying strong software engineering principles to infrastructure and operations problems, and continually pushing the platform toward higher reliability with lower operational toil. The ideal candidate will combine deep systems knowledge with strong programming skills, a measurement-driven mindset, and the discipline to design, automate, and operate complex services so that reliability becomes a first-class engineering deliverable rather than a reactive concern.
Key Responsibilities
  • Define, instrument, and continually refine service-level objectives (SLOs), service-level indicators (SLIs), and error budgets for critical services, and use those measures to drive concrete engineering and prioritization decisions.
  • Lead incident response and resolution for production issues, acting as a calm and effective incident commander when needed, and ensuring high-quality post-incident reviews that drive lasting improvements.
  • Design and implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing strategies using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/EFK, Datadog, or similar tooling so that operators have rich, actionable visibility into system behavior.
  • Build and maintain robust on-call processes, runbooks, and escalation paths that reduce mean time to detect and mean time to resolve while protecting the well-being of the engineers on rotation.
  • Automate operational toil aggressively by writing production-grade tooling in Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages, replacing manual workflows with reliable, auditable automation.
  • Architect and operate large-scale Kubernetes clusters and container-based workloads, including autoscaling, capacity planning, network policy, and integration with service meshes.
  • Design CI/CD pipelines that promote safe, frequent, and observable releases, supported by automated testing, canary deployments, feature flags, and progressive rollout strategies.
  • Lead capacity planning and performance engineering activities, building models that predict growth and stress, and validating those models through load testing and chaos experiments.
  • Partner closely with application development teams to embed reliability practices early in design — including failure-mode analyses, graceful degradation patterns, and dependency hardening.
  • Strengthen the platform’s resiliency through chaos engineering, fault injection, dependency isolation, retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, and well-tested failover paths.
  • Drive continuous improvement of security posture in collaboration with security teams, including patch management, vulnerability remediation, and secure-by-default platform defaults.
  • Contribute to the technical roadmap for reliability tooling, observability platforms, and developer-experience improvements that reduce friction and improve outcomes for engineering teams.
  • Mentor engineers across the organization on SRE practices and foster a strong, blameless culture of operational excellence.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Ten or more years of SRE, DevOps, or production engineering experience supporting large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong programming skills in at least one of Python, Go, or Java, with the ability to build robust automation and tooling.
  • Deep, hands-on experience operating Linux at scale, including networking, performance tuning, and systems-level troubleshooting.
  • Production experience operating Kubernetes and container-based workloads.
  • Strong working knowledge of observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/EFK, or commercial equivalents.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines for both infrastructure and applications.
  • Solid understanding of distributed system design, including consistency models, partitioning, and failure semantics.
  • Demonstrated experience leading incident response and conducting effective post-incident reviews.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience defining and operationalizing SLOs and error budgets in real production environments.
  • Exposure to chaos engineering practices and tools such as Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, or Litmus.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Background in capacity planning, performance engineering, or large-scale load testing.
  • Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio, Linkerd, or Consul.

How to Apply

We are seeking a Journal Editor who will determine and plan editorial content and manage publication and distribution of in-house and/or external publication(s). Serves as an information specialist and brings expertise to scientific and/or promotional editing and writing.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities

  • Edit and/or produce written materials/manuscripts, and ensure technical accuracy, editorial consistency, clarity, and appropriateness for the target audience using technical/scientific knowledge of the subject matter.
  • Plan layouts, contract with vendors, review copy.
  • Design layout and oversee production.
  • Research story ideas and assign or write articles.
  • Plan and manage budgets.
  • Oversee advertising activities.
  • Supervise or oversee related staff.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to create structure and form in the writing and editing of manuals and other communication vehicles.
  • Perform literature reviews and Internet research on selected topics.
  • Collaborate with authors on content development, editing, and submission of journal articles.
  • Guide the work of design/desktop publishing staff in developing content for internal and external audiences.
  • Apply subject matter expertise to edit manuscripts and other journal features.
  • Interact with authors on changes, agreement to copyright release and mandatory charges, deadlines, and production requirements.
  • Oversee the administrative function of the journal, e.g., publication budget, basic copy editing of non-scientific portions of the journal, editorial board meeting content and scheduling, advertising space and advertising goals, maintenance of on-line editing systems.
  • May establish author guidelines, resource materials, and make recommendations for overall format for journals
  • Other duties as assigned.


Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree in related field.
  • Three years of related experience.
  • Additional education may substitute for required experience, and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond a high school diploma/graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.


Preferred Qualifications
  • Doctoral Degree in related field.
  • Five years of related experience, preferably with the journal, Review of Educational Research.

Technical Qualifications or Specialized Certifications

  • Ability to understand scientific information, including theory, quantitative and qualitative data, and the preferred structure of scientific journal manuscripts.

Technical Skills & Expected Level of Proficiency

  • Editing - Intermediate
  • Editorial Process - Intermediate
  • Project Management - Intermediate
  • Proofreading - Intermediate
  • Reporting Writing - Intermediate
  • Style Guides - Intermediate
  • Visual Design - Intermediate
  • Writing - Intermediate

The core technical skills listed are most essential; additional technical skills may be required based on specific division or department needs.

jobs.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer - AWS & Salesforce (Serbia)
jobs.excerpt: Project Overview: At Flosum, we build the leading native DevOps, Release Management, and Data Backup solutions for the Salesforce ecosystem.
jobs.description:
Project Overview: At Flosum, we build the leading native DevOps, Release Management, and Data Backup solutions for the Salesforce ecosystem. While our core platform is native to Salesforce, we utilize a hyperscale, open-cloud architecture on AWS for key web applications and high-throughput background processing.

We are looking for an expert Senior QA Automation Engineer to design, build, and maintain an end-to-end automated testing framework that bridges our AWS cloud web applications and our core Salesforce architecture. This is a mission-critical role where you will ensure the seamless, secure sync of enterprise DevOps data between cloud microservices and Salesforce metadata.

What You Will Do:

  • Design and implement an automated testing framework covering both our AWS-hosted web app and our connected Salesforce native workflows.
  • Automate end-to-end user journeys that cross platforms (e.g., actions initiated in our cloud web UI that trigger deployments or metadata backups inside Salesforce).
  • Create stable UI tests for Salesforce Lightning that resist dynamic ID changes and effectively handle Shadow DOM components (using UTAM, Playwright, or enterprise testing tools).
  • Develop robust API automation suites to validate real-time data integrations, webhooks, and secure queues running between AWS and Salesforce.
  • Integrate the automated test suites cleanly into modern Git-based CI/CD pipelines.

Requirements

Required Experience & Skills:

  • 4+ years in QA Automation Engineering, specifically handling complex enterprise integrations.
  • Deep Salesforce Expertise: Exceptional understanding of Salesforce Lightning architecture, metadata, security models, and developer workflows.
  • Technical Stack: Proficient in code-first automation (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium) OR deep expertise in Salesforce-specific automated testing systems (Provar, ACCELQ, or UTAM framework).
  • API & Database Testing: Expertise in REST API testing and a strong command of SOQL queries for direct Salesforce database verification.
  • DevOps Mindset: Solid experience setting up automated test steps within CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, or cloud developer tools).

jobs.excerpt: Job Summary:Guidant Power is looking for a high-potential B2B marketer ready to take the next major step in their career.
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

Guidant Power is looking for a high-potential B2B marketer ready to take the next major step in their career. This is a hands-on leadership opportunity to build and own the marketing function of a rapidly growing, private-equity-backed services company. The Director will report directly to the CEO, work closely with sales and operating leadership, participate in Shore Capital's marketing cohorts and operating resources, and gain experience building the go-to-market capabilities of a company growing organically and through acquisition. We are looking for a builder, not simply a manager. The Director will own Guidant's lead-generation engine, HubSpot, campaigns, marketing metrics, budget, agencies, and the process for creating qualified pipeline one and two quarters ahead of sales requirements. This role is designed for a marketer ready to earn broader leadership responsibility by producing measurable business results.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Marketing Leadership
Develop and manage Guidant's annual marketing plan, campaign calendar, priorities, and budget, setting measurable objectives and KPIs.
Develop the lead flow model required to support organic bookings goals, including how many leads and qualified opportunities Guidant needs and how far in advance they must be created.
Translate company growth objectives, service-line priorities, target industries, and customer needs into measurable marketing programs that generate qualified opportunities and future pipeline.
Support and help execute marketing campaigns in support of Guidant's M&A strategy.
Advise leadership on marketing investments, resource requirements, channel mix, technology needs, and which programs should be increased, improved, or stopped based on performance.
Develop relationships with and manage outside agencies, contractors, paid media partners, content resources, data vendors, and other marketing resources, managing them for quality, cost, timing, and results.
Assess marketing functions of newly acquired companies, integrating each acquisition into Guidant’s marketing strategy, system, processes and brand.

Campaigns & Market Development
Own the marketing calendar, coordinating campaigns, content, product and service-line launches, and events into a single schedule that aligns with sales priorities and business objectives.
Create, launch, and manage integrated campaigns across email, paid advertising, social media, events, webinars, outbound BDR programs, and targeted accounts (ABM).
Plan and support Guidant's presence at trade shows, conferences, customer events, and webinars, including audience targeting, booth and materials, pre-event outreach, on-site support, lead capture into HubSpot, and post-event follow-up measured by qualified opportunities created.
Work with outside contractors to continually improve SEO, and its AI relatives, ensuring Guidant is accessible to prospects searching for our solutions.
Use qualitative market research with customers, prospects, salespeople, technical experts, and industry participants to identify buying triggers, needs, objections, and opportunities, then translate those insights into positioning, content, offers, and campaigns.
Establish campaign objectives, audiences, offers, budgets, schedules, responsibilities, and success measures; manage the internal and external resources required to develop content, lists, creative assets, landing pages, and workflows.
Continuously improve campaigns based on lead quality, funnel conversion, pipeline generated, bookings, revenue, cost per qualified opportunity, and ROI.Systems, Funnel Metrics & Reporting
Oversee implementation of HubSpot and own HubSpot as Guidant's marketing automation and top-of-funnel platform, including campaigns, BDR lead generation and activity monitoring, lead scoring, qualification, website activity, workflows, sequences, attribution, and funnel reporting.
Build and manage dashboards that measure leads, qualified opportunities, pipeline generated by source, pipeline coverage one and two quarters forward, funnel conversion rates, cost per qualified opportunity, campaign and channel ROI, attribution, and marketing contribution to bookings and revenue.
Manage marketing data quality and integrations among HubSpot, NetSuite, Guidant websites, and relevant external data sources. NetSuite will remain the primary system for sales opportunities, customers, bookings, and revenue.
Establish common definitions, workflows, and service levels for leads, MQLs, sales-accepted leads, handoff to sales, conversion to opportunities in NetSuite, and attribution so Guidant can measure the full path from first engagement through booked business.

Experience:

5 or more years of progressive B2B marketing experience, preferably in services, industrial markets, engineering, electrical services, or other technical businesses, with a record of rapidly increasing responsibility and strong business results.
Demonstrated success personally building and executing demand-generation programs that create qualified opportunities and pipeline. Prior responsibility for an entire marketing function is not required.
This role may be particularly attractive to a successful Senior Marketing Manager, Demand Generation Manager, Growth Marketing Manager, or first-time Director who is ready for broader ownership and accountability.
Strong hands-on experience with HubSpot or a comparable marketing automation platform, with enough technical understanding to build workflows, reporting, and campaigns and to effectively manage outside implementation resources.
Strong marketing foundation with practical understanding of segmentation, positioning, the four P's, customer acquisition, qualitative market research, content, SEO, paid media, social media, email, events, and account-based marketing.
Experience building lead-management processes, funnel metrics, attribution, dashboards, campaign measurement, and reporting that connects marketing investment to pipeline, bookings, and revenue.
Experience managing agencies, vendors, contractors, budgets, and cross-functional programs with sales, operations, technical experts, and leadership.
Experience in an acquisitive, multi-location, or rapidly scaling services company is preferred. Prior experience in a private-equity-backed company, M&A marketing, acquisition integration, or cross-selling is a plus, not a requirement.

Personal
Characteristics

Leadership & Influence: Establishes clear priorities, standards, responsibilities, and deadlines. Gains cooperation across marketing, sales, operations, service lines, leadership, acquired companies, and outside partners, even without direct reporting authority.
Strategic & Hands-On: Can define the strategy and personally drive execution. Comfortable moving from market insight and investment decisions to campaign briefs, content review, HubSpot workflows, dashboards, and vendor management.
Customer & Market Curious: Listens carefully to customers and the market, asks strong questions, identifies patterns, and turns qualitative insight into positioning, content, campaigns, and growth opportunities.
Data-Oriented & Process Disciplined: Builds reliable reporting, maintains clean data, and uses agreed definitions and workflows. Looks beyond activity metrics to understand conversion, future pipeline, bookings, revenue, and ROI.
Systems Thinker: Understands how campaigns, websites, forms, HubSpot, BDR activity, CRM workflows, sales processes, NetSuite, and reporting connect into one revenue system. Identifies root causes and creates practical, scalable solutions.
Commercially Minded: Treats marketing as a revenue-generating function. Prioritizes work based on customer needs, sales productivity, qualified opportunity creation, pipeline coverage, and business value.
Resource Management: Excellent project management and organizational skills to manage agencies, contractors, technology investments, budgets, and competing priorities. Holds outside partners accountable for quality, cost, timing, and results.
Self-Directed & Accountable: Takes ownership of outcomes, manages competing priorities with minimal oversight, follows through on commitments, and is comfortable being accountable for the future pipeline created by marketing.
Ambitious Builder: Energized by the opportunity to create something that does not yet exist. Seeks responsibility rather than waiting for it, learns quickly, operates with urgency, and sees this role as a chance to prove the ability to lead a marketing function and grow with the company.

What Success Looks Like

Leadership can reliably answer how many leads and qualified opportunities Guidant needs each quarter and how much future pipeline marketing created this month.
Guidant can identify which channels and campaigns create the best opportunities, what a qualified opportunity costs, and which investments should be increased, improved, or stopped.
Marketing consistently creates qualified opportunities early enough to improve pipeline coverage one and two quarters forward improving sales productivity.
HubSpot is fully operational and provides reliable campaign, BDR, lead-scoring, qualification, website, attribution, and funnel-conversion data, integrated appropriately with NetSuite. Data is accurate, complete, and usable. Integrations work reliably and accurately.
Leadership can measure the full path from first engagement through qualified opportunity, sales pipeline, bookings, and revenue, with accurate attribution and funnel conversion metrics.
Integrated campaigns are launched on schedule, measured consistently, and improved based on pipeline, revenue, and ROI; target-account and cross-sell programs contribute to measurable growth.
M&A-related marketing supports acquisition strategy, integrates acquired companies into Guidant's go-to-market model, and creates cross-sell opportunities across acquired customer bases.
Outside marketing resources meet agreed expectations for quality, timing, cost, and business results, while Guidant's marketing processes become more scalable, documented, and repeatable as the company grows.
The Director earns increasing responsibility by producing measurable results, exercising sound judgment, and building a scalable marketing function as Guidant grows.

About Guidant Power

Guidant Power creates safer, more productive workplaces by helping companies improve electrical safety, reliability, and employee capability. bachelors degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field

jobs.description:
PENN Entertainment, Inc. is North America’s leading provider of integrated entertainment, sports content, and casino gaming experiences. From casinos and racetracks to online gaming, sports betting and entertainment content, we deliver the experiences people want, how and where they want them.

We’re always on the lookout for those who are passionate about creating and delivering cutting-edge online gaming and sports media products.
