jobs.description:
Who we are:
At Wagepoint, we're good people. It's easy to feel that way when you're surrounded by folks doing the best work of their careers, building great payroll software for small businesses across Canada.

Our team brings together diverse backgrounds, perspectives, experiences, and ideas to make payroll the easiest part of running a business.

We're remote-first, growing, and looking for passionate people who don't settle for the first solution or the way it's been done before. We care deeply about our customers and each other, and understand that when it comes to payroll, getting it right matters.

Our values guide how we work and what we expect from one another:

  • Cultivate Impact by focusing on what matters most and delivering meaningful outcomes for our customers.

  • Unify as One Team by collaborating openly, communicating clearly, and rallying around shared goals.

  • Stay Curious and Kind by challenging assumptions, learning quickly, and leading with empathy.

If you want to build the future of payroll in a place where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter, look no further!

The role at high level:

We're looking for a talented Senior Content Marketing Managerwho enjoys tackling hard problems and wants to create meaningful impact for small businesses across Canada.

Wagepoint is looking for a hands-on digital content marketer who can turn strategy into a steady stream of useful, discoverable and distinctly Wagepoint content. You'll own our day-to-day social publishing engine and content-led SEO and GEO execution, while writing, editing, repurposing and coordinating the people needed to get strong work out the door.

This is a maker role with strategic range. You'll be close enough to the work to write the content, run the content engine, and read the performance report - then use what you learn to make the next piece better. You will report directly to our Director, Content & Brand.

What you'll be expected to own:

  • Social publishing and distribution (about 30%)

    • Own the day-to-day social editorial calendar across Wagepoint's priority channels, from idea and platform-native copy through scheduling, publishing and quality control.

    • Maintain a dependable rhythm of five posts per week, balancing educational, brand, product, customer and timely content, prioritizing relevance, audience reach, qualified traffic and meaningful action.

    • Turn blogs, guides, webinars, videos, research and customer insights into channel-specific social stories rather than simple link promotion.

    • Partner with design and internal subject-matter experts on briefs, visual direction and fast approvals.

    • Track channel performance, test formats and messages, and share clear recommendations about what to repeat, stop or change.

    Content SEO, GEO and organic growth (about 25%)

    • Translate technical SEO, search-demand, AI-search behaviour and audience insights into a prioritized content backlog of new pages, targeted refreshes and internal-linking improvements.

    • Build briefs around the real questions and intent of our SMB and accounting and bookkeeping audiences, with credible expertise, useful structure and a clear next step.

    • Optimize on-page elements, structure, metadata and internal links while protecting clarity, accuracy and Wagepoint's voice.

    • Work with our technical SEO/GEO and web partners on recommendations, implementation dependencies and measurement; bring content judgment to the decisions.

    • Monitor rankings, qualified organic traffic, engagement and conversion signals, then use the evidence to shape the roadmap.

    Writing, editing and brand voice (about 25%)

    • Write and edit short- to long-form work such as social copy, conversion copy, product and campaign content, resource updates, and web copy.

    • Build a regular feedback loop with Sales, Customer Success and other customer-facing teams to uncover common questions, objections, successes and friction that should shape the editorial calendar.

    • Make complex or compliance-sensitive topics clear, human and practical without sanding away the nuance.

    • Edit work from internal contributors, specialists and partner advocates for structure, accuracy, voice and usefulness.

    • Use AI thoughtfully to accelerate research, ideation, repurposing and quality checks while keeping human judgment, originality and accountability firmly in the loop.

    Content operations and measurement (about 20%)

    • Keep the editorial calendar, briefs, reviews and handoffs moving so the team can publish consistently without last-minute scrambles.

    • For larger content initiatives, define the priority audience, distribution plan and desired next action before production begins.

    • Build lightweight systems for repurposing, evergreen refreshes, content governance and asset reuse.

    • Maintain a simple monthly view of owned content performance that connects publishing activity to audience growth, engagement, qualified traffic and conversion.

    • Spot workflow bottlenecks and solve them with better priorities, clearer roles or simpler processes.

What you bring to the table:

  • About seven or more years of experience in content marketing, digital marketing or social content - or equivalent evidence that you have operated at this level.

  • A portfolio that shows strong writing and editing across formats, including work you personally created and work you improved or directed.

  • Hands-on ownership of brand social channels, including editorial planning, publishing, measurement and iteration.

  • Practical SEO/GEO experience: search intent, content briefs, on-page optimization, internal linking, content refreshes and performance analysis.

  • The ability to make complex subjects understandable without losing accuracy - especially when facts, regulations or customer trust matter.

  • Comfort using analytics and channel tools to make decisions. Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Agorapulse; exact tool matches are not required.

  • Strong project judgment in a lean, remote environment: you can prioritize, ask for what you need, collaborate generously and ship.

Bonus points if:

  • Experience in Canadian payroll, accounting, bookkeeping, fintech, HR technology, B2B SaaS or another complex or regulated category.

  • Experience marketing to small business owners and/or professional advisors.

  • Experience with data-led content, webinars, video or integrated campaign distribution.

  • Familiarity with emerging search behaviour, AI-assisted discovery and content designed to earn citations or recommendations beyond traditional search results.

What we bring to the table:

  • Impact:Dig in and directly contribute to Wagepoint’s growth and success.

  • Culture:Work alongside a team that genuinely enjoys solving problems together, celebrates wins, supports one another through challenges, and still finds time for the occasional terrible joke.

  • Growth:We believe learning is part of the job. We’re committed to helping you Get Better Every Day (a representation of our Stay Curious and Kind value!) by offering professional development, new experiences, and career growth as we continue to evolve.

  • Innovation:Curiosity and experimentation encouraged! Bring ideas, challenge assumptions, responsibly utilize AI, and help shape better ways of working.

  • Remote:Work from wherever you do your best work. Wagepoint has always been remote-first, giving you flexibility, autonomy, and hopefully a little extra time with the people (and pets) you love.

Ready to join the team? Apply now and help us continue making payroll the easiest part of running a business.

Next steps:

If this sounds like the right fit, we’d love to hear from you! No need for a formal cover letter, just send us your resume and if you’d like, a few lines about what excites you about the opportunity.

If we agree it's a great match, someone from our team will reach out to schedule a call.

Psssst!

In 2026, we were recognized as one of Canada's Best Workplaces for Mental Wellness and Inclusion. That commitment extends to our hiring process, where we strive to create an experience that is welcoming, respectful, and inclusive from day one.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and perspectives, and we're committed to building a workplace where everyone can thrive.

As a remote company, all interviews are conducted virtually. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We're happy to support you!

  • Evaluate emerging technologies supporting digital assets and tokenization.

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a motivated and consultative Business Development Representative (BDR) to generate, qualify, and nurture high-quality sales opportunities through inbound and outbound prospecting.

In this role, you’ll engage prospective customers, conduct discovery conversations, identify business needs, and hand qualified opportunities to Account Executives. You’ll play a key role in driving pipeline growth while delivering a professional and consultative buying experience.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who enjoys prospecting, relationship building, lead qualification, and creating new business opportunities in a fast-paced B2B sales environment.

Lead Qualification & Discovery

Pipeline Nurturing & Relationship Building

Sales Collaboration

    • Messaging

CRM & Sales Operations

    • Similar CRM platforms
  • Track:

What Success Looks Like

  • Maintains a healthy and predictable pipeline.
  • Conducts effective discovery conversations.
  • Delivers seamless handoffs to Account Executives.
  • Maintains accurate CRM records and reporting.
  • Contributes directly to revenue growth.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You enjoy building relationships and starting conversations.
  • You’re naturally curious and ask thoughtful discovery questions.
  • You stay organized while managing multiple prospects.
  • You’re resilient and comfortable with outbound outreach.
  • You communicate confidently with decision-makers.
  • You’re motivated by goals, pipeline growth, and continuous improvement.

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in:
    • Business Development
    • Sales Development
    • Inside Sales
    • Outbound Prospecting
  • Experience conducting discovery and qualification calls.
  • Hands-on experience with CRM platforms such as:
    • Salesforce
    • HubSpot
    • Zoho CRM
  • Experience using:
    • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
    • Apollo
    • Outreach
    • SalesLoft
    • Similar sales engagement platforms
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple prospects and follow-up sequences simultaneously.

Nice to Have

  • 3–5 years of BDR or SDR experience with a proven track record.
  • Experience selling:
    • B2B SaaS
    • Technology solutions
    • Professional services
    • High-ticket products or services
  • Familiarity with:
    • MEDDIC
    • Challenger Sale
    • SPIN Selling
    • Sandler Methodology
  • Experience supporting mid-market or enterprise sales teams.
  • Background in account-based selling and multi-channel outreach.

Tech Stack

  • Salesforce
  • HubSpot
  • Zoho CRM
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Apollo
  • Outreach
  • SalesLoft
  • Google Workspace
  • Microsoft Office

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Respond to inbound leads and conduct discovery calls.
  • Research target accounts and identify decision-makers.
  • Execute outbound email, phone, and LinkedIn campaigns.
  • Qualify opportunities and schedule meetings.
  • Update CRM records and pipeline stages.
  • Collaborate with Account Executives on active opportunities.
  • Review outreach metrics and optimize messaging.

In short: You’ll build qualified pipeline by identifying opportunities, engaging prospects, conducting discovery, and connecting Account Executives with sales-ready leads.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Outreach activity (calls, emails, LinkedIn touches).
  • Discovery calls completed.
  • Qualified opportunities generated.
  • Lead-to-opportunity conversion rate.
  • Pipeline contribution.
  • CRM accuracy and documentation quality.
  • Prospect engagement and response rates.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on pipeline growth and revenue generation.
  • Close collaboration with sales leadership and Account Executives.
  • Exposure to modern outbound sales strategies and tools.
  • Fully remote role aligned with U.S. business hours.
  • Career progression into:
    • Senior BDR
    • Account Executive
    • Business Development Manager
    • Sales Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple initial screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your business development experience, and explain how you’ve handled outbound prospecting, discovery calls, lead qualification, and pipeline generation. You’ll also have the chance to demonstrate your communication style, objection-handling approach, and experience using CRM and sales engagement tools. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving to the client interview.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

About the Job:

We’re looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the SDK team, the team behind LaunchDarkly’s developer experience across every platform. The team builds and maintains 35+ open-source SDKs, along with OpenFeature providers, event-streaming libraries, contract tests, release tooling, and the Relay Proxy. This is the code developers integrate directly into their applications and the primary way customers experience LaunchDarkly day-to-day.

Our SDKs are feature-rich agents that bring LaunchDarkly’s capabilities into a wide range of languages, frameworks, and platforms, with a deep focus on performance, concurrency, resiliency, and idiomatic developer experiences. Trillions of feature flag evaluations run through code this team ships, giving the team an unusually direct impact on how safely and confidently engineering organizations deliver software.

You’ll lead a senior, polyglot team working at the intersection of developer tooling, distributed systems, open source, and the next generation of software delivery. It’s an opportunity to shape a highly visible portfolio, influence how developers (including AI-assisted developers) integrate with LaunchDarkly, and help define what great developer infrastructure looks like at scale.

This is a role with real technical and organizational scope: you’ll help set priorities across a large, long-lived ecosystem; guide decisions around compatibility, versioning, release quality, and resilience; and grow a team whose work is public, widely used, and central to LaunchDarkly’s product experience

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop a team of senior engineers, providing coaching, feedback, and career growth opportunities
  • Own prioritization and intake for the SDK portfolio, balancing feature work, maintenance, security, and customer escalations across 35+ SDKs and the Relay Proxy
  • Partner with Product Management to define and deliver the SDK and Relay Proxy roadmap, including version support and deprecation policy
  • Guide technical tradeoffs across languages and platforms, and help the team keep our SDKs idiomatic, performant, and resilient
  • Represent SDK engineering with customers, Support, Solutions, and Sales, and communicate roadmaps, risks, and progress clearly to engineering leadership
  • Drive operational excellence in release quality, observability, and incident response for SDKs and the Relay Proxy
  • Build team working norms that promote collaboration, reduce silos and bus factor, and keep engineers engaged
  • Participate in hiring to grow the team and raise the engineering bar

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in a formal engineering management role, including managing senior engineers
  • Experience leading teams that build developer-facing software: SDKs, client libraries, public APIs, or open-source projects used by external developers
  • Working familiarity with several programming languages and ecosystems, and the judgment to guide technical tradeoffs in a polyglot codebase
  • Proven ability to prioritize across many stakeholders and to partner with Product Management to translate business goals into engineering plans with reliable estimates
  • Track record of coaching and developing senior engineers, including performance management, career growth planning, and technical mentorship
  • Excellent communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including customers
  • Familiarity with observability practices and comfort with production incident response
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source software is a plus

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $240,600 - $330,700**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $216,500 - $297,600**
  • Zone 3: All other US locations - $204,500 - $281,100**

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize

jobs.excerpt: About the Alliance for Wildfire ResilienceThe Alliance for Wildfire Resilience (AWR) is working to achieve meaningful and durable policy change to lessen the negative impacts of wildfire both today and tomorrow.
jobs.description:
About the Alliance for Wildfire Resilience

The Alliance for Wildfire Resilience (AWR) is working to achieve meaningful and durable policy change to lessen the negative impacts of wildfire both today and tomorrow. AWR works with the broader wildland fire community to advance policy change and foster systemic solutions to the growing wildfire crisis.

AWR is a collaboration of AWR Research and AWR Action. AWR Research, a fiscally sponsored project of the 501(c)(3) Resources Legacy Fund (RLF), provides public education, nonpartisan research, analysis, and public education on America’s worsening wildland fire crisis. AWR Action, a fiscally sponsored project of the 501(c)(4) Fund for a Better Future (FBF), advocates for wildfire policy reforms through coalition building, strategic communications, and engagement with decision-makers.

Resources Legacy Fund (RLF) delivers transformative outcomes for our planet and its people through trusted partnerships and creative campaigns. Rooted in California and expanding across Western North America and beyond, we have a 25-year track record of supporting initiatives at every scale. We host fiscally sponsored projects that reach across the globe, reinforcing the efforts of change makers worldwide. To learn more about Resources Legacy Fund, visit .

About the Opportunity

AWR is seeking a curious and rigorous Policy Associate, Wildfire to strengthen the organization’s policy research and analysis capacity. This position focuses on researching wildfire, land management, emergency management, and related policy topics and developing white papers, issue briefs, and other written products that inform AWR’s positions and support the broader wildland fire community. The role also monitors and analyzes federal legislative, administrative, and regulatory developments, translating complex information into clear, useful analysis for AWR’s team and partners. The Policy Analyst may also periodically represent AWR in meetings with policymakers and coalition partners.

Government relations experience is welcomed but not required for this role. We are looking primarily for strong research, analytical, and writing skills, along with genuine curiosity about wildfire and natural resource policy.

This position will work closely with the Managing Director for Policy and will collaborate regularly with AWR’s policy, government relations, communications, and research staff to ensure written products are accurate, timely, and effective for their intended audiences.

The successful candidate will be adept at navigating work in a growing organization and remote work. This is a full-time, exempt position that reports to the Managing Director or Policy. The position is fully remote within the U.S., with occasional travel for team meetings, conferences, or partner convenings (estimated 4 to 6 trips per year).

Key Responsibilities

Policy Research & Writing (45%)

  • Develop and manage the production and distribution of a variety of written products such as reports and issue briefs that influence the policy debate on key wildfire issues.
  • Synthesize complex technical, scientific, and programmatic information into clear, accessible, and persuasive written materials.
  • Conduct qualitative literature reviews and meta-analyses of existing research.
  • In coordination with other AWR staff, assist in the development and assessment of new policy ideas and approaches and, as appropriate, provide requested technical assistance to external stakeholders on those ideas.
  • Collaborate with communications staff to rapidly respond to policy developments as needed, including by drafting articles, fact sheets, memos, op-eds, and social media.
  • Produce comment letters, testimony, and other written materials as needed.

Stakeholder & Internal Coordination (30%)

  • Support in-person and virtual meetings (with occasional presentations)
  • Coordinate with partner organizations, coalitions, and subject matter experts to inform research and ensure AWR’s written products reflect current data and best practices.
  • Contribute to internal strategy and advise senior staff on key insights by breaking down strategic questions into clear, actionable steps.

Policy Monitoring & Analysis (15%)

  • Track federal legislation, regulatory actions, and administrative developments related to wildfire risk reduction, response, and post-fire recovery.
  • Develop timely analyses of bills, proposed rules, and other policy developments, outlining implications for AWR and its partners.
  • Communicate regular updates on legislative and regulatory developments to the full AWR team.

Strategy & Administrative Support (10%)

  • Support the development of AWR’s overall policy research agenda and priorities.
  • Maintain organized files, source documentation, and citation records so research products are well-supported and easy to update.
  • Support grant proposals, reporting, and funder updates related to policy research work.

Requirements

Note: These qualifications are guidelines, not hard and fast rules, so if you have 75% of the qualifications listed, we encourage you to apply. Experience can include paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work that helped you to build the competencies, knowledge, and skills needed for this position. Applying gives you the opportunity to be considered.

Key Skills

  • Strong qualitative research, analytical, and writing skills, including the ability to write for both technical and non-technical audiences across a range of products.
  • Ability to independently plan, prioritize, allocate time, balance projects, and coordinate with internal and external partners.
  • Ability to independently manage projects from conception to completion.
  • Knowledge of, or strong interest in, wildfire, natural resources, emergency management, land management, or related policy areas.
  • Strong attention to detail and sound judgment in fact-checking, sourcing, and citation.
  • Strong interpersonal skills; ability to collaborate effectively across policy, government relations, communications, and research teams.
  • Commitment to AWR’s mission and goals to improve wildfire response, recovery, and risk reduction.

Ideal Qualifications

  • Education or equivalent work experience in public policy, political science, environmental science, forestry, natural resources, journalism, law, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in policy research, analysis, or related writing (e.g., in a think tank, government, academic, or nonprofit setting).
  • Experience managing projects across multiple members of staff and teams.
  • Experience developing white papers, issue briefs, or similar research products for policy audiences.
  • Excellent presentation and written and oral communication skills, with experience with public speaking and writing.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in writing with different audiences about complex policy issues.
  • Established relationships with economic experts, policymakers, and advocates valued.
  • Government relations, legislative, or advocacy experience is useful but not required.

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination, where all team members feel valued, respected, and included. We know that our work is enriched by the varied voices and perspectives of every staff and board member, so we are committed to making an earnest effort to recruit, welcome, train, develop, and retain talented individuals from all backgrounds. We believe that a welcoming culture expands our creative capacity to do our work and achieve greater outcomes for people and the natural world.

Benefits

The Policy Associate, Wildfire starting salary range is: $75,000 - $85,000 annually, salary commensurate with related work experience and qualifications.

We have an alternate Fridays off work schedule (employees work 40 hours one week, 32 hours the next week). The position has a comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401{k) plan with a 5% match, and generous paid time off. Benefits also include a technology allowance, student loan repayment assistance, the Calm app, mental health benefits, and approximately 17 paid holidays per year.

How to Apply

Please submit a resume and cover letter - please be sure to address your experiences with bipartisan relationship building, any relevant subject area expertise, and developing policy materials for decision-makers. Applicants encouraged to apply by October 5, 2026.

RLF participates in E-Verify, potential candidates can review the information here and here.

About the company

Hi, we're Ondo Finance. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We were the first company to tokenize exposure to US Treasuries, and have since expanded into several other assets. We are also focused on incubating protocols that can support both tokenized real-world assets and traditional crypto.
Founded by folks from Goldman Sachs Digital Assets Team, we’re backed by some of the best investors in the world including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are currently the leaders in the space in terms of AUM and are well capitalized to continue growing the firm. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.

About the Role

In this role, you will drives Ondo’s outbound onboarding to the exchanges, brokers, custodians, banks, and service providers that underpin our products and treasury operations. This role owns onboarding end to end — gathering documents, completing KYB/KYC applications, coordinating with Legal and Compliance, and maintaining accurate status across a book of 20+ concurrent workstreams.

We are looking for someone who is organized, detail-oriented, and reliable under the pressure of managing many open items at once. You will co-own the onboarding function alongside an experienced peer, splitting coverage across counterparties and backing each other up. After ramping on Ondo-specific processes, counterparties, and entity structures, you will run your own book independently — setting priorities, driving items to close, and using judgment on when to pull in Legal, Compliance, or leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Onboarding Execution

  • Execute across the vendor onboarding lifecycle: gathering entity documentation, completing KYB/KYC applications, tracking outstanding items, and following up with counterparties and internal stakeholders.
  • Prepare document packages in response to counterparty requirements — including corporate structure materials, beneficial ownership disclosures, AML certifications, authorized signatory forms, and tax documents.
  • Track progress across multiple concurrent onboardings, keeping each record current with clear status, blockers, and next actions.
  • Drive responses to incoming due diligence questionnaires (DDQs), coordinating internally to gather accurate information and owning the response through submission.

Legal & Compliance Coordination

  • Route contracts and agreements through Legal for review and own the follow-up to keep things moving. Treat Legal and Compliance as your closest business partners — know when to push, when to escalate, and when to resolve directly.
  • Coordinate with Compliance on document requests, KYC refresh cycles, and AML certifications.
  • Flag delays and blockers proactively — to internal stakeholders and to the relevant counterparty — rather than waiting to be asked.

Tracking & Documentation

  • Keep onboarding records accurate and up to date in shared trackers. Every active deal should have a known stage, owner, and next action.
  • File executed agreements, completed DDQs, and supporting materials in the appropriate locations for audit readiness.
  • Use AI tools as a core part of the workflow — drafting communications, organizing documentation, building and maintaining tracking tools, and accelerating repetitive work.

Counterparty Communication

  • Serve as a primary point of contact with vendors during onboarding, representing Ondo externally. Write clear, professional communications on Ondo’s behalf.
  • Keep internal stakeholders informed of status, blockers, and expected timelines.

Requirements

  • A track record of independently running operations, vendor management, compliance, or legal-coordination workstreams end to end — ideally in financial services or another regulated environment. We evaluate on demonstrated scope and impact, not years of experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple open workstreams simultaneously without missing details or deadlines.
  • Comfortable following up persistently — with external counterparties and internal teams — to keep things moving.
  • Strong written communication: professional external emails, clear internal updates, organized documentation.
  • Proficiency with document management and workflow tools (Google Drive, Notion, DocuSign, or similar).
  • Fluency with AI tools — you use them daily to draft, organize, analyze, and build lightweight tooling. This is core to how the team works, not a nice-to-have.
  • Working knowledge of entity documentation (incorporation certificates, beneficial ownership disclosures, W-8s) and institutional KYB/KYC processes.
  • Background in digital assets, crypto, or financial services is a plus but not required

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation including but not limited to salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) — We are well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation.
  • Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO).
  • Remote-first team across many countries — You will be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices.
  • A+ colleagues — Our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, McKinsey, Circle, Uniswap.
  • Best-in-class investors — We are proud to be backed by leading crypto experts and VCs, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund and Coinbase Ventures.

Job titleSenior Foundation Relations ManagerReports toSenior Director, Foundation RelationsFLSA StatusNon-ExemptPosition
Alliance for Justice (AFJ) is a national association of over 140 organizations representing a broad array of groups committed to progressive values and the creation of an equitable, just, and free society. AFJ’s programs comprisefour core pillars:
  • Our Bolder Advocacy program builds progressive power by providing nonprofit advocates with the training, technical assistance, and resources they need to comply with the federal and state laws associated with nonprofit advocacy. Bolder Advocacy is the nation’s leading resource for foundations and nonprofits who want to engage more actively and knowledgeably in the policymaking process.
  • AFJ Law deepens our support of nonprofits’ advocacy, strengthen the progressive movement’s ability to advocate within the bounds of IRS restrictions on tax-exempt organizations, and ensure compliance to keep their organizations safe. AFJ Law goes beyond providing technical assistance to providing legal advice on nonprofit clients’ activities.
  • Our Justice Program works to ensure that our state and federal courts protect our democracy and our core rights and values, preserve human rights, and provide access to justice for all. We research federal judicial nominees, educate the public and elected leaders about them, and advocate for demographically and professionally diverse nominees, who will protect our rights.
  • Our Outreach & Membership team deepens and expands the engagement of AFJ’s core constituencies, including supporting our member organizations with Bolder Advocacy, judicial nominations, and capacity building resources to advance their missions. We also educate and mobilize members, partners, and advocates with the tools and AFJ resources they need to advocate for courts that protect the rights of all us and defend nonprofits’ role in protecting our democracy.

AFJAction promotes a national conversation about the importance of the courts and other key AFJ issues through advocacy, research, and mobilizing progressive advocates and voters. It also serves as the leading expert on the legal framework for 501(c)(4) nonprofit advocacy efforts because we believe it will take all of us to defend our democracy.

Build templates of LOI, reports, and proposals for entire foundation relations portfolio; create first drafts for Senior Director, Foundation Relations as directed; provide proofing and formatting for final drafts priorto submission; and submit as requested.

Other:

Director, Advisory Services: Financial Transformation - Revenue Cycle

*General travel requirements between 25-75% largely dependent on client engagement

About the Practice

Premier's Financial Transformation Advisory Practice reimagines the entire patient financial journey, from intake to invoice, helping health systems achieve sustainable margin improvement through an integrated, enterprise-wide approach. Rather than pursuing isolated fixes, our team works end-to-end across three interconnected pillars that drive lasting financial performance: Revenue Cycle, Managed Care, and Clinical Integrity. Our consultants combine trusted advisory relationships with advanced analytics, automation, and AI to help clients reduce friction, uncover hidden opportunities, strengthen accountability, and improve financial performance across the enterprise.

What You'll Be Doing

The Director serves as a senior leader within Premier's Financial Transformation Revenue Cycle Practice and is responsible for driving client outcomes, developing executive relationships, growing the business, and developing consulting talent. The Director acts as a trusted advisor to healthcare executives, providing strategic guidance on enterprise revenue cycle transformation, operational improvement, technology optimization, and financial performance enhancement.

The Director is accountable for leading complex client engagements, cultivating executive-level relationships, driving business development activities, overseeing engagement teams, and contributing to the growth and evolution of Premier's Revenue Cycle Practice. This role provides executive oversight for projects of all sizes and durations and maintains accountability for engagement quality, financial performance, client satisfaction, and achievement of measurable client outcomes.

The Director serves as a trusted advisor to CFOs, Chief Revenue Officers, Chief Operating Officers, Chief Information Officers, and other executive leaders, helping clients develop and execute strategic plans that improve operational performance, strengthen financial outcomes, and create sustainable organizational change.

In addition to client delivery responsibilities, the Director plays a significant role in business development, practice development, thought leadership, and talent development activities. The Director mentors Managers, Senior Consultants and Consultants, contributes to the development of innovative solutions and methodologies, and helps drive growth across the Revenue Cycle service line. This position collaborates with and develops strong client relationships across all levels of healthcare organizations, including executive leadership, revenue cycle operations, finance, clinical leadership, and technology teams, to achieve transformational results.

Core Expectations

  • Maintain utilization targets for client billable projects.
  • Create value through executive-level client relationship management, solution development, and implementation leadership.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to healthcare executives.
  • Develop and mentor future consulting leaders while fostering a collaborative and high-performing team environment.
  • Drive business growth through active participation in sales pursuits, account expansion activities, and new client development.
  • Create value for the Revenue Cycle Practice through thought leadership, innovation, methodology development, and practice enhancement initiatives.
  • Contribute to Premier's market presence through industry engagement, speaking opportunities, publications, and client-facing thought leadership.

Role-Specific Expectations

Directors within the Revenue Cycle Practice possess extensive expertise across the end-to-end revenue cycle, including patient access, revenue integrity, charge capture, coding, clinical documentation improvement, denials management, billing operations, collections, reimbursement optimization, and revenue cycle technology.

Additional expectations include:

  • Serve as an executive advisor to healthcare leadership teams on revenue cycle strategy, transformation, benchmarking, operational excellence, and financial improvement opportunities.
  • Lead enterprise-wide revenue cycle transformation initiatives that improve financial performance, operational efficiency, and patient experience.
  • Drive development and implementation of revenue enhancement, cash acceleration, denial reduction, and cost optimization strategies.
  • Build and maintain strong executive relationships with client stakeholders, serving as a trusted and referenceable advisor.
  • Lead strategic discussions regarding operating model design, organizational structure, technology optimization, governance, and performance management.
  • Apply advanced analytics, benchmarking, automation, and industry best practices to identify and quantify improvement opportunities.
  • Develop and enhance revenue cycle solutions, methodologies, intellectual property, and market offerings.
  • Sponsor implementation efforts and support achievement of measurable client outcomes.
  • Lead executive steering committees and facilitate consensus among clinical, operational, financial, and technology stakeholders.
  • Champion innovation and adoption of emerging technologies, including automation, artificial intelligence, predictive analytics, and digital revenue cycle capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibility #1 – Client Delivery & Executive Leadership (50%)

  • Provide executive leadership and oversight for revenue cycle transformation engagements.
  • Serve as the primary executive relationship manager for assigned clients.
  • Lead executive-level discussions regarding organizational performance, strategic priorities, and transformation roadmaps.
  • Guide engagement teams in developing actionable recommendations and implementation plans that address client objectives.
  • Oversee complex operational, financial, technology, and performance analyses and ensure quality of engagement deliverables.
  • Facilitate executive steering committees, leadership workshops, and board-level presentations.
  • Manage engagement economics, profitability, scope, risk mitigation, and client satisfaction.
  • Ensure successful implementation and achievement of targeted financial and operational outcomes.
  • Sponsor large-scale transformation initiatives and support realization of sustainable improvement.
  • Identify opportunities for account growth and expanded client partnerships.
  • Direct and mentor Managers, Consultants, and Analysts assigned to engagements.
  • Serve as executive sponsor for key client relationships and strategic initiatives.

Responsibility #2 – Business Development & Account Growth (20%)

  • Develop, cultivate, and expand executive client relationships that generate additional revenue opportunities.
  • Lead sales pursuits, proposal development, statements of work, oral presentations, negotiations, and contracting activities.
  • Partner with practice leadership to achieve annual growth and revenue objectives.
  • Identify and qualify opportunities within existing and prospective client organizations.
  • Develop strategic account plans and expansion strategies for key client relationships.
  • Serve as an executive sponsor for strategic client accounts and growth initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Premier commercial and account management teams to identify and pursue market opportunities.
  • Actively generate new business through industry relationships, networking, conferences, and executive introductions.
  • Contribute to annual pipeline development, forecasting, and growth planning activities.
  • Support cross-selling opportunities across Premier service lines and solutions.

Responsibility #3 – Practice Development & Thought Leadership (15%)

  • Lead development and enhancement of revenue cycle methodologies, frameworks, intellectual property, and solution offerings.
  • Contribute to thought leadership activities, including conference presentations, webinars, publications, benchmark studies, and market-facing content.
  • Identify emerging healthcare and revenue cycle trends and translate those insights into innovative service offerings.
  • Collaborate with practice leadership to establish strategic priorities, market positioning, and service line growth plans.
  • Promote adoption of analytics, automation, AI, and technology-enabled solutions throughout client engagements.
  • Participate in strategic planning efforts supporting overall Advisory Services growth.
  • Help define and standardize leading practices for revenue cycle transformation engagements.
  • Collaborate with leadership to develop new offerings that address market demand and client needs.

Responsibility #4 – Talent Development & People Leadership (10%)

  • Mentor, coach, and develop Managers, Consultants, and Analysts across the practice.
  • Participate in recruiting, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, and retention activities.
  • Support succession planning and leadership development initiatives.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
  • Lead staffing and resource planning discussions across multiple engagements.
  • Provide ongoing performance coaching and career development guidance.
  • Identify high-potential talent and support advancement within the organization.
  • Promote employee engagement and professional development across the Revenue Cycle service line.

Responsibility #5 – Professional Development & Training (5%)

  • Complete all required training requirements annually.
  • Lead internal educational sessions and knowledge-sharing activities.
  • Support development of training materials and best practices within areas of expertise.
  • Stay current with industry trends, revenue cycle technologies, EMR platforms, regulatory developments, and emerging best practices.
  • Promote continuous learning and knowledge sharing throughout the Advisory Practice.

Preferred Qualifications

Skills

  • Ability to influence and advise C-suite and senior healthcare leaders.

  • Expertise in revenue cycle operations, performance improvement, and financial transformation.

  • Proven people leadership and talent development capabilities.

  • Track record of delivering measurable improvements in cash flow, denial reduction, revenue capture, productivity, and operating margins.

jobs.excerpt: About the Role We're looking for a Developer Content & Product Marketing Specialist to own how developers discover, understand, and fall in love with our API.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Developer Content & Product Marketing Specialist to own how developers discover, understand, and fall in love with our API. This is a hands-on, high-craft role for someone who's spent real time writing code, thinks like a developer, and has genuinely strong opinions about docs, DX, and content. You'll translate deep technical capability into positioning, messaging, and content that resonates with a sceptical, detail-oriented developer audience, and you'll do it with excellent writing and a sharp eye for UX.

This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, and marketing. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers to understand what we're building, and with the broader marketing team to turn that understanding into positioning, launches, and content that developers actually want to read.

What You'll Do

  • Own positioning and messaging for our API products, grounded in a real understanding of the technical capabilities and how developers evaluate them.

  • Plan and execute product launches and feature announcements, from technical narrative to go-to-market assets.

  • Write high-quality, developer-facing content: landing pages, launch posts, comparison pages, email sequences, in-product copy, and sales enablement materials.

  • Partner with product and engineering to develop deep product knowledge — you should be comfortable reading docs, testing the API yourself, and asking sharp technical questions.

  • Collaborate with the docs/DX team to improve the developer journey: onboarding flows, quickstarts, and the overall experience of evaluating and adopting the API.

  • Conduct win/loss analysis, customer interviews, and competitive research to sharpen messaging and inform roadmap conversations.

  • Define and track the metrics that matter for product marketing: activation, adoption, and content performance.

  • Act as the voice of the developer internally, and the voice of the product externally.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years in developer content, technical writing, developer marketing, product marketing, or a closely related role, ideally at a company selling to developers.

  • A technical or highly technical background. Prior experience as a developer, solutions engineer, technical writer, developer advocate, or similar is strongly preferred. You should be able to read code and hold your own in a technical conversation.

  • Exceptional writing skills. You can turn complex technical concepts into clear, compelling, jargon-free content — and you genuinely enjoy the craft of writing.

  • A strong sense of UX and content design: you think about how information is structured and consumed, not just what it says.

  • Native or near-native English fluency and excellent verbal communication skills.

  • A proactive, self-directed attitude. You spot opportunities, propose solutions, and move projects forward without needing detailed direction.

  • Comfort working independently with minimal supervision, while staying aligned with team goals and priorities.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, especially with engineering and product teams.
    Must be willing to work US hours with 6 hours overlap.

Nice to Have

  • Experience marketing APIs, developer tools, or infrastructure products.

  • A portfolio or writing samples that demonstrate technical storytelling (blog posts, docs, launch pages, etc.).

  • Familiarity with API documentation tools, developer portals, or SDKs.

  • Experience running developer community programs, hackathons, or technical events.

Why Join Us

  • Fully remote team with flexible working hours.

  • Meaningful ownership over how developers experience our product, from first impression to advocacy.

  • A collaborative culture that values craft, curiosity, and clear thinking.

  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

How to Apply

Send us your resume along with a short note on why this role interests you. If you have writing samples, such as blog posts, documentation, tutorials, launch content, or anything else that shows how you think and write, please include links. Code samples or GitHub projects are also welcome. We're especially interested in seeing how you explain technical concepts in plain language.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

The SOX Senior Manager, Business Processes will assume ownership of the business process side of Instacart's SOX compliance program, leading risk assessments, managing control testing, and resolving deficiencies across key financial and operational processes.

Reporting to SOX Compliance leadership, this role collaborates closely with accounting, finance, operations, IT, and external auditors, and serves as a trusted advisor to process owners across Revenue Operations, procurement, legal, and engineering to ensure controls are integrated into business processes and system workflows.

The team is committed to developing an effective control environment that supports transparency and accountability in financial reporting, and this role will provide the thought leadership on governance, process optimization, and risk transformation across finance and revenue systems needed to get there.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • The end-to-end SOX compliance program for business processes is owned and operated effectively, with control scoping, documentation, rationalization, and deficiency remediation completed in alignment with SOX 404 requirements and external auditor reliance strategies.
  • Risk assessments across high-risk processes including procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, inventory management, and revenue lifecycle (aligned with ASC 606) are completed, with ICFR controls designed, validated, and tested for operating effectiveness.
  • Control deficiencies are identified, evaluated, and remediated through close partnership with process owners across accounting, operations, procurement, and legal, with corrective actions defined and tracked to closure.
  • Cross-functional alignment is established across finance, accounting, RevOps, and engineering to embed controls into system and process workflows, with technology solutions identified to automate manual processes and improve control effectiveness.
  • SOX status updates, risk assessments, and remediation progress are consistently prepared and presented to the SOX Quarterly Steering Committee, Quarterly Audit Committee, Quarterly Disclosure Committee, and Quarterly External Audit Close Meetings.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA, CIA, or equivalent certification is highly preferred
  • 10 years of experience in SOX compliance, internal audit, or related fields, with a focus on business processes.
  • Strong understanding of SOX 404 requirements, COSO framework, and US GAAP.
  • Proven success in designing and testing controls for operational and financial processes, including procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, inventory management, and financial reporting; experience designing control frameworks within finance systems, beyond traditional audit.
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams and senior leadership.
  • Strong problem-solving and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Master's degree (MBA, Accounting, or a related field) is a plus.
  • Experience working in a publicly traded company or with a Big Four accounting firm.
  • Familiarity with ERP systems such as Oracle, SAP, Workday, etc., revenue/billing platforms (e.g., Salesforce CPQ/Billing, Stripe) including custom or internally built revenue systems, and experience supporting control audits for these systems.
  • Proven ability to evaluate and implement process improvements and automation solutions.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth, or complex organizational environment.
  • Strong experience in revenue accounting (ASC 606) within complex environments, including subscription, multi-element arrangements, and contra revenue accounting (e.g., customer incentives, promotional credits, coupons, and rebates).
  • Experience with advertising or media revenue models, including variable consideration, performance-based fees, and attribution complexity under ASC 606.
  • Experience with revenue-related M&A accounting, including purchase price allocations, deferred revenue haircuts, and post-acquisition revenue recognition harmonization.

Req ID:385092

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Strategic Pursuit Leader to join our Client Growth team. This role will primarily focus on large deals ($50M+). This role will work remotely from your home office located within the US with travel required as necessary.

Overview: The Pursuit Leader is a single threaded leader responsible for managing and orchestrating end-to-end strategic pursuit cycle. They create an account engagement plan and own its execution. During early stages, they will review the client-facing point of view, and compelling value propositions and provide feedback from a deal shaping perspective. They influence, orchestrate, and facilitate internal alignment to remove blockers and achieve desired business outcomes.

The Pursuit Leader will clearly understand the value drivers, value proposition, transformation angle, stakeholder map (including board relationships), competitive landscape, decision process and timeline, including clarity of the approval path. Based on this they create an actionable Pursuit Strategy / Win Strategy) that clearly articulates what we need to do to win, and continually refresh that as the pursuit progresses. They must continually develop and refine the understanding of “who amongst the client executives need to believe what, and what needs to be true for the client to do the deal with NTT DATA”. They continually leverage the value proposition to align the stakeholders to the value proposition and shape/create a deal. Lastly, from a key renewals perspective, this function will create a process for high value renewals - encompassing assessment, strategy, and execution, and will work with the Industry Leaders to roll it out.

  • Own the creation and execution of strategic pursuit engagement plans, collaborating with team members and across the company to ensure continued alignment and action.

Hearst Health is seeking a part-time Graduate Research Associate, Clinical Outcomes to help quantify and communicate the clinical impact of our software, data, and decision-support solutions.
This role is designed for a student pursuing an advanced degree in public health, health services research, epidemiology, biostatistics, health informatics, or a related field who wants to apply rigorous research methods to real-world healthcare questions.
The core question behind the role is straightforward but important: Do patients and healthcare organizations achieve better clinical outcomes when they use Hearst Health solutions?
Working with Hearst Health leadership and the Chief Medical Officers and clinical leaders across our businesses, the Graduate Research Associate will help turn that question into testable hypotheses, design appropriate analyses, evaluate real-world data, and develop credible evidence about the relationship between use of our solutions and clinical outcomes.

jobs.excerpt: “Katram cilvēkam, kas pievienojas mūsu kolektīvam jebkurā sākuma līmeņa amatā, ir iespēja sasniegt vadītāja amatu un kļūt par uzņēmuma partneri.
jobs.description:
“Katram cilvēkam, kas pievienojas mūsu kolektīvam jebkurā sākuma līmeņa amatā, ir iespēja sasniegt vadītāja amatu un kļūt par uzņēmuma partneri.”
Antons Sapriko, uzņēmuma dibinātājs
Kā kļūt par PR & Media Hacker scandiweb komandā?
Mēs esam ļoti atvērts uzņēmums, kurā strādā kolēģi no vairāk nekā 30 valstīm visos kontinentos. Mūsu e-komercijas speciālistu sieviešu īpatsvars ir viens no augstākajiem nozarē. Mēs aicinām pieteikties cilvēkus no visām sfērām, kuri var izpildīt testa uzdevumu.

Šis nav tradicionāls PR, kurā galvenais pienākums ir rakstīt un izplatīt preses relīzes, sūtīt vienu un to pašu piedāvājumu garam mediju sarakstam. Mēs meklējam cilvēku, kas prot piesaistīt uzmanību, meklējot iespējas, izaicinājumus, faktus, viedokļus un spēj pārvērst to par stāstu, ar kuru ir vērts dalīties.
Reizēm stāsts jau pastāv un tas tikai jāatklāj; reizēm tu palīdzēsi radīt reālu notikumu, salīdzinošu pētījumu, publisku izaicinājumu, eksperimentu, diskusiju, sadarbību vai kampaņu, kas medijiem dod iemeslu par to rakstīt.
Mums ir svarīga tava spēja sasniegt rezultātus, sākot ar testa uzdevumu, un jūsu entuziasms un atvērtība jaunu zināšanu un procesu apguvei. Nepārtraukta mācīšanās un atgriezeniskās saites ņemšana vērā ir vienas no mūsu galvenajām organizatoriskajām vērtībām.
scandiweb komunikācijas pamatvaloda ir angļu, kas mums nepieciešama brīvai saziņai gan ar klientiem no starptautiskā tirgus, gan kolēģiem no dažādām pasaules valstīm.

Kādi ir PR & Mediju hakera pienākumi?

Tavs galvenais pienākums būs radīt publisku uzmanību par scandiweb, mūsu iekšējām biznesa iniciatīvām, uzņēmuma attīstību un atsevišķiem klientu projektiem.

Kopā ar dibinātājiem un biznesa līderiem tu meklēsi un atklāsi stāstus, ko vērts dzirdēt plašākai pasaulei. Tev nebūs jāgaida norādes vai gatavi teksti – tu pats proaktīvi radīsi kampaņu rakursus, apkoposi faktus un nogādāsi stāstus tieši pareizajā auditorijā.
Tavi pienākumi būs sekojoši:
  • Rast PR iespējas iekš scandiweb – projektos, komandu diskusijās, produktu izstrādē, pētījumos, tehniskajos sasniegumos un tirgus izmaiņās;
  • Pārvērst sarežģītas vai šķietami ikdienišķas tēmas aizraujošos stāstos ar spēcīgu virsrakstu, intriģējošu rakursu un skaidru iemeslu, kāpēc auditorijai tas ir svarīgi;
  • Izstrādāt radošas PR kampaņas, kas piesaista uzmanību un veicina publisjas diskusijas;
  • Negaidīt, kad stāsts pats uzradīsies. Mēs sagaidām, ka tu radīsi ziņu vērtus notikumus pat, ja gatava stāsta vēl nav;
  • Pielāgot vienu un to pašu notikumu vairākiem medijiem, atbilstoši dažādām auditorijām;
  • Pētīt un atlasīt katram stāstam atbilstošos žurnālistus, raksta (newsletter) autorus, podkāsterus, satura veidotājus, analītiķus un nozares kopienas;
  • Sagatavot personalizētus piedāvājumus un sazināties par piedāvājumu e-pastā, sociālajos tīklos, zvanos, pasākumos un citiem kanāliem;
  • Veidot ilgtermiņa attiecības ar mediju profesionāļiem, izprotot viņu intereses un regulāri piedāvājot noderīgus, savlaicīgus un uzticamus stāstus;
  • Koordinēt intervijas, ekspertu komentārus, pamatojošos datus, vizuālos materiālus, demonstrācijas un sagatavot uzņēmuma pārstāvjus uzstāšanās reizēm;
  • Sadarboties ar satura, dizaina, video, datu un izstrādes komandām, lai izveidotu materiālus, kas nepieciešami stāsta pamatošanai un izplatīšanai;
  • Sekot līdzi publiskajām diskusijām – konkurentu aktivitātēm, nozares ziņām un tendencēm, lai pamanītu brīžus, kur scandiweb var pienest vērtību;
  • Ātri reaģēt uz negaidītām mediju iespējām un operatīvi iesaistīt nepieciešamos komandas biedrus;
  • Izmantot MI un pētniecības rīkus, lai sekotu medijiem, atrastu kopsakarības, identificētu kontaktus un uzlabotu saziņu, saglabājot personalizētu pieeju un izvairoties no automatizētām mēstulēm;
  • Mērīt kampaņu rezultātus, dokumentēt gūto pieredzi un nepārtraukti uzlabot nākamās kampaņas, balstoties uz mediju atsaucību un ietekmi uz biznesu.
Tavu sniegumu nemērīsim pēc sagatavoto preses relīžu skaita. Tavu panākumu atslēga būs nopelnītā mediju atspoguļojuma kvalitāte, kampaņu radītās sarunas, izveidotās attiecības, īstās auditorijas uzmanība un reāls atbalsts biznesa izaugsmei.

Ko mēs sagaidām no PR & Mediju hakera?

Mēs meklējam zinātkāru, neatlaidīgu un ļoti proaktīvu cilvēku, kurš meklē stāstu aiz notiekošā.

Tava iepriekšējā pieredze var būt PR, žurnālistikā, medijos, satura veidošanā, komunikācijā, radošajā stratēģijā, jaunuzņēmumu mārketingā vai citā saistītā jomā. Tradicionāla PR karjera var noderēt, tomēr tev jāspēj parādīt, ka tev ir izdevies piesaistīt uzmanību, nopelnīt mediju atspoguļojumu, izveidot auditoriju vai radīt publisku interesi par kādu ideju.

Šīs īpašības palīdzēs tev gūt panākumus šajā lomā:
  • Spēcīga izpratne par ziņu vērtību un spēja saprast, kāpēc par vienu stāstu raksta, bet citu ignorē;
  • Spēja atrast saistošu rakursu tehniskā, komerciālā vai citādi ikdienišķā informācijā;
  • Izcilas virsrakstu, piedāvājumu un īsformas tekstu rakstīšanas prasmes;
  • Pārliecinoša angļu valoda rakstiski un mutiski, jo strādāsi ar starptautiskiem medijiem un klientiem;
  • Spēja saprast tehniskas un biznesa tēmas un izskaidrot tās vienkāršā valodā;
  • Proaktīva attieksme un gatavība sazināties ar cilvēkiem tieši, nevis gaidīt, kad viņi ieinteresēsies paši;
  • Neatlaidība, kad piedāvājumi tiek ignorēti, atteikti vai prasa vairākus mēģinājumus, līdz saņemta atbilde;
  • Spēja strādāt ar nepilnīgu informāciju un veidot kampaņu, kamēr pamatā esošais projekts vēl attīstās;
  • Spēja vienlaikus pārvaldīt vairākus stāstus, iesaistītās puses un termiņus;
  • Pārliecinātība, komunicējot ar dibinātājiem, vadītājiem, tehniskajiem ekspertiem, klientiem, žurnālistiem un satura veidotājiem;
  • Zinātkāre par medijiem, biznesu, tehnoloģijām, e-komerciju, kultūru un iemesliem, kāpēc cilvēki dalās ar informāciju;
  • Praktiska izpratne par sociālajiem tīkliem, tiešsaistes kopienām, podkāstiem, jaunumu vēstkopām, satura veidotāju kanāliem un citiem mediju veidiem ārpus tradicionālajiem izdevumiem.
Esošas attiecības ar žurnālistiem, redaktoriem, satura veidotājiem vai nozares medijiem tiks uzskatītas par priekšrocību. Tomēr mēs vairāk vērtējam tavu spēju atrast un izveidot pareizās attiecības, nevis esošā kontaktu saraksta lielumu.
Pieredze e-komercijā vai tehnoloģijās arī tiks uzskatīta par priekšrocību, taču tā nav obligāta. Mēs palīdzēsim tev izprast mūsu nozari, projektus, pakalpojumus un tehnisko kontekstu.

Ko mēs piedāvājam?

  • Mēneša atalgojumu 3090-4740 EUR bruto, atkarībā no pieredzes un izpildes līmeņa;
  • Iespēju iegūt uzņēmuma akciju opcijas;
  • Atbalstu tehnikas uzlabošanai;
  • Veselības apdrošināšanas pamatsegumu un sporta bonusus;
  • Daudznacionālu ekspertu komandu, no kuras mācīties;
  • Leģendārus tiešsaistes un klātienes pasākumus, lai kopā svinētu panākumus.

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.
We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview

This is a foundational engineering role. You will own a critical domain of the platform on which Agiloft's CLM product is built as one of a small team of staff engineers who each own a core part of the platform and shape its direction together. This is a backend- and distributed-systems–weighted position with deep ownership of your domain and end-to-end accountability for its design, scalability, reliability, and security as the product and customer base grow.

You will work across the organization with engineering leaders, senior engineers, product leaders, and partner teams to understand where the product is going, translate business and product goals into durable platform architectures, and align diverse stakeholders on the technical direction. This means, you will set architectural direction alongside a peer group of staff engineers of your caliber. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines deep backend and cloud expertise with the influence to drive architecture across functional boundaries.

Job Responsibilities

    DATA MODEL & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE

  • Own the canonical data models and service boundaries in your domain
  • Design models and boundaries that let independent systems evolve in parallel without duplicating logic or creating competing implementations
  • Evolve the platform through additive, backward-compatible changes that introduce new capabilities without disrupting existing behavior.
  • Own the architecture of one or more critical platform domains, with responsibility for design integrity, scalability, reliability, security, and long-term technical health.

    • DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS & CLOUD ARCHITECTURE (AWS)

  • Design AWS-native, event-driven and asynchronous services that scale on demand, degrade gracefully under load, and remain cost-efficient as volume grows.
  • Architect the backend to enable and support AI/ML workloads at scale with a focus on performance, scalability and cost efficiency.
  • Act as architectural steward for these services, keeping them scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable as customer and platform demands grow.
  • Drive cloud-native design principles: stateless services, managed-service adoption, and failure-tolerant, self-healing architectures.

    • SECURITY & MULTI-TENANCY

  • Treat tenant isolation, authentication, and authorization as first-class design concerns across every service and API you own.
  • Design secure authentication and token-handling flows, permission-aware data access, and safe credential management for an enterprise, multi-tenant platform.
  • Design for correct, isolated behavior across tenant, environment, and data-residency boundaries, and reason explicitly about security posture and blast radius when centralizing sensitive capabilities.

    • TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL INFLUENCE

  • Partner with product- and engineering leaders to develop a deep understanding of customer and business needs and translate them into platform architectures that solve the problem
  • Lead the technical design of major platform initiatives end to end, and drive alignment across teams and functions whose priorities and incentives do not always converge.
  • Integrate diverse stakeholders and project teams around a shared technical direction, navigating differing functional interests with sound judgment and strong interpersonal skill.
  • Produce clear, rigorous design documents, service contracts, and acceptance criteria that others can review, build on, and trust, setting the standard for technical design on the team.
  • Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate and sharpen design and implementation, applying the judgment to know where they add leverage and where deeper thinking is required.
  • Lead by example in applying AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate architecture, design, implementation, and testing, using sound technical judgment to amplify productivity without compromising quality, maintainability, or depth of thinking.

    • API DESIGN

  • Design clean, versioned API contracts on top of the platform's data models — including high-scale bulk and asynchronous operations — with deterministic behavior, idempotency, structured error handling, and well-defined limits.
  • Establish contract tests and permission-enforcement validation as first-class parts of every API you design.

    • DELIVERY & ENGINEERING EXCELLENCE

  • Own initiatives end to end from design through release, with accountability for product quality in your domain and high standards for reliability, security, observability, performance, scalability, usability, and cost across the services you own
  • Champion modern practices: infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, continuous delivery, and observability-by-default
  • Lead platform-modernization and refactoring initiatives while maintaining delivery velocity and improve the developer experience for the services you own.
  • Identify and drive improvements to how the engineering organization designs and delivers
  • Contribute across the stack when an initiative calls for it, including UI layers on top of the platform services you build; backend remains the primary focus.

    • ORGANIZATIONAL IMPACT & MENTORSHIP

  • Serve as a technical multiplier unblocking teams, accelerating architectural decisions, and reducing long-term complexity.
  • Partner with CloudOps, Security, MLOps, and integration teams to define reliability targets, operational-readiness standards, and clean interfaces between domains.
  • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, raising the bar for data-model and systems design, security, and design-document quality.
  • Stay ahead of a fast-moving industry, particularly the rapid evolution of AI capabilities, and drive pragmatic adoption where it delivers clear business value.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's and/or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software or Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a comparable field.
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years at staff level.

jobs.description:
At Mitratech, we are a team of innovators focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in its diverse and inclusive work culture centered around great people practices, learning opportunities, and having fun! Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.

For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.

As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

About the AI Platform Organization

Mitratech’s AI mission is to turn its legal data and products into a unified, safe AI platform that powers the top legal workflows in every core solution and drives meaningful gains in legal team productivity and AI-influenced revenue.

The organization is designed using Team Topologies: stream-aligned product teams sit at the top, an AI Platform layer sits in the middle, and Cloud & Data Foundation sits below. This role sits at the foundation layer and builds the infrastructure and data capabilities the rest of the AI organization depends on.

About the Role

This role leads the Data & Cloud Platform function for the AI organization. It is accountable for the data and infrastructure foundation that makes higher-level AI platform capabilities and product experiences possible.

The role blends cloud platform engineering with strong data responsibilities: building a unified access layer across fragmented product data stores, shaping how shared agent memory and context systems should work, operatingthe cloud foundations underneath the AI platform, and helping execute the broader data strategy.

This is explicitly a hands-on leadership role. The team begins small — likely one to two direct reports — and you are expected to spend roughly half of your time writing and reviewing production code while the organization scales.

What You Will Do

  • Own the cloud and data foundation for the AI organization — shared runtime infrastructure, CI/CD patterns, and platform services used by AI teams
  • Design and build a unified data access layer for agents and AI features so they can interact with a coherent interface rather than bespoke storage and retrieval systems in each product
  • Define where shared AI data should live — agent memory, context stores, and shared service datasets — while partnering with product teams that have compliance or customer-specific reasons to retain specialized storage patterns
  • Build and operate data ingestion and transformation pipelines that support AI workloads and analytics, including ETL and lakehouse-style patterns where needed
  • Shape the technical execution of the organization’s data strategy, especially around scale, operability, cost, and long-term maintainability
  • Partner with the AI Quality & Governance team to support privacy-sensitive data handling, PII-aware workflows, and safe access patterns for observability, memory, and trace data
  • Provide platform patterns, reference architectures, and reusable services that help product teams migrate toward shared foundations instead of building fragmented point solutions
  • Hire, mentor, and grow the team over time — the function may later mature into separate data-platform and cloud-platform groups

What We Are Looking For

You have 8+ years of software engineering experience including meaningful experience leading engineers as a manager or technical lead. You have built and operated shared platform and data systems in production across multiple teams.

  • Strong experience with cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, developer platforms, or internal platform engineering
  • Hands-on experience building or operating shared data systems: ETL/ELT pipelines, internal data services, warehouse or lakehouse environments, or other multi-team data platforms
  • Experience designing platform APIs or integration layers that make complex infrastructure or fragmented systems easier for other teams to consume
  • Demonstrated exposure to production AI systems, especially where data architecture and infrastructure materially affect quality, reliability, latency, or cost
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous environments where the architecture is evolving and the right answer may be a combination of shared services, integration layers, and selective platform consolidation
  • A strong bias toward hands-on execution, systems thinking, and building scalable foundations that other teams can trust
  • Experience with agent memory, retrieval systems, semantic search, or data architectures optimized for LLM-powered applications and Snowflake

Nice to Have

  • Experience in multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud environments
  • Experience in legal technology, enterprise SaaS, or regulated environments where access controls, auditability, and customer-specific constraints shape technical design

The Stack Context

  • Engineering environment primarily uses Python and TypeScript
  • Platform operates across AWS and OCI
  • Currently leveraging FiveTran and DBT in our ETL to Snowflake
  • Data infrastructure investment is active — lakehouse / warehouse patterns and agent memory architecture are early-stage

Why This Role

This role sits at the foundation of Mitratech's AI engineering organization. You will design and build the data and cloud infrastructure that AI platform capabilities and product teams depend on — a unified data access layer, shared agent memory systems, and the cloud runtime underneath it all. You will work across the full AI organization, set the patterns other teams build on, and own a function with broad technical reach and long-term strategic importance.
