jobs.title: SAP Basis Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians! At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses, by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.
jobs.description:
Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians!

At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses, by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.

We serve over 10 million users and process more than USD 4 billion annually. We’ve been profitable since 2022 and operate our own credit business. We are an AI-first, 100% remote team, scaling in the rapidly changing Brazilian financial market.

Our goal? Deliver the best payment experience in Brazil for people and small businesses alike.

We value autonomy, ownership, and a bias for action. We’re looking for people who are curious, hands-on, and driven by impact, who want to solve real problems, work with strong teams, and rethink what’s possible.

If you’re ready to do your best work, at scale, with purpose, this is your place.


Responsibilities

Lead hands-on custom code activities for SAP S/4HANA release upgrades, including custom code impact analysis (ATC, Simplification Item checks, Custom Code Migration), SPDD/SPAU adjustments, remediation of obsolete or incompatible objects, cleanup of modifications and enhancements, technical regression support, cutover support, hypercare, and post-upgrade stabilization in coordination with the Basis and functional teams.

Assess the current custom code landscape, identifying unused or duplicated objects, modifications to SAP standard, undocumented developments, performance hotspots, security exposures in custom code, clean-core violations, integration dependencies, technical debt, partner dependencies, and opportunities for simplification, refactoring, or automation.

Help define the SAP development operating model, including coding standards, naming conventions, code review practices, ATC baseline and check variants, ABAP Unit expectations, technical specification templates, definition of done, transport discipline, release participation, partner handoffs, and audit evidence practices for changes.

Provide hands-on ABAP development for regulatory and fiscal changes impacting Brazil, including Reforma Tributária, SAP Notes implementation with manual steps and code adjustments, localization extensions (tax determination, NF-e, DRC / Document and Reporting Compliance, SPED and related obligations), technical impact analysis, and support to functional changes led by FI/CO, Tax, Product, and external partners.

Design, build, test, and maintain custom developments end to end on S/4HANA, including reports and programs, enhancements (BAdIs, enhancement spots, implicit enhancements), CDS views, AMDP, RAP-based services, OData services for Fiori applications, forms (Adobe Forms / Smart Forms), background jobs, data migration and correction programs, and interfaces (IDoc, RFC/BAPI, OData, REST via ABAP HTTP client, proxies).

Apply clean-core principles in daily development, favoring released APIs and extensibility options (in-app, developer, and side-by-side extensibility) over modifications, reducing the custom code footprint, and preparing the landscape for future upgrades and ABAP Cloud adoption where applicable.

Own custom code quality through ATC and Code Inspector, ABAP Unit tests, peer code review, and performance analysis (SQL Monitor, ST05, SAT, runtime analysis), ensuring HANA-optimized code (code pushdown, efficient data access) and durable, maintainable solutions.

Govern the technical side of change management through STMS and ChaRM / SAP Cloud ALM, ensuring traceability between requirements, technical specifications, transports, and test evidence, segregation of duties, emergency-change control, approval evidence, and safe promotion across DEV, QAS, and PRD.

Apply secure coding practices in partnership with Security and GRC stakeholders, including proper authorization checks in custom objects, Code Vulnerability Analyzer findings remediation, protection against SQL injection and directory traversal, secure handling of personal and sensitive data, logging and audit trail requirements, and evidence generation aligned with LGPD, BACEN, and SOX where applicable.

Develop and support the ABAP side of integrations, including SAP Integration Suite / CPI scenarios (proxies, OData and REST endpoints, IDoc and RFC interfaces), interface monitoring and error handling from the application perspective, certificate and connectivity troubleshooting together with Basis, and coordination with integration developers or external partners for iflow changes.

Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of complex application-level incidents, including short dumps (ST22), failed background jobs, interface and runtime failures, performance degradation in custom code, authorization-related blockers in custom programs, data inconsistencies, and upgrade defects, ensuring durable corrective actions and clear documentation.

Support functional teams and the Product Owner with technical feasibility assessments, effort estimates, technical specifications, debugging of SAP standard code, SAP Notes analysis and validation, and translation of business requirements into robust technical designs.

Act as the internal ABAP counterpart for implementation partners and AMS providers, reviewing and challenging technical designs, code quality, enhancement approach, SAP Notes strategy, transport sequencing, test evidence, security implications, documentation, and production-readiness criteria.

Establish technical acceptance criteria for partner deliveries, including technical specifications, code review results, ATC compliance, unit and regression test evidence, rollback plans, performance validation, operational documentation, and handover quality.

Create and maintain technical documentation, custom object inventories, technical specifications, developer guidelines, interface and job runbooks, known-error databases, and audit evidence repositories, ensuring readiness for internal, external, BACEN, LGPD, and SOX-related reviews.

Use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly for code generation, code review, test generation, ATC finding remediation, log and dump analysis, documentation, and knowledge base creation, ensuring all outputs are reviewed and validated before use in production or audit-relevant contexts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead hands-on technical activities for SAP S/4HANA release upgrades, including sandbox, development, quality, and pre-production cycles, SUM execution, SAP Notes lifecycle, technical regression support, cutover planning, hypercare, rollback readiness, and post-upgrade stabilization.
  • Assess the current SAP technical landscape, identifying platform risks, undocumented configurations, upgrade dependencies, monitoring gaps, security exposures, integration dependencies, technical debt, partner dependencies, and opportunities for automation or standardization.
  • Help define the SAP platform operating model, including support levels, escalation paths, incident ownership, monitoring standards, transport governance, release participation, environment strategy, documentation requirements, partner handoffs, and audit evidence practices.
  • Provide hands-on SAP platform support for regulatory and fiscal changes impacting Brazil, including Reforma Tributária, SAP Notes adoption, version baseline alignment, technical impact analysis, environment readiness, transport coordination, and support to functional changes led by FI/CO, Tax, Product, and external partners.
  • Operate and continuously improve the SAP S/4HANA landscape end to end, covering installations, support packages, kernel updates, system refreshes, client copies, job monitoring, interface monitoring, technical housekeeping, capacity reviews, and routine Basis activities.
  • Administer and govern SAP HANA operational practices, including HANA System Replication, backup and recovery, performance monitoring, query and memory analysis, capacity planning, patch coordination, and incident response.
  • Govern transport and change management activities through STMS and ChaRM / SAP Cloud ALM, ensuring traceability, segregation of duties, emergency-change control, approval evidence, release coordination, and safe promotion across DEV, QAS, and PRD.
  • Apply and support SAP platform security baselines in partnership with Security and GRC stakeholders, including technical user lifecycle, SSO, certificate management, audit logs, role transport controls, emergency access support, and evidence generation aligned with LGPD, BACEN, and SOX where applicable.
  • Operate SAP environments on cloud or managed SAP platforms, such as RISE with SAP and/or AWS depending on the actual landscape, supporting HA/DR routines, sizing reviews, performance baselines, backup validation, cost awareness, and vendor coordination.
  • Maintain and periodically validate backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery procedures, ensuring that recovery objectives are documented, tested, and aligned with business criticality.
  • Provide platform-level support for SAP Integration Suite / CPI, including tenant administration, connectivity, certificate management, Cloud Connector, monitoring, runtime troubleshooting, deployment support, and coordination with integration developers or external partners for iflow changes.
  • Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of complex SAP platform incidents, including performance degradation, job failures, transport issues, connectivity problems, interface/runtime failures, HANA alerts, authorization-related technical blockers, and upgrade defects, ensuring durable corrective actions and clear documentation.
  • Define and improve SAP platform observability, including job monitoring, interface monitoring, HANA health indicators, system availability, performance baselines, transport failure tracking, certificate expiration alerts, backup validation, and incident recurrence analysis.
  • Act as the internal SAP platform counterpart for implementation partners and AMS providers, reviewing and challenging technical plans, Basis activities, transports, cutover steps, SAP Notes approach, environment dependencies, security implications, documentation, and production-readiness criteria.
  • Establish technical acceptance criteria for partner deliveries, including implementation plans, transport sequencing, rollback plans, test evidence, monitoring impact, security considerations, operational documentation, and handover quality.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, landscape diagrams, runbooks, operational playbooks, known-error databases, cutover plans, recovery procedures, and audit evidence repositories, ensuring readiness for internal, external, BACEN, LGPD, and SOX-related reviews.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly for scripting, log analysis, runbook generation, documentation, knowledge base creation, and operational analysis, ensuring all outputs are reviewed and validated before use in production or audit-relevant contexts.

Requirements

  • Academic background in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent technical experience in SAP ABAP development.
  • Solid hands-on experience as an ABAP developer on productive SAP S/4HANA landscapes, including ABAP OO, enhancement framework (BAdIs, enhancement spots, implicit enhancements), CDS views, AMDP, RAP, OData services for Fiori, ABAP Unit, and ATC.
  • Experience with S/4HANA release upgrades and custom code adaptation, including ATC and Simplification Item checks, Custom Code Migration, SPDD/SPAU adjustments, remediation of obsolete objects, and HANA-optimized coding practices.
  • Experience working in environments where development standards, code governance, documentation, or internal capabilities were still being built is highly desirable.
  • Practical knowledge of clean-core principles and S/4HANA extensibility options (in-app, developer, and side-by-side extensibility), with exposure to ABAP Cloud / released APIs as a strong plus.
  • Hands-on experience with Brazilian localization on SAP, including FI/CO and tax-related developments, NF-e, DRC / Document and Reporting Compliance, SPED and related fiscal obligations, and implementation of SAP Notes with manual steps and code adjustments. Exposure to the Reforma Tributária transition is a strong plus.
  • Strong experience with SAP integration technologies from the ABAP side, including IDoc, RFC/BAPI, OData, REST via ABAP HTTP client, and proxies, plus working knowledge of SAP Integration Suite / CPI from a developer perspective. Groovy or JavaScript for CPI iflow development is a strong plus.
  • Experience with performance analysis and tuning of custom code, including SQL Monitor, ST05, SAT, runtime analysis, and code pushdown to SAP HANA.
  • Working knowledge of SAP security applied to custom code, including authorization objects and checks, Code Vulnerability Analyzer, secure coding practices, secure handling of personal data, and collaboration with Security/GRC teams on SoD-related controls.
  • Strong experience with SAP transport governance using ChaRM on Solution Manager 7.2 or SAP Cloud ALM, with familiarity with modern approaches such as gCTS, abapGit, and CI/CD applied to ABAP assets (abaplint, automated ABAP Unit execution).
  • Experience debugging SAP standard code and analyzing SAP Notes to support incident resolution, functional teams, and upgrade validation.
  • Experience producing technical evidence for audits, including technical specifications, code review records, test evidence, transport approvals, and change documentation.
  • Basis fundamentals expected for effective collaboration with the SAP Basis Specialist, including transport landscape, background job scheduling, system monitoring transactions, and reading of system logs. Scripting in Python or shell for developer automation is a plus.
  • Practical experience in regulated industries (fintech, banking, payments, retail, or e-commerce), with exposure to compliance frameworks such as BACEN, LGPD, or SOX.
  • Experience acting as the internal ABAP counterpart to implementation partners and AMS providers, with the ability to review and challenge technical designs, code quality, enhancement approach, SAP Notes strategy, test evidence, documentation, and production-readiness criteria.
  • Desirable: familiarity with SAP Fiori / UI5, SAP BTP (ABAP Environment, Build), BW/4HANA, and Adobe Forms.
  • Practical experience applying AI-assisted tools (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) to ABAP development and SAP operations.
  • SAP certifications in ABAP for SAP S/4HANA (Back-End Developer), ABAP Cloud / RAP, SAP NetWeaver ABAP, or SAP Integration Suite.
  • Fluent Portuguese and advanced Spanish and English required given LATAM operations.

Soft Skills

  • Strong hands-on execution discipline, with ownership over developments from specification to production and stabilization.
  • Clear communication with the Tech Lead SAP, the Product Owner, the SAP Basis Specialist, functional teams, Engineering, Security, and external partners, capable of translating business requirements into technical designs and technical decisions into clear documentation.
  • Ability to coordinate, review, and challenge external partners and AMS providers, ensuring code quality, traceability, production readiness, and knowledge transfer.
  • Pragmatic problem-solving, balancing speed, maintainability, performance, risk, and compliance.
  • High autonomy and bias for delivery, with strong documentation and audit-trail discipline.
  • Comfortable navigating regulated environments, fiscal deadlines, and high-pressure cutover windows.
  • Ability to mentor future junior ABAP developers, operations team members, or adjacent engineering teams as the Corporate Systems capability grows.
  • Risk awareness: deep understanding of operational, security, and compliance risks tied to custom code and integrations.
  • Pragmatic modernization mindset: balancing stability of legacy custom code, regulatory compliance, clean-core principles, extensibility, test automation, and integration reliability.
  • Proactivity in identifying improvement opportunities across code quality, performance, technical debt reduction, and developer productivity.

Industry-Specific Knowledge

It is highly desirable for the SAP Basis & Platform Specialist to have experience operating SAP technology in regulated, high-volume environments such as fintech, banking, payments, retail, or e-commerce. Strong candidates will understand how regulatory frameworks such as BACEN, LGPD, and SOX, as well as Brazilian fiscal complexity and recurring legal changes, impact SAP platform operations, release planning, transport governance, audit evidence, security controls, integration reliability, and production readiness. Current examples in the portfolio include SAP S/4HANA release upgrades and the Brazilian Tax Reform transition, with similar regulatory initiatives expected over time.

Benefits

  • Competitive and market-aligned salary.
  • Remote work — wherever you are, you’re part of the team!
  • Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app.
  • Health and dental plans with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Flexible meal allowance (via Flash).
  • TotalPass membership to take care of your health.

Diversity & Inclusion at RecargaPay

At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. Here, everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

About the use of your Data

By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. You can request the update or deletion of your information at any time, in accordance with LGPD (General Data Protection Law).

Industry-Specific Knowledge

It is desirable to have practical familiarity with one or more core financial domains such as lending, payments, credit cards, open finance, fraud prevention, merchant acquiring, or investment services, along with an understanding of their fundamental workflows and business drivers. Experience in how these domains intersect to influence revenue, risk management, and customer satisfaction is highly valued.

Ideally, candidates will have applied this knowledge to deliver solutions such as loan-origination engines with real-time decisioning; scalable payment-processing platforms integrated with core banking systems and third-party gateways; secure open-finance interfaces compliant with industry regulations; automated fraud-detection pipelines leveraging behavioral analytics; or financial reporting and reconciliation engines for regulatory compliance. The ability to translate complex compliance mandates (e.g., KYC/AML, PCI-DSS, GDPR) into resilient, high-performance systems without compromising user experience is considered a strong asset.

jobs.description:
Launch Manager – AIAre you highly organized, proactive, and energized by bringing people together to deliver a shared goal? Do you thrive on turning a complex, multi-team effort into a clear plan and driving it to a successful outcome? If so, Intermedia’s Data & AI Product Management team is seeking a Launch Manager to own the go-to-market launch of our next generation of AI products – one of the most visible and cross-functional roles on the team.
This role sits at the center of how Intermedia brings its AI products to market. You will coordinate launches end to end, align stakeholders across the business, and work directly with senior leadership to keep them informed and confident that each launch is on track. It is an exceptional opportunity for someone who wants to build a broad understanding of the business and develop real visibility with our leaders.
About Intermedia
Intermedia is a leading provider of cloud-based communication and collaboration solutions, empowering over 140,000 businesses and 7,500 partners with UCaaS, CCaaS, and productivity tools. We’re committed to delivering secure, easy-to-use solutions, backed by industry-leading reliability and support. Our AI & Data team is at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the wealth of communication data generated across our platforms to develop intelligent tools and insights that drive customer success. We believe in a collaborative, hands-on approach where every team member contributes their unique skills to create products that truly make a difference. We are a roll-up-your-sleeves-and-get-into-the-details product management team where, irrespective of your position, you can contribute your skills and energies to help improve our products.
About the Role
As Launch Manager, you will own the planning and coordination of AI product launches across our AI groups. You will build and maintain the launch plans – the timelines, owners, and lead times that define what needs to happen, who is responsible, and by when – and keep a large and varied set of stakeholders aligned and on track. You will develop a strong working understanding of the products so you can give clear, well-structured direction, and you will keep senior leadership informed on launch status, risks, and dates.
This is a highly cross-functional role in which your impact comes through communication, organization, and consistent follow-through. You will be proactive in keeping commitments on track, following up with stakeholders diplomatically and in a way that strengthens working relationships.
What this role is not: this is not an engineering project management role. You will not be coordinating engineering teams against a development plan or managing inter-team technical dependencies and delivery timelines. Your focus is the launch and the stakeholders around it – ensuring the business is ready, aligned, and set up for a successful release.

What success looks like in your first 6 months
  • You know the landscape. You understand our AI products well enough to explain them to any audience, and you know who owns what across marketing, sales, support, training, solution architects, and docs.
  • The launch calendar is yours. There’s a single, up-to-date view of what’s launching when — with owners, dependencies, and lead times — and people rely on it.
  • You’ve run a launch. You’ve coordinated at least one launch end-to-end, keeping every workstream aligned and on schedule through to a clean release.
  • A cadence is in place. A regular check-in and communication rhythm exists, so stakeholders always know what they need to do and by when.
  • Leadership trusts your read. You give execs a concise, accurate picture of launch status and risks — and they come to you for it.
Working with Senior LeadershipLaunch readiness is a topic our executives care about, and you will be their trusted point of contact for it. You will report launch status directly to senior leadership, present timelines and readiness in leadership forums, and give our executives the clear, concise picture they need to make decisions. This is a rare opportunity early in a career to work alongside leaders across the company, build genuine relationships with the executive team, and be recognized as the person who makes launches happen – visibility that can open significant doors for your future at Intermedia.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and maintain launch plans for AI products – project plans and spreadsheets capturing timelines, owners, dependencies, and required lead times for each task.
  • Map the stakeholders involved in each launch and run a clear communication cadence so everyone knows what they need to do and by when.
  • Track go-to-market readiness across the business – marketing, sales, support, training, solution architects, documentation, and more – and keep it all moving toward the launch date.
  • Provide clear, well-organized direction to stakeholders and follow up proactively and diplomatically to keep commitments on track.
  • Report launch status, risks, and delivery dates to senior leadership, and present readiness in leadership forums.
  • Coordinate usability testing and customer feedback sessions by connecting product teams with customers, solution architects, and other stakeholders, and organizing the logistics.
  • Run launch checklists, go/no-go reviews, and post-launch retrospectives to continuously improve how we launch.
  • Build a strong working understanding of the products so you can communicate credibly with any audience, from engineers to executives.
Requirements
  • Enough familiarity with AI products to explain them credibly to any audience; deep technical or model-building knowledge is not required.
  • 1–2 years of experience in a role that rewards strong organization and coordination – for example project or program coordination, product ownership, business operations, launch or event management, an internship, or a similar cross-functional role. We’re open to high-potential candidates early in their careers.
  • A track record of keeping multiple workstreams, owners, and deadlines on track at once, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to tailor a message to any audience, from individual contributors to senior executives.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and a collaborative, outgoing style; you build trust quickly and enjoy working across teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting mindset – you take ownership, anticipate what is needed, and follow through without being asked.
  • Confidence and professionalism when engaging and presenting to senior stakeholders.
  • Comfort working with globally distributed teams, with strong asynchronous communication skills.
  • Upper-intermediate or higher English proficiency.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
Would Be a Plus
  • Exposure to go-to-market, product marketing, or launch/event coordination (including internships or university projects).
  • Experience with planning and collaboration tools (e.g. Smartsheet, Jira, Asana, Monday).
  • Familiarity with UCaaS/CCaaS or other SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with modern AI concepts or products.
Why Join Us
This is a high-visibility role at the heart of how Intermedia brings its AI products to market. You will work with colleagues in nearly every part of the company and partner directly with senior leadership, building relationships and credibility with our executive team. It is a genuine springboard: you will gain a broad understanding of how the business fits together, develop a wide internal network, and make a visible, measurable impact on the success of every launch. If you are organized, proactive, and motivated by delivering results through people, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Description:

Risk Supervisor Job Description

About the Role

Constellation Payments is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Risk Supervisor to lead the day-to-day operations of the Risk team, including merchant risk monitoring, transaction review, bank account change controls, and ongoing portfolio risk oversight. This role is responsible for overseeing the identification, investigation, escalation, and mitigation of emerging fraud, compliance, transaction, chargeback, ACH, NACHA, website, MCC, and merchant behavior risks across both new and existing merchants.

The ideal candidate is a strong people leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities, workloads, risk trends, and business needs continuously evolve. They are comfortable balancing operational oversight, team development, escalated case management, and strategic risk initiatives while ensuring service levels, quality standards, and risk controls are consistently maintained.

The Risk Supervisor will work closely with Risk leadership, Underwriting, Onboarding, Merchant Support, Finance, Compliance, Product, and external partners to ensure risk items are appropriately reviewed, documented, escalated, and resolved in a timely and consistent manner. This role plays a critical part in strengthening post-boarding controls, protecting the merchant portfolio, supporting regulatory compliance, and driving continuous improvement across risk operations.

This position offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a growing organization by leading risk operations, developing team capabilities, enhancing monitoring frameworks, improving operational controls, and supporting strategic business initiatives.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and oversee the daily activities of the Risk team, ensuring risk queues, investigations, alerts, reviews, and escalations are completed accurately and within established service levels.
  • Supervise merchant risk monitoring activities related to fraud, compliance, reputational, operational, ACH, chargeback, and transaction-related risks.
  • Review and approve escalated investigations involving held transactions, large ticket activity, excessive refunds, duplicate transactions, excessive authorizations, excessive declines, ACH returns, suspicious merchant behavior, and emerging risk trends.
  • Manage team workload, priorities, queue assignments, and resource allocation to ensure timely completion of all risk reviews and investigations.
  • Conduct regular quality assurance reviews of risk cases, documentation, merchant outreach, escalations, workflows, and monitoring activities.
  • Provide coaching, mentoring, training, and performance feedback to Risk Analysts while supporting career development and skill growth.

Thriveworks is currently seeking Licensed Clinicians to provide telehealth sessions in Maine.

About the job

Thriveworks is a mental health care company founded by clinicians in 2008 and still led by them today. With 340+ locations and a nationwide hybrid care model, we serve over 175,000 clients annually through more than 1.7 million sessions, and we're growing. In addition to working directly with clients, we partner with health systems and primary care providers because we believe mental health is inseparable from physical health. As a clinician-led organization, we're built to support the people who do this work with the tools, community, and stability you need to build a career that lasts.

About the Role

We’re hiring licensed clinicians to provide compassionate, evidence-based care to our more than 175,000 clients across the country. You may be a good fit for this role if you’re:

  • Independently licensed and living in Maine — LCPC, LMFT, LCSW or Licensed Psychologist

  • Consistently available to clients for a minimum of 25 sessions with 30 hours of availability weekly

  • A behavioral health generalist who is open to treating a variety of clients, including couples and children

  • Invested in helping your clients achieve measurable progress

  • Confident working with modern clinical technology, including telehealth and EHR tools

  • A good teammate — we’re building a clinical community and value positive contributors

Compensation

Up to $112,200.00 based on licensure type, session volume, and bonus opportunities. Full-time clinicians are eligible for health insurance, student loan repayment assistance, paid time off, and other employer-sponsored benefits.

How We Support You

We handle the administrative work so you can focus on what you do best: providing exceptional care. That means credentialing, billing, scheduling, and marketing support taken care of for you, plus paid orientation and training to get you started. You'll build a full caseload within 90 days of credentialing, with flexible scheduling available seven days a week from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. ET.

Benefits

As a W2 employee, you'll be eligible to receive:

  • Guaranteed bi-weekly pay for completed sessions

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k) with employer matching

  • Paid time off

  • Short- and long-term disability insurance

  • Company-paid life and AD&D insurance

  • CEU reimbursement and free in-house training

  • Student loan repayment assistance

  • Opportunities for paid clinical supervisor roles in select states

Our Community

Being a clinician can feel isolating, especially in a telehealth world. We're built to make sure it doesn't. You'll have access to live clinical support, monthly case consultations, and a vibrant online and in-person community of more than 2,700 licensed providers. All clinical leadership is promoted from within, so the people supporting you have been exactly where you are.

Ready to Join Us?
Apply today to become part of a team that’s changing mental health care for clients and clinicians alike.


Interested in joining Team Thriveworks? We're thrilled to meet you!


With Job scams becoming more and more frequent, here's how to know you're speaking with a real member of our team:

If you see a scam related to Thriveworks, please report it to . You can contact with any questions or concerns.

jobs.description:
The Sales Development Representative (SDR) is the process-driven engine of our lead generation machine — and the right person for this role knows exactly what that means. If you've built your early career inside a large, structured organization and you're ready to take everything you've learned and actually own something, this is your next move.

As Bridgeway's first SDR, you won't be just inheriting a lead gen playbook — you'll be part of taking it to the next level. You'll bring the discipline you've honed in structured environments and apply it where it matters most: establishing a repeatable lead generation process, executing a defined script on every outbound interaction, and capturing clean, complete data in the CRM after each touch. There's no ambiguity here — just clarity, consistency, and the satisfaction of knowing your output directly fuels the entire revenue pipeline. This is a rare early-career opportunity to be the person who built the function, not just worked in it.

This is a remote position with minimal overnight travel. East coast candidates preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation & Outreach

  • Execute the full defined lead generation process: list pull → research → call → email follow-up → CRM log, for every prospect in the assigned territory.
  • Make 60–80 outbound calls per day following the approved call script; conduct multi-touch cadences (call + email + LinkedIn) on all priority accounts.
  • Qualify inbound leads generated by marketing using the standard qualification script and route sales-ready opportunities to the assigned Account Executive within 24 hours.
  • Research target accounts and contacts to personalize the script's open and pain-point sections without deviating from qualification structure.

Script Adherence & Quality

  • Follow Bridgeway’s lead gen call script verbatim for all required fields; use approved rebuttals for common objections.
  • Participate in weekly call review sessions — calls are recorded and scored against the script rubric by sales leadership.
  • Complete script certification for any new script version within 5 business days of release before using it in the field.

Data Integrity & CRM

  • Log every call outcome, contact field, and disposition in HubSpot immediately after each interaction — no end-of-day batching.
  • Maintain 95%+ CRM field completion rate as audited weekly by Sales Ops; resolve flagged records within 48 hours.
  • Surface data anomalies (duplicate contacts, wrong industry codes, stale phone numbers) to Sales Ops using the defined data quality process.
  • Contribute to weekly pipeline data reviews by ensuring assigned segment's contact and activity data is accurate and current.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Collaborate with Account Executives on account prioritization and handoff quality; participate in weekly AE-SDR syncs.
  • Share script objection patterns and market intelligence with the team in the shared feedback log after each calling block.
  • Meet and exceed monthly quotas for qualified meetings booked and sales-qualified opportunities (SQOs) created.

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in a sales, business development, or high-volume customer-facing role (SDR/BDR experience strongly preferred)
  • Comfortable being first, operate without peer SDRs to benchmark against, contribute to setting the standard and discipline
  • Demonstrated ability to follow a structured process consistently, where scripts are not viewed as a constraint, but rather as a competitive advantage
  • Excellent verbal communication skills with the ability to follow a script naturally and handle objections using approved rebuttals without sounding robotic
  • Strong CRM discipline — experience logging calls, contacts, and dispositions in a CRM in real time
  • Comfort with high call volume and the ability to sustain energy and script adherence through a full calling block
  • Constructive feedback orientation and ability to articulate what is and is not working in a process and translate that into concrete suggestions
  • Detail-oriented to catch and recover from errors
  • Familiarity with sales engagement platforms (Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo) and call recording tools (Gong, Chorus) is strongly preferred

jobs.description:
Bulletproof is seeking an experienced DTC Ecommerce Growth Lead for a three-month, full-time contractor engagement to provide interim leadership of Bulletproof.com while the current DTC leader is on leave.

This person will be responsible for maintaining business continuity, owning DTC performance, directing agency and internal execution, and identifying near-term growth opportunities across acquisition, retention, subscription, site conversion, merchandising and innovation.

This is not primarily a hands-on production role. The contractor will set priorities, make commercial decisions, challenge assumptions, connect execution to business economics, and hold partners accountable for results.

In summary, this is a three-month, full-time interim leadership assignment with real business ownership. The successful contractor will step into an established DTC business, lead performance and forecasting, oversee a specialized DTC agency, guide paid acquisition across Google and Meta, supervise an experienced ecommerce operator, and help identify the next sources of profitable growth. The expectation is to quickly understand the economics of the business, focus the organization on the few things that matter most, and leave behind a stronger operating system and roadmap than the one inherited.

Additional Information:

  • Hourly contract rate: $50-$75/hour
  • Weekly hours: 30-40 hours per week, planned to start ASAP.
  • This is a fully remote contract role; candidates can be located anywhere within the United States.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Protect business continuity: Ensure forecasting, promotions, launches, site operations, retention programs, paid media and reporting continue without disruption.
  • Own DTC business performance: Maintain clear visibility to revenue, margin, traffic, conversion, AOV, subscriptions, retention and acquisition performance, and proactively identify gaps versus forecast.
  • Lead and hold the contracted agency accountable: Translate Bulletproof priorities into clear agency direction, manage scope and SLAs, prioritize work, challenge recommendations and ensure execution drives measurable business impact.
  • Accelerate the path back to growth: Identify and validate the highest-value revenue opportunities across acquisition, retention, subscription, merchandising, CRO, product prioritization and innovation.
  • Leave the business stronger: Provide documented learnings, decisions, outstanding risks and a prioritized forward roadmap for the returning DTC leader.
  • Weekly S&OE
    • Maintain and update the weekly DTC revenue outlook and item-level forecast.
    • Review actual performance versus forecast and identify risks and opportunities early enough to act.
    • Forecast expected performance by core product/category, promotional period, subscription revenue, paid acquisition contribution and major innovation launches.
    • Incorporate current traffic, conversion, AOV, inventory and media trends into the forecast.
    • Partner with Operations to understand inventory constraints, OOS risks and product availability.
    • Recommend interventions when weekly run rate falls behind expectation.
  • Monthly S&OP / Rolling Forecast
    • Own item-level DTC forecasting, including base business, promotions, subscriptions, innovation and seasonality.
    • Maintain and improve the rolling 12-month forecast rather than rebuilding it unnecessarily during the engagement.
    • Translate changes in demand into inventory, media and commercial actions through monthly S&OP.
    • Document assumptions, upside/downside scenarios, major risks and opportunities.
  • Monthly Business Performance Review
    • Own preparation of the DTC Monthly Business Review and ensure it explains business performance rather than simply reporting activity.
    • Cover revenue vs. plan/LE/prior year; contribution margin; traffic; CVR; AOV; new vs. returning mix; paid acquisition and CAC; subscription adds, active base and churn; repeat purchase; product/category performance; innovation; promotional effectiveness; CRO and creative learnings.
    • Provide a clear executive “So What?” with recommended actions and decisions.
  • Agency Leadership
    • Serve as the primary internal business owner for the agency across retention, CRO, website support, and AIO.
    • Translate business priorities into clear agency briefs and maintain a prioritized roadmap across workstreams.
    • Hold the agency accountable to scope, SLAs, quality standards and agreed business outcomes.
    • Lead business reviews and challenge recommendations that do not align with margin, LTV, inventory, brand strategy or product priorities.
    • Ensure tests generate useful learning and quantified business impact, not activity for activity’s sake.
    • Escalate performance, quality or timing issues appropriately and ensure learnings/documentation remain inside Bulletproof.
  • Paid Media Leadership – Google & Meta
    • Oversee Google and Meta strategy, budget allocation and performance with sufficient technical depth to challenge agencies and operators.
    • Review spend, CAC/nCAC, ROAS, NTB, conversion, revenue and contribution margin through a business-economics lens, not ROAS alone.
    • Evaluate product-level paid media economics and determine which products merit acquisition investment based on margin, conversion, repeat behavior, subscription potential and LTV.
    • Connect acquisition investment to downstream customer quality and retention.
    • Ensure creative testing is concentrated behind strategically prioritized products rather than spread thinly across the portfolio.
  • Retention, CRM & Subscription Strategy
    • Advance the shift from promo-first CRM toward segmented, value-driven lifecycle marketing.
    • Prioritize customer segments based on product affinity, purchase behavior, subscriber status, engagement, LTV and promotion dependency.
    • Monitor whether retention strategy is improving repeat purchase, time to second order, subscription conversion, early subscriber retention and revenue per recipient/customer.

jobs.title: Request for Proposals: Digital Strategy
jobs.excerpt: Request for Proposals: Digital StrategyOur Story: MOBILIZE, ORGANIZE, VOTE AND EMPOWER MOVE Texas is a nonpartisan, nonprofit, grassroots organization working to build power in underrepresented youth communities through civic engagement, leadership development, and issue advocacy.
jobs.description:
Request for Proposals: Digital Strategy

Our Story: MOBILIZE, ORGANIZE, VOTE AND EMPOWER
MOVE Texas is a nonpartisan, nonprofit, grassroots organization working to build power in underrepresented youth communities through civic engagement, leadership development, and issue advocacy. In 2013, MOVE was founded by a small group of dedicated students at the University of Texas at San Antonio to increase participation in local elections. Since then our work has gone statewide to become one of the most effective voter registration and engagement groups in the state. MOVE Texas has helped transform the Texas electorate over the past decade and continues to bring new voters into the electorate. We don’t just register voters, we invest in communities of young people that are traditionally underserved and underinvested in – especially young people of color and meeting them where they are at on local college campuses. We are building the next generation of Texas leadership by teaching critical organizing skills to take them from voters to effective, lifelong organizers. Our theory of change is simple: develop new leaders, educate voters and create space for the changes we need to make so that our state can be a place where all Texans can thrive. We believe that together we are transforming democracy in Texas and beyond.

Why Now

We're seeking a digital strategy partner to help us build and execute a robust digital plan through the 2026 election, set clear goals against that plan, and strengthen our internal Communications team's capacity to lead this work independently over time. This engagement supports a broader investment in our Communications function as we head into a critical election cycle, and builds on insights from our 2025 Bold at the Ballot Box narrative work and Your Texas, Your Say survey to keep our digital presence aligned with our base.

Our Digital Challenges

The firm must solve four primary challenges to ensure our digital strategy meets the moment and sets our team up to sustain it:

  1. Build a Digital Plan With Clear Goals Through the Election Our current digital work has been driven more by day-to-day execution than by a defined strategy tied to measurable goals. The firm is challenged to build a digital plan spanning owned, earned, and paid channels that is explicitly sequenced against 2026 election milestones, with concrete goals our team can be held to and can track progress against.
  2. Elevate Paid & Earned Media Beyond a Reactive Posture Traditional and paid media have largely been pursued reactively rather than as a proactive strategy. The firm is challenged to help us build sustained paid media capacity for younger-audience and electoral engagement goals, and support a more proactive approach to earned media and press opportunities, including building a proactive media strategy heading into the 2027 legislative session, so we're positioned to shape coverage of our legislative and advocacy priorities rather than reacting to it after the fact.
  3. Build Internal Capacity We are not looking for a firm to execute digital strategy on our behalf indefinitely. The firm is challenged to work alongside our Senior Communications Manager and Digital Communications Associate throughout the engagement, through training, shared strategy sessions, and documentation, so that our internal team can increasingly own and lead this work after the engagement ends.
  4. Integrate Digital Strategy With Our Narrative and Cultural Organizing Work Our digital presence doesn't operate in isolation; it's informed by ongoing narrative testing and by the cultural organizing work that tells us what resonates with our base. The firm is challenged to build a digital strategy that can absorb and act on that insight, rather than operating as a separate execution track.

Scope of Work

  • Develop a digital strategy and plan that defines:
    • Channel strategy across owned, earned, and paid media through the 2026 election and early 2027 legislative planning
    • Goals and KPIs tied to organizational priorities (voter engagement, base growth, campaign visibility)
    • A measurement framework and reporting cadence the team can sustain after the engagement
  • Support paid and earned media strategy and execution, including:
    • Budget allocation guidance across platforms
    • Testing and optimization support throughout the cycle
    • Strategy specifically aimed at younger-audience and electoral engagement goals
    • Proactive earned/traditional media strategy heading into the 2027 legislative session, including planning tied to legislative priorities
  • Establish a professional development plan for the internal Communications team, including:
    • Structured training in owned, earned, and paid media strategy, platform best practices, and digital analytics
    • Working sessions where internal staff are active participants, not just recipients of finished deliverables
    • Documentation, playbooks, or frameworks the team can reuse independently going forward

Deliverables

  • Digital Strategy & Plan
    • Channel-specific strategy through the 2026 election and early 2027 legislative planning
    • Defined goals/KPIs and measurement framework
    • Recommended reporting cadence and structure
  • Paid and Earned Media Support
    • Budget allocation guidance
    • Testing/optimization approach and check-ins across the engagement
    • Proactive earned/traditional media strategy for the 2027 legislative session
  • Professional Development
    • Package Training sessions/materials for internal staff (cadence to be proposed by firm)
    • End-of-engagement capacity assessment and handoff documentation
  • Milestones & Deadlines
    • Onboarding: Early October
    • October: Execute paid and earned media support tied to GOTV, EP, and electoral engagement goals
    • November-December: Conduct in-depth professional development training with Communications team
    • Early November: Deliver post-election engagement analysis
    • Mid-Late November- Early December: Support development of communications/digital plan for 2027 legislative session

Our Digital Evolution

While this engagement is centered on digital strategy, MOVE's digital presence is inseparable from the narrative and cultural organizing work that grounds it. Our content and strategy need to reflect the same base our cultural organizing and communications team already serves — multiracial, working-class young Texans ages 18 to 35 — and should be built to integrate with, not run parallel to, our existing narrative testing infrastructure.

The overarching aesthetic and tone our base responds to:

  • Culturally Texas, multiracial, and working-class
  • Bold and defiant, reflecting a generation that refuses to accept the status quo
  • Warm toward its people, yet fiercely confrontational toward power
  • Urgent and action-oriented, driven by a sense of power and a vision for a brighter future rather than desperation

Our Ideal Candidate:

  • Has established experience with movement organizations, campaigns, or nonprofits, not solely corporate/commercial clients
  • Has a demonstrated track record of building internal client capacity, not just executing on a firm's own behalf
  • Understands paid, owned, and earned digital strategy across a full election cycle
  • Can work collaboratively with an internal team already producing narrative and cultural content, integrating with that work rather than replacing it
  • Is able to translate strategy into training and documentation that a small internal team can sustain

Budget:

MOVE Texas has budgeted $20k for this contract

Submission Deadline: 5pm on September 28th

Process:

Submit a proposal that includes the following:

  1. A background of your firm
  2. Examples of similar digital strategy engagements you've completed, particularly with nonprofit, movement, or electoral clients
  3. Why you believe you are the best partner for this project and what makes you different from your competitors
  4. An overview of your approach to strategy development and to building internal team capacity specifically
  5. Proposed team and their roles
  6. Pricing structure and estimated cost

Timeline:

  • Applications Accepted: Friday, September 11th - Friday, September 25th
  • Determination & Notification: Week of September 28th
  • Contract Start Date: October 1st
  • Contract End Date: December 10th

People Operations,

jobs.title: Operations & Logistics Lead
jobs.excerpt: Real opportunities.  Real impact.  Your career, redefined.
jobs.description:
Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we help the best and brightest of Sri Lanka to take advantage of opportunities that otherwise wouldn’t be available to them, while supporting entrepreneurs around the world. Our community (we call them Divers) don’t do surface work—they go deep to solve complex challenges and make a real impact. And in doing so, they support bold ideas, expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers, all without having to leave family and friends.

As an Operations & Logistics Lead, you will play a critical role in building and managing the operational backbone of a growing distribution operation. You'll take ownership of day-to-day logistics while also designing the processes and systems required to make the operation more reliable, efficient, and scalable.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong logistics and supply-chain experience with analytical thinking and a builder's mindset. You'll need to be comfortable working through operational details, solving problems as they arise, managing external partners, and building repeatable processes in an environment where the operating playbook is still being developed.

Accountability

Your success as the Operations & Logistics Lead will be defined by your ability to build reliable logistics operations while continuously improving the systems and processes behind them.

Here's how you'll make an impact:

Logistics & Distribution Ownership

  • Own day-to-day logistics and distribution operations.
  • Coordinate the movement of products from production partners through fulfillment and final delivery.
  • Ensure deliveries are completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Maintain visibility across active routes, orders, delivery performance, and exceptions.
  • Troubleshoot delivery failures and operational bottlenecks.
  • Coordinate with carriers, vendors, production partners, fulfillment partners, and 3PLs.
  • Build reliable operating routines around recurring distribution activity.
  • Ensure issues are followed through to resolution rather than simply escalated.

Route Planning & Optimization

  • Design and continuously improve delivery routes.
  • Analyze route density, delivery windows, mileage, capacity, and costs.
  • Identify inefficient or underperforming routes.
  • Evaluate trade-offs between delivery speed, service levels, capacity, and cost.
  • Improve route utilization as customer volume increases.
  • Build repeatable route-planning processes.
  • Support the development of a distribution model capable of scaling across additional markets and geographies.

Demand & Capacity Planning

  • Translate customer demand into operational requirements.
  • Forecast route and fulfillment capacity requirements.
  • Identify potential capacity constraints before they impact customers.
  • Coordinate demand with production availability.
  • Maintain visibility into expected volume versus available logistics capacity.
  • Determine when routes, partners, or fulfillment capacity need to expand.
  • Support planning for seasonal or geographic demand changes.

Cold Chain & Perishable Operations

  • Support cold-chain execution across the distribution lifecycle.
  • Coordinate time-sensitive movement of perishable products.
  • Identify risks that could compromise product quality or delivery reliability.
  • Work with partners to resolve cold-chain or fulfillment issues quickly.
  • Help establish repeatable procedures for handling perishable products.
  • Build operational visibility around time-sensitive handoffs.

Experience with food, beverage, grocery, dairy, or other perishable goods would therefore be highly valuable.

Farm, Vendor & 3PL Management

  • Act as a key operational point of contact for production partners.
  • Coordinate with fulfillment and logistics providers.
  • Manage recurring vendor, carrier, and partner communication.
  • Follow up proactively when information or execution is delayed.
  • Monitor partner performance.
  • Surface recurring operational issues.
  • Hold partners accountable while maintaining strong working relationships.
  • Support onboarding of new operational partners as the business expands.

Logistics Analytics & Reporting

  • Build visibility into how the logistics operation is performing.
  • Monitor operational metrics such as:
    • On-time delivery rate
    • Cost per delivery
    • Cost per route
    • Route utilization
    • Delivery density
    • Failed or missed deliveries
    • Capacity utilization
    • Delivery exceptions
    • Partner and carrier performance
    • Customer volume by route or geography
  • Turn operational data into recommendations and decisions rather than simply maintaining trackers.
  • Use performance trends to identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and reliability.

SOP & Process Development

  • Map operational workflows.
  • Build SOPs for recurring logistics processes.
  • Standardize route-planning procedures.
  • Establish escalation paths.
  • Document production-to-fulfillment handoffs.
  • Build operating controls around cold-chain requirements.
  • Identify manual processes that can be simplified.
  • Create repeatable systems that future team members can follow.

Operational Scaling

  • Help translate the initial operating model into a scalable playbook.
  • Assess logistics requirements for new markets.
  • Evaluate route and distribution structures.
  • Identify fulfillment requirements.
  • Support partner and vendor selection.
  • Develop repeatable launch processes.
  • Adapt operating procedures to higher volumes and additional geographies.
  • Identify where the current operating model may break before expansion occurs.

Colleagues

You'll work closely with production partners, fulfillment providers, carriers, vendors, 3PLs, and internal stakeholders to ensure that the different parts of the operation work together effectively. You'll act as a key operational connector across logistics, fulfillment, demand, capacity, and partner management, while communicating clearly and following issues through to resolution.

At Oceans Talent, you'll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you're continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans Talent, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area paired with broad curiosity across the business. As the Operations & Logistics Lead, your vertical focus will be on logistics and supply-chain operations, while your horizontal focus will include route optimization, analytics, capacity planning, process improvement, partner management, and scalable operations.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience managing logistics, supply chain, distribution, or last-mile operations, with ownership of operational performance and process improvement.
  • Logistics & Supply Chain: Meaningful hands-on experience across logistics, supply chain, distribution, last-mile delivery, transportation operations, fulfillment, or route operations.
  • Operational Ownership: Experience owning operational processes rather than simply providing administrative or coordination support.
  • Builder Experience: Comfort working in environments where processes are incomplete or nonexistent, with the ability to design how an operation should work.
  • Analytics: Strong analytical capability and comfort working with spreadsheets, operational datasets, logistics KPIs, capacity, demand, and route economics.
  • Route & Distribution: Experience with route planning, last-mile operations, distribution, transportation, or logistics optimization.
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to identify bottlenecks, investigate root causes, develop solutions, and drive implementation through to resolution.
  • Partner Management: Experience directly managing vendors, carriers, production partners, fulfillment partners, or 3PLs.
  • Process Development: Experience creating SOPs, operating processes, and repeatable systems.
  • Autonomy: Ability to operate independently and make decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Organization: Strong attention to detail, follow-through, and ability to manage multiple operational priorities.
  • Perishable Operations: Experience with food, beverage, grocery, dairy, or other perishable products is highly valuable.

During the interview process, you'll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Logistics & Distribution: How you manage day-to-day logistics operations and delivery performance.
  • Route Planning & Optimization: How you evaluate routes, capacity, cost, and service levels.
  • Demand & Capacity Planning: How you translate demand into operational requirements and identify constraints.
  • Operational Analytics: How you use logistics data and KPIs to identify trends and make decisions.
  • Process Development: How you build SOPs and repeatable operating systems from the ground up.
  • Partner Management: How you manage vendors, carriers, fulfillment partners, and 3PLs.
  • Ownership & Problem-Solving: How you respond to operational issues, identify root causes, and drive solutions through to resolution.

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

Want to learn more about our recruitment process, what to expect from interviews, and possible outcomes? Check out [The Dive].

jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart is seeking a Senior Manager to build, train, and lead our Technical Account Management (TAM) practice and own post-launch technical excellence for our premier Storefront Pro (SFP) product.

Storefront Pro is the market leader in e-commerce solutions for grocery, combining Instacart's enormous scaling abilities with best-in-class customer experiences, while bridging online and in-store commerce.

Over the past two years, SFP has grown explosively, launching triple digits of retailers ranging from local independent favorites to midsize players to multinational giants — totalling billions in revenue. You will own post-launch technical health and excellence across the entire SFP space, founding and scaling a tiered TAM organization to match the size and complexity of that portfolio.

About the Job

  • Hire, train, and develop the Technical Account Management team from the ground up, growing it through coaching and mentorship into a world-class practice
  • Define, develop, and refine the approach to platform health for SFP; identify and monitor key metrics and establish measurement as a foundational team practice
  • Design and operate the team's operating model — portfolio assignment, tiering by account size and complexity, coverage, and escalation paths — and evolve it as the portfolio scales
  • Develop and operate systems of intake and prioritization spanning external and internal stakeholders, balancing competing priorities across resource management, product roadmap, and business commitments
  • Serve as a senior escalation point for critical issues, communicating with retailer stakeholders at all levels — including C-suite — across a range of platform matters
  • Negotiate scope and responsibility boundaries with partners and internally, holding a principled line on what the TAM function owns versus Customer Success, Project Management, Technical Support, Solution Architecture, and Engineering
  • Initiate and operate internal cross-functional initiatives that drive continuous technical improvement in SFP's deployments and operation, and synthesize systemic patterns into product and engineering roadmap influence

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in technical account management, solutions engineering/architecture, technical consulting, or engineering, ideally in SaaS or platform environments
  • 5+ years leading, hiring, and maturing engineering and/or engineering-adjacent teams; experience building or significantly scaling a team is strongly preferred
  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills, including experience liaising with VP-level and C-suite stakeholders on high-priority issues
  • Ability to define and drive large-scale transformation programs across a cross-functional landscape with measurable impact
  • Engineering depth at scale and speed: ability to analyze and diagnose complex platform integrations — REST APIs, authentication, ETL, message queues, async patterns, error handling and recovery — and drive improvements
  • Proven ability to balance proactive and reactive approaches to technical health, delivering on urgent needs without compromising long-term maintainability
  • Ability to thrive in a highly collaborative landscape, coordinating across many internal partners (project management, customer success, product management, engineering, solution architecture) to consistently deliver successful outcomes

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience founding or bootstrapping a TAM, professional services, or post-launch technical delivery function
  • Deep domain expertise in at least one area of enterprise architecture: loyalty, identity, payments, point of sale, or catalog
  • Understanding of the grocery retail or e-commerce ecosystem, including in-store operations and last-mile fulfillment

ISOs will be the primary audience, alongside vertical specific ISVs and software providers.

This is both a strategic and hands on role. You'll identify where the biggest opportunities lie, build the marketing strategy and work across teams to turn it into campaigns that deliver measurable pipeline and revenue impact.

About NMI

NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one-size-fits-all approach to payments. You've probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We're the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We're creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what's possible so they can think about what's next. But we're not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.

How We Work - Our Core Values

  • Be a Good Person, It's Simple. We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus
  • Align, Trust & Go. We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together - holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.
  • Raise the Bar. Good enough isn't enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.

About the Team

The NMI marketing team is a group of smart, collaborative people in a fast moving environment. Self-starters who love solving problems, learning continuously and building creative, data driven campaigns will thrive here.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the integrated marketing strategy and plan for NMI's core payment gateway, aligned to pipeline and revenue goals.
  • Develop and execute multi-channel campaigns to acquire new ISO partners, drive gateway adoption and support cross-sell and upsell opportunities.
  • Develop verticalized marketing strategies for priority markets, using market, customer and competitive insight to tailor positioning, messaging and campaigns to specific industry needs.
  • Build a strong understanding of ISO and ISV audiences, their buying journeys, challenges and decision drivers.
  • Partner with product marketing and content teams to develop compelling messaging, thought leadership, customer stories, campaign content and sales enablement.
  • Work closely with demand generation to define target audiences, campaign journeys, lead follow-up and conversion strategies.
  • Collaborate with sales, channel and other marketing teams to ensure programs are aligned to commercial priorities and effectively executed.
  • Manage campaigns from planning through execution, reporting and optimization, ensuring activity stays on track, on budget and on brand.
  • Track performance against agreed KPIs and use insights to continuously improve targeting, messaging, channel mix and campaign effectiveness.

Essential Skills and Experience:

  • 5-7+ years of B2B marketing experience, ideally in payments, fintech, SaaS, or enterprise technology.
  • A marketing or related business degree or equivalent.
  • Proven experience developing and executing integrated marketing strategies and campaigns that contribute to pipeline and revenue growth.
  • Experience with verticalized marketing, including developing market-specific positioning, messaging and go-to-market programs.
  • Strong understanding of B2B partner or channel-led business models. Experience marketing to ISOs, ISVs, PayFacs or other payments audiences is highly desirable.
  • Experience working closely with sales and demand generation teams on lead management, account targeting, sales enablement and pipeline acceleration.
  • Experience collaborating with and managing agency partners.
  • Strong digital marketing, campaign management and performance measurement skills, including marketing automation (Salesforce, Hubspot, Pardot, ZoomInfo), SEM, SEO, PPC, display, programmatic, etc, as well as analytics (GA4).
  • Exceptional project management, communication and stakeholder alignment skills.
  • Creativity, curiosity, initiative and a strong commercial mindset.

Do you feel like you have a slightly out of the ordinary career path or history? We are open to all walks of life and very willing to hear your story. Please don't feel like this should be a barrier to securing a great career at NMI! We appreciate success can come in all shapes and sizes. Fill in the 'Additional Info' box on our application to tell us more about your path.

As well as being a part of something exciting everyday, you will also receive the following benefits:
