Locations Required: Belgium, Canada, France, Mexico, or United States
Time Zone Preference: 6am - 12pm EST
Contract Duration: 12 months (possibility for direct hire)

About Us
Original Composites and Fiberglass is a global leader in glass reinforcement solutions for the composites industry. Recently separated from Owens Corning, the business now operates independently under the Praana ownership model, continuing a strong legacy of innovation, manufacturing excellence, and customer partnership.

With more than 4,000 employees worldwide, we are committed to redefining what's possible through a performance-driven culture centered on safety, quality, sustainability, inclusiveness, and employee development. Guided by our values of passion, ownership, and team spirit, we work together to deliver innovative solutions and exceptional service across the globe.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced and highly organized SAP Cutover Manager to lead the planning, coordination, execution, and governance of all activities required to transition from legacy business systems to SAP S/4HANA and supporting enterprise applications. This role is responsible for ensuring successful deployment readiness, business continuity, technical execution, and stabilization throughout all phases of cutover, go-live, hyper care and ongoing operations. The role will coordinate deployments across SAP S/4HANA, SAP Business Suite applications, enterprise integrations, data platforms, infrastructure services, and supporting business applications.

The SAP Cutover Manager will act as the central coordinator across IT, functions, infrastructure, data migration, security, integrations, non-ERP applications, and implementation partners. The role requires exceptional leadership, communication, and execution skills to ensure all cutover activities are coordinated, risks are mitigated, dependencies are managed, and business operations continue with no disruption during go-live events.

Original Composites & Fiberglass is a business unit of the Praana Group. Original Composites & Fiberglass was recently acquired by the Praana Group. The path ahead will be dynamic, full of change, and expected to be fast paced. The business operates from twenty (20+) locations across the globe. The information technology environment supporting our new company is being built from the ground up in terms of IT infrastructure and applications with the opportunity to leverage new technologies and new ways of thinking as we look to end a transition services agreement associated with the acquisition as soon as possible. Our Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) landscape is comprised of multiple instances across the globe. We seek to consolidate and simplify our ERP landscape to drive efficiency and effectiveness in our operations for decades ahead.
Key Responsibilities
  • Cutover Strategy & Governance
    • Develop and maintain the overall SAP S/4HANA cutover strategy, methodology, governance model, and execution framework.
    • Establish deployment readiness criteria, go/no-go decision processes, and approval mechanisms.
    • Define cutover governance, command center structures, escalation paths, and communication protocols.
  • Integrated Cutover Planning
    • Develop and maintain a fully integrated cutover plan across all program workstreams.
    • Manage dependencies, critical path activities, milestones, and contingency plans.
    • Establish and maintain detailed deployment runbooks, checklists, and execution procedures.
  • Business Readiness & Site Deployment
    • Partner with manufacturing plants, distribution centers, laboratories, and corporate functions to ensure deployment readiness.
    • Coordinate with Business leadership blackout periods, inventory activities, physical inventory counts, order management transitions, and production planning considerations to support system deployment.
    • Ensure local deployment teams understand responsibilities and execute assigned activities successfully.
  • Data Migration & Mock Cutovers
    • Coordinate with the Data Team all data migration activities supporting deployment and cutover execution.
    • Lead mock cutovers, deployment rehearsals, simulation exercises, and lessons-learned reviews.
    • Drive continuous improvement by incorporating lessons learned into the go-live deployment plans.
  • Technical Deployment Management
    • Coordinate with IT Teams the infrastructure, network, security, integration, middleware, device, and application deployment activities.
    • Ensure technical environments are prepared and validated before go-live.
    • Partner with support vendors, implementation partners, and managed service providers to ensure deployment success.
  • Hypercare & Stabilization
    • Lead command center operations during cutover execution, go-live, and hyper care periods.
    • Coordinate issue triage and resolution activities across business, SAP, infrastructure, integration, data, and application support teams.
    • Ensure successful transition from project delivery teams to Application Management Services (AMS) and operational support teams.
    • Monitor stabilization metrics and drive closure of deployment-related issues.
  • Performance & Reporting
    • Define and monitor key performance indicators related to deployment readiness and execution.
    • Provide regular reporting to executive leadership and program governance teams.
    • Drive continuous improvement initiatives for subsequent deployment waves.
Qualifications & Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or equivalent work experience.
  • 10+ years of SAP delivery and enterprise transformation experience. Minimum 2 SAP S/4HANA go-lives in a deployment leadership, or cutover management role.
  • Experience coordinating enterprise-wide business transformation deployments involving ERP, CRM, digital commerce, manufacturing operations, and customer-facing systems.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing plant deployments, warehouse deployments, commercial operations, and shared services organizations.
  • Experience managing deployment activities across multiple global locations simultaneously.
  • Strong leadership, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Exceptional planning, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities.
Preferred Qualifications & Experience
  • SAP S/4HANA implementation experience within manufacturing or process industries.
  • Experience deploying SAP within multi-site global manufacturing environments.
  • Experience leading command center and hyper care operations following ERP go-live events.
  • Knowledge of release management, CAB governance, and enterprise change control processes.
  • Familiarity with SAP Cloud ALM, SAP Solution Manager, ITSM, or similar deployment and support management tools.
  • Experience in chemical or manufacturing industries with regulated environments, supply chain, or shop floor adoption challenges.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
Work Conditions
  • Potential 20% travel time required.
  • Due to the team structure, virtual meeting formats, time zone differences, and appropriate meeting times, extended work hours may be required

About Fetch

At Fetch, we’re dedicated to helping pets live their healthiest and happiest lives. About the Industry

The pet insurance industry is more important than ever, offering peace of mind and financial protection for pet owners. The sector is expanding quickly, fueled by growing awareness of the need for accessible, high-quality veterinary care. With advances in veterinary medicine, pets now have access to the most effective treatments available, making pet insurance an essential component of modern pet care.

About the Role

Overview

We are looking for an Actuarial Data Scientist to help Fetch continue to have best-in-class pricing and profitability while also supporting growth of the business. You will leverage predictive analytics to improve the sophistication of our existing pricing models and build tools to monitor the performance of our rating plans over time.

In this highly visible role, you will be a member of a small, close-knit actuarial team and will need to be adaptable, wearing multiple hats in support of various actuarial pricing and financial forecasting initiatives. Time will be roughly evenly split between pricing, conversion, and retention modeling work and traditional actuarial pricing work. You will help evaluate product proposals from a pricing and enterprise risk management perspective, support rate filings and responses to regulatory objections, and contribute to special pricing projects such as increased limit factor analyses, policyholder coverage utilization studies, and pricing brand new coverages. You will frequently engage in creative problem-solving and present your findings to senior leadership, actively shaping the organization’s future.

  • Risk Segmentation: Improve the risk segmentation sophistication of our rating plans by developing GLM-based rating factors (in R or Python) and applying advanced predictive modeling techniques
  • Performance Monitoring: Build and maintain tools to monitor the performance of our existing rating plans and rate level over time, including loss ratio, conversion rate, churn, and lifetime value
  • Data Analysis & Modeling: Write advanced SQL procedures to pull from large, line item level veterinary bill databases
  • Product & Coverage Analysis: Estimate the impact of coverage and product changes on pricing
  • Evaluate New Product Proposals: Analyze product design proposals to determine pricing viability, impact on enterprise risk, competitive positioning, and customer value
  • Market Analysis: Stay highly informed on competitor filings to understand how our products and pricing stand relative to the market

  • Innovate: Propose creative ways to price innovative coverage concepts and ideas

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

Why Kenya

Kenya is where our next chapter begins. Following our acquisition of Sumac Microfinance Bank, we're preparing to go live — which means the people we hire here help build a business from its first day, not inherit one. How we execute in Kenya will shape how we approach every market we enter after it, making this one of the most consequential engineering mandates in the business right now. This is the natural extension of our mission: to drive financial inclusion, and help millions of business owners and individuals across the African continent achieve financial happiness and success.

So, now we are looking for our Head of Engineering, Supply Chain to join us in Kenya.

About The Role

POS Hardware and Device Platforms owns the software behind the physical side of Moniepoint's business: the systems that track, move, maintain and account for millions of POS terminals in the field. That covers inventory and warehouse management, logistics and distribution, repair and maintenance workflows, and the operational tooling the business runs on day to day. It is a backend and distributed systems challenge at real scale - making operational data about millions of physical devices visible, trustworthy and consistent across every market we operate in. It is not a hardware engineering role.

The Head of Engineering, POS Supply Chain, oversees that software estate and is vital as Moniepoint expands internationally and scales device operations globally. The position involves leading the technical strategy for the domain and managing a large engineering organisation in a remote, distributed environment. As Head of Engineering, Supply Chain, your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the technical strategy and architecture for inventory and logistics tools and repair management software.
  • Leading an engineering organisation of approximately 25 engineers, including managers, QA, SRE and Data Engineering.
  • Driving platformisation of inventory and supply chain systems so operational data is visible, trustworthy and consistent across millions of terminals.
  • Bridging the gap between operational practice and software systems by building operationally disciplined solutions.
  • Defining architecture standards, engineering processes and quality metrics across squads to ensure reliability and data integrity.
  • Collaborating with business and operational stakeholders to translate operational requirements into engineering solutions.
  • Hiring, mentoring and developing engineering managers and senior engineers to support team growth up to 30+ members.

Who You Are

  • 10–15 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading engineering teams through growth phases.
  • 5+ years of hands-on, production-level experience writing and shipping Java code as a practising engineer. This means years spent writing Java yourself, not years spent overseeing teams who write it.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing managers - leading an engineering organisation through other engineering leaders, rather than running a single team.
  • Deep hands-on experience in supply chain, inventory, warehouse or logistics software at scale.
  • Fintech or regulated-industry experience, with an understanding of the operational stakes of device management in a payments environment.
  • Strong backend engineering skills for data-intensive, distributed, operational systems.
  • Proven system design ability at large scale, managing hundreds of thousands of devices or more.
  • Experience managing and developing large engineering teams of 20 or more members.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, translating complex technical concepts for non-technical leaders.
  • A product-minded approach to solving operational problems with engineering solutions.

Cultural Alignment

As well, we assess every candidate across eight dimensions that define how great leaders operate at Moniepoint. We look for evidence of all eight throughout the process, not just in a single conversation.

  • Customer Obsession: Build deep empathy for users. Solve problems intuitively, and fix root causes, not just tickets.
  • Craft: Master the fundamentals. Reason from first principles, make trade-offs explicit, and raise the bar on quality.
  • Systemisation: Turn repeating decisions into scalable mechanisms. Reduce cognitive load and raise engineering quality.
  • Urgency: Move with disciplined speed. Act autonomously within scope, remove friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Ownership: Treat the platform as your own. Take initiative across boundaries and follow through without reminders.
  • No Ego: Put the mission first. Share credit, welcome debate, and never protect status over team outcomes.
  • Candour: Surface uncomfortable truths and risks early. Intelligent failure is welcome; concealment is not.
  • Integrity: Stay truthful and ethically consistent. Refuse toxic behavior. Performance without integrity is unacceptable.

What Success Looks Like In The Role

  • Scalable inventory and logistics systems delivered, supporting millions of devices across multiple countries.
  • A high-performing, motivated engineering team aligned with company growth.
  • Operational data visibility and trust established across multiple global markets.
  • Robust architecture standards enabling reliability and data integrity.
  • Effective collaboration with business and operational teams to meet rapid expansion needs.

What we can offer you

  • Lead engineering for one of Africa's largest POS networks and directly influence our global expansion.
  • Work in a fast-paced, innovative environment at the intersection of fintech and hardware operations.
  • Be part of a mission-driven company impacting millions of businesses and individuals across Africa and beyond.

What to expect in the hiring process

  • A preliminary phone call with the recruiter.
  • 60 minute High level System Design round with one of our Engineering Managers.
  • 60 minute Panel Interview with 2 of our Head of Engineering leaders, 30 minutes focused on a technical deep dive into your CV and into a project/system you built in the past. 30 minutes will be focused on testing for leadership attributes.
  • 60 minute Stakeholder Management Round with one of our Product Heads/VPs, focused on your stakeholder management, collaboration skills with product/business.
  • 60 minute Technical round and Culture fit interview with our Co-founder & Group CTO (the hiring manager).

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

About the Position
The Advising Operations Coordinator role at The Chicago School oversees operational processes and systems related to student advising. This is an operations support role with the university's Student Advising team. Success in this role includes effective collaboration with students, faculty, staff, academic
departments, and Student Support Counselors to deliver a strong advising experience to students. Key responsibilities include managing advising-related data, department schedules, enrollment processes, reporting, and system accuracy.

This is a remote role. The Advising Operations Coordinator will report to the Assistant Director of Advising Operations and will be assigned management of the advising-related operations of a subset of The Chicago School's academic departments. Domestic travel and work outside of standard business hours will be required to support key activities and events.

Principal Duties
Information Management

  • Centrally track advising-related data and ensure that data are accessible, accurate, and up to date.
  • Track student information related to general academic progress, dissertation progress and coordination,administrative withdrawals, degree audits, faculty advisor assignments, and cross-campus enrollment.
  • Review commencement eligibility, residency, study abroad, and other academic needs to ensure that students remain on track toward graduation.
  • Manage implementation of internal articulation agreements for students moving between academic programs at The Chicago School.
  • Collaborate with academic departments and Student Support Counselors on enrollment, coursescheduling, and student support-related operational needs.
  • Generate and review reports to support enrollment management, course scheduling, system audits,student tracking, and other advising operations.
  • Conduct routine system and data audits to ensure course and enrollment information is accurate,complete, and up to date.
  • Identify and resolve data discrepancies and coordinate with appropriate departments to address issues and maintain data and system integrity.

Schedule Management

  • Lead course scheduling to meet student needs, considering average credit hours, class sizes, course sequences, breaks in enrollment, and time to graduation.
  • Build and maintain courses using CampusVue/Campus Nexus and other applicable university systems, including assigning faculty, cross-listing courses, reviewing course capacity and enrollment, and making necessary scheduling adjustments.
  • Participate in enrollment meetings and term-preparation activities to review course offerings, enrollment, instructor assignments, and other registration-related needs.
  • Review course schedules and enrollment data to identify necessary updates, including deactivating courses, assigning TBA instructors, reviewing courses with low or no enrollment, and making other scheduling adjustments as needed.

Other Duties

  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • 1-2 years of administrative or higher education experience.
  • Bachelor's degree.

Required Skills

  • Excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Strong time management and prioritization skills.
  • Highly organized and attentive to detail.
  • Ability to manage projects independently.
  • Strong administrative skills.
  • Team-oriented.
  • Experience with CampusVue/Campus Nexus or similar student information systems, including coursescheduling, enrollment management, data review, and report generation.
The Chicago School offers a generous compensation and benefits package, as well as the opportunity to work for a leader in the field of education. Some of our key benefits include: generous paid time-off, medical and dental coverage, company-paid life and disability insurance, retirement plan with employer contribution, multiple flexible spending accounts (FSA), tuition reimbursement, professional development, and regular employee appreciation events.The Chicago School is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description:
AnewHealth is one of the nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home. We enable better outcomes for patients and the healthcare organizations who support them. Established in 2023 through the combination of ExactCare and Tabula Rasa HealthCare, we provide a suite of solutions that includes comprehensive pharmacy services; full-service pharmacy benefit management; and specialized support services for Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. With over 1,400 team members, we care for more than 100,000 people across all 50 states.

Job Details

Pharmacy Technicians in our Patient Care Center of Excellence may hold multiple duties to ensure ExactCare’s patients receive quality care out of their pharmacy services. They will work in a closed-door pharmacy environment, spending their time speaking with patients, doctors and facilities on the phone in addition to the outline job duties and responsibilities.

Job duties will vary from phone work and navigating multiple pharmacy software systems to supporting the various stages of patient care/contact. These areas of responsibility will fluctuate based on organizational needs, allowing the Pharmacy Technician to develop multiple skillsets.

This is an office (or remote) based, cubicle environment, allowing the Pharmacy Technician to provide an exceptional patient experience. ExactCare Pharmacy provides a fast-paced, high energy environment, allowing Pharmacy Technicians to excel in many areas with a focus on phone based pharmacy work.

Responsibilities

  • Providing an exceptional customer service experience each day in a phone based environment.

  • Enter a high volume of data; processing prescription information with speed and accuracy.

  • Utilizing sound drug knowledge to effectively receive prescription authorizations, clarifications or transfers.

  • Perform claim adjudication and auditing duties such as prior authorizations, billing and eligibility checks. Requiring outbound calls to patients.

  • Working through current case queues to problem solve for patient care issues.

  • Serving as a liaison between the clinical pharmacists and other medical professionals on patient’s behalf.

  • Partner with technicians and pharmacists to ensure that new patients are successfully on-boarded to ExactCare.

  • Maintaining patient records with strong attention to detail and confidentiality.

  • Accurate retrieval of all prescription information and verifying through doctor calls.

  • Placing welcome calls to newly on-boarded patients and establish a trusted point of contact.

  • Placing outbound calls to patients to create, maintain or update their medication profiles.

  • Serve as backup support for times of higher patient call volume.

  • Effectively assist with patient questions over the phone.

  • Performing in a high volume, fast paced environment to support ExactCare’s nationwide patient base.

  • Embody AnewHealth’s Core Values in all communications and interactions.

  • Other duties as assigned.

The above essential functions are representative of major duties of positions in this job classification. Specific duties and responsibilities may vary based upon departmental needs. Other duties may be assigned similar to the above consistent with knowledge, skills and abilities required for the job. Not all of the duties may be assigned to a position.

Education

  • High school diploma/GED

  • Certified with the Pharmacy Technician Certification Board (PTCB) or the National Health Association (NHA) and maintain a current certificate

  • Must maintain a pharmacy technician registration with State Board of Pharmacy

Experience

  • Must be 18+ years of age

  • Prior experience in a pharmacy setting

  • Ability to perform in an office based (or remote) setting that requires sitting at a desk 90% of the time

Skills & Abilities

  • Comfortable working in a phone-based environment.

  • Ability to work independently.

  • Self-motivated and goal oriented.

  • Ability to utilize computer equipment, technology and work within multiple software programs to receive medication authorizations, clarifications and/or transfers.

  • Exceptional customer service skills; servicing doctor’s office, pharmacist, and patient needs over the phone.

  • Thorough drug knowledge.

  • Pharmacy billing knowledge.

  • Knowledge of appropriate processes in taking prescriptions, clarifications and transfers including clear written and verbal communication.

  • Strong prioritization and organizational skills.

  • Maintain a high degree of confidentiality.

  • Passion to help people and enrich their lives.

Schedules are set to accommodate the requirements of the position and the needs of the organization and may be adjusted as needed.

This is a remote position.

AnewHealth offers a comprehensive benefit package for full-time employees that includes medical/dental/vision, flexible spending, company-paid life insurance and short-term disability as well as voluntary benefits, 401(k), Paid Time Off and paid holidays. jobs.excerpt: About the Client Our client owns and operates a behavioral health private practice with offices in Raleigh, NC and the Salem/Portland, OR area, now in its third year of business.
jobs.description:
About the Client
Our client owns and operates a behavioral health private practice with offices in Raleigh, NC and the Salem/Portland, OR area, now in its third year of business. The practice provides mental health care to patients across both locations and is building out its internal systems and support team as it grows. They're looking to bring on a dedicated assistant with genuine healthcare experience to support the clinical and administrative side of the practice.
Why does this role exist?
The practice has learned firsthand that generalist administrative support isn't enough for a healthcare setting — the current assistant in this seat lacks a medical background, which has created a steep learning curve around healthcare terminology, insurance processes, and how to appropriately support patients who may be in distress. This role exists to bring in someone who already understands the healthcare world and can hit the ground running on intake, insurance claims, and documentation — freeing the practice owner from the administrative load of prior authorizations and claims follow-up so she can focus on patient care. This is intended as a long-term seat on the team, not a temporary fix.

The Impact you’ll make

Patient Intake
  • Gather patient information and set up new patient charts
  • Schedule initial appointments
  • Support the ongoing development of a standardized intake process alongside the practice owner

Insurance Claims Management
  • Process prior authorizations
  • Submit and manage insurance claims
  • Follow up directly with insurance companies on denied or rejected claims to get them resolved

Documentation Records
  • Draft patient-related documents, including diagnosis letters, ESA letters, and work-excuse letters
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in the practice's EHR system (iCANotes)
  • Handle general data entry and recordkeeping

Process SOP Development
  • Help create and maintain internal policies and standard operating procedures
  • Support the practice as it formalizes processes like patient intake

Patient Practice Support
  • Communicate with patients professionally and with empathy, including those who may be having a difficult day
  • Coordinate with the practice owner via WhatsApp, RingCentral, and Google Meet as needed

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required:
  • Genuine, hands-on prior experience in a healthcare or medical setting — this is a strict requirement, not a nice-to-have
  • Experience with medical insurance processes, including claims submission and following up on denials/rejections
  • Experience with patient intake and/or medical documentation (charts, letters, records)
  • Comfortable working in or learning an EHR system for daily data entry and recordkeeping
  • Professional written and verbal communication skills suitable for direct patient interaction
Your superpowers are...
  • Technical:
    • Real working knowledge of healthcare terminology and insurance/claims processes
    • Comfortable navigating EHR systems (iCANotes experience a plus, but not required)
    • Strong documentation skills — accurate, clear, and appropriately formatted for a clinical setting
    • Organized and detail-oriented when managing patient charts, records, and follow-ups
  • Soft Skills:
    • Even-keeled and patient, especially with individuals who may be struggling or distressed
    • Empathetic communicator who never gets short with patients, even under pressure
    • Reliable and consistent — this is a long-term role, not a short-term gig
    • Comfortable helping shape and improve processes that are still being built out
    • Proactive about following up and closing the loop, especially on insurance claims
WFH Set-Up:
  • Computer with at least 8GB RAM, an Intel i5 core processor/AMD Ryzen 5 Processor and up.
  • Internet speed of at least 40MBPS
  • Headset with an extended mic that has noise cancellation and a webcam
  • Back-up computer and internet connection
  • Quiet, dedicated workspace at home
You should apply if...
  • You've genuinely worked in healthcare before — not adjacent to it, but in it — and you understand why that matters when you're the one on the phone with an insurance company or building out a patient's chart.
  • You have real compassion for people who may be going through a hard time, and you don't let that show in your tone even on a tough day.
  • You like the idea of joining a practice early enough to help shape how things get done, rather than just following a rulebook that's already set in stone.
  • You're looking for a role you can settle into long-term, not just your next short-term placement.
What to expect...
Work Setup:
  • Remote position
  • Must have a reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace
  • Required to provide own computer with Intel Core i5 or something similar or higher operating system
Working Hours:
  • 40 hours per week
  • Monday to Friday 10:00 am to 7:00 pm EST
Compensation:
  • $7 per hour
  • No benefits package included

Who We Are

Great Minds is a high-growth, mission-driven organization founded by educators in 2007. As a for-profit, Public Benefit Corporation, we believe all students deserve access to meaningful, challenging content—and all teachers deserve tools that are intuitive, effective, and built for the realities of today’s classrooms.

We develop high-quality, knowledge-rich math, science and ELA curricula grounded in research and designed in collaboration with educators. Our materials reflect real classroom needs and are built to drive lasting student outcomes.

We are committed to usability, coherence, and practical implementation—supporting teachers not just through curriculum, but with professional learning, purposeful technology, and responsive service that enable strong adoption and impact.

What We Build

Our products—Eureka Math and Eureka Math², Wit & Wisdom, PhD Science, Geodes, and the newly launched Arts & Letters ELA—are trusted by thousands of schools and districts nationwide.

  • Eureka Math is the most widely used math curriculum in the U.S., and is focused on balancing conceptual understanding, procedural fluency, and application.

  • Wit & Wisdom® and Arts & Letters ELA™ anchor our reading strategy with content-rich, grade-level instruction that integrates literature, history, and the arts, grounded in the science of reading. Geodes® complements our reading suite with decodable texts that pair phonics with meaningful content to support early literacy.

These programs reflect a shared belief in high expectations, joyful rigor, and deep respect for educators and students.

Great Minds is entering a new stage of growth and product maturity. We are focused on building more connected, customer-informed experiences across the full educator journey—from curriculum to professional learning to platform and support.

Our long-term vision is to become a true partner in impact—not just delivering curriculum, but supporting educators in achieving outcomes at scale.

Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

Best Life

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

Growth Mindset

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

One Team

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

ABC Fitness is seeking a Vice President, People Operations & Experience to help build the next generation of our global People operating model. Reporting to the Chief People Officer, this leader will shape how our People function scales across core operations, employee experience, Talent Management, Learning & Development, People Technology, analytics, AI enablement, and employee engagement.
This is not a traditional HR operations role. We are looking for a leader who can pair strong People Operations experience with real depth in Talent Management, leadership development, workforce capability building, and technology-enabled transformation. The right leader will help simplify how work gets done, strengthen the employee and manager experience, develop high-performing People leaders, and ensure ABC’s People function is built for growth, agility, and the responsible use of AI and automation.
This role will lead through senior functional leaders across Total Rewards and HRIS, Workforce Relations and Employee Experience, People Technology and Analytics, Talent Management and Learning, and Employee Engagement and Communications.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
  • Define and lead a scalable People Operations and Experience roadmap that supports ABC’s business strategy, global growth, and evolving workforce needs.
  • Establish clear operating models, decision rights, service standards, governance, and success metrics across People Operations and Experience.
  • Build practical, enterprise-ready Talent Management, Learning & Development, succession, leadership development, manager enablement, and capability-building practices.
  • Champion a technology-forward People operating model, including responsible use of automation, AI-enabled workflows, people analytics, data governance, and employee and manager self-service.
  • Lead through strong functional leaders, helping Directors and Senior Directors grow from excellent operators into enterprise-level People leaders.
  • Partner with the CPO, HR Business Partners, business leaders, IT, Finance, and Legal to connect People priorities to business outcomes, productivity, risk, employee experience, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Strengthen employee and manager service delivery through simplified processes, clearer knowledge management, stronger support models, and measurable improvements in quality, speed, and experience.
  • Integrate employee listening, internal communications, culture activation, and change communications into broader People transformation work.
  • Elevate People analytics from reporting to actionable workforce insights that improve leadership decisions and organizational performance.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • Significant progressive People / HR leadership experience, including leadership of broad People Operations, Employee Experience, HR Operations, or HR transformation work.
  • Demonstrated depth in Talent Management, Learning & Development, leadership development, manager enablement, succession planning, talent reviews, or workforce capability building.
  • Meaningful experience with HR technology, people analytics, workflow automation, digital transformation, or AI-enabled HR practices.
  • Experience redesigning operating models, simplifying processes, and building scalable systems rather than only managing existing programs.
  • Ability to lead through senior functional leaders by setting direction, clarifying ownership, developing leadership capability, and creating accountability without becoming the execution bottleneck.
  • Strong executive partnership skills, with the ability to connect People investments to business outcomes, productivity, employee experience, risk, and ROI.
  • Change leadership experience in a complex, growing, global, PE-backed, technology, or transformation-oriented environment.
  • Comfort operating through ambiguity, shifting priorities, direct feedback, and high expectations while building trust through judgment, transparency, and follow-through.

AND IT’S GREAT TO HAVE

  • Experience in SaaS, software, payments, HR technology, professional services, or another technology-enabled business.
  • Experience working in a PE-backed, global, high-growth, or transformation-heavy environment.
  • Familiarity with Workday, HR service delivery models, employee support, employee relations, Total Rewards, payroll, or job architecture.
  • Experience implementing AI-enabled, automated, or analytics-driven People workflows with appropriate controls and human oversight.
  • Experience connecting internal communications, employee listening, engagement, culture, and change management into broader employee experience work.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Within the first 12 months, this leader will have:
  • Established a clear People Operations and Experience operating model with defined accountabilities, service standards, decision rights, and success measures.
  • Strengthened the leadership bench across the People organization, especially among Director and Senior Director-level functional leaders.
  • Built credible, practical Talent Management, Learning & Development, succession, manager enablement, and leadership development capabilities.
  • Advanced a People Technology, AI, analytics, and data-governance roadmap with measurable improvements in productivity, experience, and decision quality.
  • Improved employee and manager service delivery through simplified processes, stronger self-service, clearer knowledge management, and better operational metrics.
  • Increased the use of workforce data and insights in executive and business decision making.
  • Created stronger integration across employee experience, communications, culture, learning, technology, and business needs.

Description

TripleTen is an online teaching platform that empowers individuals, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions.

Our bootcamps focus on training students in software engineering, data science, business intelligence analytics, and QA engineering in a feasible and accessible way, ultimately leading them to thrive in a new career.

Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry.

Career Coaches help ensure that our graduates are job ready by their graduation date. They support the success of the Career Services team by coaching 150-200 students / graduates in group settings, and hosting workshops. This role is hands-on coaching, ensuring high-quality service delivery, streamlined processes, and effective problem-solving.

How to apply?

Apply here! We review applications on an ongoing basis and invite selected candidates to record an introductory video as a first step.

If there is an available opening, we will invite you to an interview with our Hiring Managers; otherwise, we will keep your profile and completed assignment on file for future opportunities.

Please submit your CV in English.

What you will do

1. Career Coaching & Student Support

  • Manage a portfolio of 150–200 students in a group format, with 1:1 office hours as needed.
  • Provide ongoing career coaching, including support for escalated or reassigned students.
  • Review resumes, LinkedIn profiles, portfolios, and cover letters, delivering feedback within 24 hours.
  • Conduct mock HR/cultural fit interviews and assess performance using internal guidelines.
  • Track student progress in internal systems and proactively flag risks (e.g., disengagement, delays).
  • Engage the student community by facilitating channels, sharing job market insights, and offering practical guidance.
  • Host webinars and career events as needed.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to improve career services and student experience.
  • Provide timely, ad hoc career support within a 24-hour response window.

2. Collaboration & Communication. Provide clear, empathetic, and solution-oriented feedback to students and teammates.

3. Organization & Reliability. Maintain structured records, manage time effectively, and respond to priorities within 24 hours.

4. Data & Performance Tracking. Monitor key metrics and use data to improve coaching outcomes.

5. Workshops. Support development and facilitation of career workshops.

6. Cross-Track Coaching. Coach across multiple tracks (Software Engineering, QA, Data, Cybersecurity, UX/UI).

Requirements

  • You have 2–5 years of experience in a relevant role, such as a career coach, recruiter, HR professional, or hiring manager (experience in executive search or coaching is a strong plus).
  • You have a strong understanding of the US job market, including hiring practices, candidate expectations, and cultural nuances.
  • You have excellent English proficiency (C1–C2), both spoken and written.
  • You are a people-oriented professional who can actively listen, provide structured and constructive feedback, and build trust with candidates.
  • You are able to inspire and motivate individuals or groups of job seekers throughout their job search journey.
  • You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and demonstrate strong ownership and follow-through.
  • You have outstanding communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Nice to have: prior experience in the tech industry or working with tech candidates.

What we can offer you

  • Fully remote part-time collaboration (20-25 hours per week, $15 USD per hour).
  • A comfortable digital office. We use modern digital tools — Slack, Miro, Notion, Google Meet, etc.— to make the process of working together seamless.
  • Growth. Our product is expanding quickly, so it's a great time to get on board and challenge yourself.
  • Diverse and tight-knit team which is spread out across US, LatAm, Europe and more.

jobs.description:
Description

CapsLock specializes in providing digital marketing services to businesses facing sales growth challenges. Our services include sales consulting, data analytics, and recruitment support, ensuring efficient and accelerated growth. Founded by industry professionals in IT, design, and data analytics, we address the market need for exclusive, scalable customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, we value people, client orientation, quality, continuous improvement, integrity, and strong relationships. Our diverse, global team speaks over 10 languages whose ideas inspire the innovation that runs through everything we do, from unique technology to industry-leading services and customer experiences.

﻿Role overview

The Video Editor / Motion Designer at CapsLock creates and edits high-performing video content with the primary goal of improving conversion rates. This role sits at the intersection of creative storytelling, motion design, and modern AI tooling — producing advertising videos that convert cold traffic across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and landing pages.

You'll work closely with the Creative Director, marketers, and copywriters to develop, test, and iterate on video concepts, using AI tools alongside traditional post-production to accelerate output and raise the quality bar.

Responsibilities

﻿

Video Creation & Production

  • Develop video ads from concept to final delivery — funnel formats, YouTube, Facebook, and TikTok
  • Edit and enhance videos using dialogue, graphics, music, sound design, and visual effects, ensuring logical sequencing and strong storytelling
  • Create AI-generated advertising creative for paid social and landing pages, converting cold traffic into warm leads
  • Produce and refine photorealistic human characters in video, with attention to realism in motion, expression, and speech synchronisation
  • Enhance video quality through upscaling, smoothness improvements, and post-processing
  • Deliver polished final cuts optimised for advertising performance goals

Concept Development & Pre-Production

  • Craft clear storylines and narrative structures tailored to platform and audience
  • Prepare shoot guides and gather reference materials when collaborating with videographers
  • Research and propose multiple creative angles, selecting the best options based on data and research
  • Test different formats, calls-to-action, and visual approaches

AI Tools & Optimization

  • Research, test, and integrate new AI tools into the production workflow to improve efficiency and output quality
  • Experiment with AI-assisted editing techniques including avatar generation, voice synthesis, and automated post-production
  • Use AI tools to reduce production time without compromising quality

Analytics & Performance

  • Analyse video performance metrics and use insights to optimise creative
  • Run A/B tests on formats, hooks, CTAs, and creative elements — monitor and document results promptly
  • Build deep product knowledge and apply it to data-driven creative decisions

Collaboration & Trend Integration

  • Work closely with the Creative Director, copywriters, marketers, and designers to ensure creative alignment
  • Track and apply the latest video trends, viral formats, and platform-specific features
  • Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards

Requirements

Must-Have Skills

  • Full post-production capability: cutting, titling, colour correction, After Effects, sound mixing
  • Strong command of video rhythm, pacing, transitions, typography, and sound design
  • Skills in improving video quality — sharpness, smoothness, upscaling
  • Hands-on experience creating AI-generated video from scratch or from references
  • Ability to produce realistic human characters in video, including lip-sync and speech-to-movement synchronisation
  • Deep enough understanding of video editing to speak the language and spot problems early
  • Ability to work from a detailed brief and proactively propose creative solutions
  • Comfort collaborating with a Creative Director on iterations and new concepts

Technical Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in video editing, post-production, or motion design as a primary discipline
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. Desktop-based editing is required — portfolios built on mobile-only tools such as CapCut will not be considered
  • Experience working within an agency or structured in-house team, with established workflows and reporting lines
  • Working experience with AI video tools: Veo, Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, HeyGen, or similar
  • Experience with AI image generation tools: Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or similar
  • Solid understanding of video formats for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook
  • Comfortable reviewing performance analytics and iterating based on data
  • Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher

﻿Soft Skills

  • Curious to explore new tools, formats, and creative approaches
  • Adaptable to shifting priorities and fast-paced team dynamics
  • High execution speed without compromising quality
  • Consistent on-time delivery and strong attention to deadlines
  • Strong attention to detail, especially around compliance and brand guidelines
  • Critical thinking and a problem-solving mindset
  • Clear, professional communication and team collaboration skills
  • Initiative to find solutions even when processes are undefined

Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

Paid Time Off

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

Ongoing Learning

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

Home Office

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

Physical Well-Being

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

Unlimited Sick Days

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

Medical Coverage

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

Co-Working Space

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

Fun Stuff

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

The IT Director, IT Service Management (ITSM) and Quality Assurance will lead Eurofins’ global ITSM function, driving the strategy, governance, quality, and continuous improvement of IT services across the organization.

This role is responsible for establishing and evolving the global ITSM operating model, ensuring reliable, efficient, and user-focused service delivery while advancing process maturity and operational excellence.

The successful candidate will oversee the enterprise ITSM platform, lead global teams, and collaborate closely with IT, business, infrastructure, security, and regional stakeholders to enhance service performance, quality, and business value.

We are looking for a dynamic leader who can combine strategic vision with execution excellence, foster cross-functional collaboration, and help shape the future of IT service delivery at Eurofins.

  • Define and lead the global ITSM strategy, governance model, and continual improvement roadmap.
  • Own full ITIL-aligned practice governance across Service Portfolio Management, Incident, Problem, Change Enablement, Request Fulfilment, Service Catalogue, Knowledge, CMDB/Configuration, IT Asset, Service Level, and Continual Improvement. Increase ITIL process maturity across global IT.
  • Enhance the quality and performance of IT services globally.
  • Lead BMC Helix platform governance, including roadmap, configuration standards, access controls, integrations, workflow automation, reporting, data quality, upgrades, and enhancement prioritization.
  • Establish service quality metrics, dashboards, KPIs, and executive reporting for ITSM performance and platform health.
  • Increase CMDB accuracy and service mapping maturity.
  • Manage ITSM and BMC Helix budgets, vendors, contracts, performance expectations, escalations, and cost-benefit prioritization.
  • Build strong partnerships across IT, business, security, infrastructure, applications, regional organizations, and external vendors, ensuring that ITSM services and BMC Helix capabilities are aligned with enterprise priorities and business needs.
  • Ensure ITSM processes and BMC Helix configurations support compliance, auditability, role-based access, data integrity, and operational risk management.
  • Improve automation, reduce cycle time and operating cost of IT through endorsed investments in AI, chatbots, virtual agents, and improved customer-accessible knowledge management.
  • Minimum Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field is required.
  • 10+ years of experience of IT leadership experience, including significant ITSM, IT Operations, Service Delivery, or platform governance experience.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, including global or distributed teams
  • Strong ITIL/ITSM expertise and demonstrated experience owning or improving enterprise ITSM practices.
  • Experience with enterprise ITSM platforms; BMC Helix experience is strongly preferred.
  • Proven experience with service quality metrics, SLAs/OLAs, reporting, CMDB/configuration management, service catalogue, automation, and continual improvement.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment. As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform.

This specialist reports into the VP of Sales, EMEA and will be aligned by segment and product. AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment. Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful.

  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’re meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you’re diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer.
  • You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers operate in "boots-on-the-ground" industries. They value earned trust and partners who understand their operational realities.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team Player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader account team. You lead through influence, not just authority.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect deals that align Samsara’s new products value with customer use cases to provide maximum value and return on investment
  • Co-generate new product pipeline with ADRs/AEs across high propensity to buy accounts
  • Drive strategy and pilot/trial success
  • Provide commercial insights and pricing benchmarks often for unique set of competitors in the market
  • Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and help shape roadmap
  • Build frameworks, assets and insights that scale across the sales org

  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Deal Complexity: Demonstrated success navigating 6- and 7-figure deals involving multiple stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, InfoSec, and C-Suite).
  • Entrepreneurial Agility: Experience selling new products where the playbook is still being written.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in a specialist/overlay co-selling with a mainline AE team.
  • Second language experience in French or German at business-level proficiency.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. Belonging at Samsara

  • Capture page metadata, including language, document type, source, page dimensions, and flags for tables, formulas, and handwriting.
  • Review a colleague's work. Every task is reviewed end-to-end by a second Korean expert.

Must-Have

  • Native Korean speaker with full command of Hangul, including hanja.
  • Experience in bilingual transcription, translation, editorial work, or AI training data.

  • Systematic application of taxonomy across pages.
  • Comfort with unfamiliar layouts like multi-column newspapers and handwritten forms.

Preferred

  • Experience with AI training data: annotation, labeling, grading, or bilingual evaluation.
  • Skills in transcription and localization: MTPE, subtitling, bilingual QA, OCR correction.
  • Document production experience: typesetting, copy-editing, proofreading, or digitization of Korean-language material.

About the job

About Juno

Juno leverages collective bargaining power to secure better student loan rates for higher education students. With 290,000+ members and over $2B in negotiated loan volume, we've proven that group buying works. We are the most popular way to pay for the world's top graduate programs, and we're expanding what a Juno membership is worth.

The Problem

Federal lending reforms have created a significant market shift. In July 2026, new caps on federal graduate loans, including the elimination of Grad PLUS for new students, came into effect, leaving millions of students with significant funding gaps. Students need transparent, competitive private options.

Our members trust us with one of the largest financial decisions of their lives. That trust is worth far more than a single loan.

Your Mission

Juno has 290,000 members who came to us for one product. We're building a portfolio of financial products and benefits that follows them from school into their careers.

You'll own that expansion. Each new product is yours from the first market question through to the first cohort of members using it. You'll pick the partners, build the case, and run the launch.

This is the widest surface area at Juno and the shortest path from a decision to a launch.

What You'll Do

  • Launch new products and member benefits end to end. Size the opportunity, select the partner, build the plan, ship it, and own the result.
  • Own the analysis behind the decision. Unit economics, market sizing, and build versus buy versus partner diligence that leadership acts on.
  • Carry our largest partnerships. Own major distribution and integration relationships day to day so they compound rather than stall.

What We Offer

Compensation: $115,000 to $140,000, plus variable compensation tied to performance.

Benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and retirement matching.

What We're Looking For

  • Background: 2 to 4 years in management consulting, investment banking, or a high-growth startup, or you've built something of your own.
  • Ownership end to end. You've taken something from a blank page to live in market.
  • Commercial judgment. You decide what to launch from real member research, then read early signals to make the call to scale it or wind it down.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. You're handed a goal rather than a plan, and you come back with a recommendation and the steps to get there.
  • Technical leverage. When the tool you need doesn't exist, you build it. AI tooling and APIs are how you already work.

The X-Factor

  • You're resourceful: constraints are where your best ideas have come from.

Interview process

Intro chat with the hiring manager, a case study exercise, cross-functional conversations with senior leadership, and references.

Why Join Juno?

Real Impact: Help hundreds of thousands of students get access to lower rates

Market Timing: Federal aid changes create massive tailwind for growth

Proven Model: $2B+ negotiated, 290K+ members, product-market fit achieved

Title:  AI Engineer(P3)

The Role:  

You build the full-stack components that power Innovation Crew pilots and prototypes. Under the technical direction of the Principal AI Engineer, in close collaboration with the AI Experience Engineer, you write the backend services, API integrations, data connectors, and frontend implementations that turn AI architectures into working systems. This role has a high ceiling and a fast runway: you will be working alongside engineers at the frontier of AI application development, with hands-on exposure to frontier model APIs, agentic frameworks, Power Agents library development, and JD Power's core data infrastructure. You arrive with strong engineering fundamentals and a genuine appetite for AI systems. You gain deep, production-proven agentic engineering experience. In your first 30 days, you will have your first feature shipped inside a PoC sprint and the codebase oriented. By day 60, you will have your first Power Agents contribution reviewed and merged. How we BuildAgents:

The Innovation Crew builds alongside its own AI agent workforce. As AI Engineer, you will contribute to building andmaintainingthose agents: writing the tool integrations, evaluation harnesses, and API connectors that give agents access to JD Power's data and systems. You learn to build for observability from day one - every agent pattern you ship is instrumented, testable, and inspectable. When a pattern proves reliable, you contribute it to the Power Agents library, where 400+ engineers & knowledge workers can build on it.

The Impact You Will Have in This Role: 

Innovation Crew pilots only get built because the engineering work that underlies them gets done cleanly and quickly. You are the execution engine that turns architectural direction into working code. You build backend services that connect to Snowflake, API integrations that wire agent outputs to JD Power's core platforms, frontend components the AI Experience Engineer builds on. The pilots you help build will be handed off as operational systems tomaintainingteams within Product Engineering, Engineering, OEM Solutions, Infrastructure, and Internal Platforms. You will contribute directly to the Power Agents library, meaning code you write will be used by engineers & knowledge workers across JD Power.

WhatYou’llBe Doing in This Role:

Qualifications of this Role:

  • Full-stack engineering fundamentals across backend (REST APIs, cloud-native service patterns) and frontend: solid enough to build a working API, connect it to a data source, and surface it through a functional UI - you do not need a dedicated teammate to do either half.

  • Genuine, demonstrable curiosity about AI systems: you have built something with an LLM API, understand what RAG and tool-calling mean in practice, follow frontier model developments, and actively use AI coding tools as part of how you work.

  • Clean, well-documented code and a fast-learning orientation: this role pairs closely with principal-level engineers who move quickly; you absorb direction, ask sharp questions, and contribute meaningfully without waiting for complete specifications.

Also Valued

  • Python and/or TypeScript; experience withLangChain,LangGraph, or equivalent agent frameworks; familiarity with Snowflake,BigQuery, or equivalent cloud data platform.

  • RAG patterns, vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone,Weaviate), and basic eval harness design, even if you have only done this in a side project, knowing the concepts matters.

  • Observability basics: you know the difference between a trace and a log, have seenLangfuseorLangSmithin use, and understand why instrumentation is part of building, not a post-build step.

  • JD Power internal platform or API familiarity; existing knowledge of our data schemas or product ecosystem reduces ramp time significantly.

The Hiring Manager says: 

“I am looking for someone with strong engineering fundamentals and a genuine hunger to apply them to AI systems. You do not need a five-yeartrack record, you need to have built something real with an LLM, have clean code instincts, and be ready to learn fast alongside engineers who are working at the frontier. If you can demo something youactually shipped (an agent, a RAG pipeline, a tool-calling integration, anything where you can walk through what broke and how you fixed it) that tells me everything I need to know.”

Role Overview
We are seeking a talented Full Stack Data Engineer to join our growing Data & Analytics team.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building data solutions end-to-end—from ingesting and transforming raw data through to modelling, visualization, and delivering actionable business insights. You will work closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Operations, Finance, and Corporate Functions to translate business requirements into scalable data products built on the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with a business-oriented mindset and enjoys owning solutions throughout their lifecycle.

Note: Role will require supporting EU/US time zones. Flexibility in working hours is to be expected

About Role

1. End-to-End BI Solution Development

  • Design, develop, and implement full-stack BI solutions from data ingestion through to user-facing reports and apps.

  • Take ambiguous business questions and translate them into well-defined BI products, including data models, semantic layers, dashboards, and supporting documentation.

  • Manage delivery from discovery and prototyping through validation and production support.

  • Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and reliability across all BI solutions.

2. Data Pipelines, Modelling, and ETL

  • Develop and maintain ingestion and transformation pipelines using Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory pipelines, dataflows Gen2, copy activities).

  • Land, organize, and structure data using Fabric Lakehouse and/or Data Warehouse patterns.

  • Implement layered data architectures (e.g. bronze / silver / gold) to ensure modular, reusable, and testable transformations.

  • Partner with Data Engineers to align on ETL standards, performance optimization, and scalable design.

  • Apply data quality checks, validation rules, and monitoring to proactively identify issues.

3. Semantic Models, Reporting, and Visualization

  • Design dimensional and star schemas optimized for BI use cases (facts, dimensions, SCDs, conformed dimensions).

  • Build and maintain Power BI semantic models (datasets) with clear, consistent business logic using DAX measures and calculated columns.

  • Develop high-quality Power BI reports, dashboards, and apps that are intuitive, performant, and aligned to real business workflows.

  • Implement navigation, drill-through, parameterized views, and security (row-level and object-level) as required.

  • Optimize models and reports for performance, maintainability, and scalability.

4. Data Analysis and Insights

  • Perform data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities that support decision-making.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand analytical needs and deliver actionable insights.

  • Support advanced analytics use cases where appropriate, including predictive or statistical models in partnership with other specialists.

5. Data Governance, Documentation, and Support

  • Ensure BI solutions comply with data governance policies, security standards, and regulatory requirements.

  • Contribute to and follow standards for naming, workspace structure, environments, and deployment flows in Fabric.

  • Document BI products clearly, including purpose, data sources, refresh cadence, ownership, lineage, and known limitations.

  • Contribute to shared libraries of reusable calculations, templates, and visual standards.

  • Provide structured handovers, user support, and occasional training or knowledge-sharing sessions.

6. Collaboration and Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with business stakeholders to priorities work and agree success measures for BI products.

  • Collaborate with data engineering, architecture, governance, and security teams to align on standards and patterns.

  • Participate in peer reviews of SQL, DAX, data models, and report designs.

  • Support continuous improvement of BI delivery practices, promoting full-stack ownership and reduced hand-offs.

About You

  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data transformation, modelling, and performance tuning.

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric components, including:

  • Data Factory (pipelines, dataflows Gen2)

  • Lakehouse and/or Data Warehouse

  • Power BI datasets, reports, and apps

  • Strong Power BI skills, including DAX, semantic modelling, and performance optimization.

  • Solid understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modelling concepts.

  • Experience implementing BI security models (e.g. RLS).

  • Familiarity with Git-based source control and CI/CD practices for BI and analytics assets.

  • Experience working with enterprise source systems (e.g. ERP, CRM, finance systems).

Analytical and Professional Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.

  • Clear communication skills, able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

  • Strong attention to detail, documentation, and data quality.

  • Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional, collaborative environment.

Education/ Qualifications

Our Workflow Squad:

The Workflow Squad builds product and platform capabilities that coordinate business processes across Cloudbeds products and services. The team works across existing systems to create flexible, reliable experiences that support a wide range of customer needs.   • Contribute as a senior individual contributor through architecture decisions, code reviews, pair programming, documentation, mentoring, and continuous improvement of engineering practices

What Sets You Up for Success:

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including maintainable architecture, automated testing, debugging, performance, security, and operational reliability
  • Solid understanding of API design, relational data modeling, PostgreSQL, distributed systems, and asynchronous or event-driven architecture
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka or similar messaging and streaming systems, REST, gRPC, and service integrations
  • Experience owning cloud-native delivery and operations, including Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, CI/CD, observability, and production incident response
  • A track record of owning complex work end-to-end, navigating ambiguity, and making pragmatic technical trade-offs
  • Comfort working in a polyglot codebase and making focused contributions outside your primary backend stack when the product requires it

Incumbent is responsible for interpreting procedures and policies to ensure accurate claims resolution. Incumbent may also be responsible for processing simple and routine claims.

jobs.excerpt: The RoleWe're looking for an Ad Operations Manager to own trafficking, tagging, and campaign QA across every paid channel our B2B team runs: Programmatic, Direct I/O, Paid Social, and Paid Search.
jobs.description:
The Role

We're looking for an Ad Operations Manager to own trafficking, tagging, and campaign QA across every paid channel our B2B team runs: Programmatic, Direct I/O, Paid Social, and Paid Search. The role is primarily dedicated to one of Wpromote's largest B2B accounts, a leading financial software company with multiple product lines and business units, with additional support across our other B2B clients as needed. Programmatic and direct buys will generate most of the day-to-day trafficking volume, but you'll be the single point of accountability for tracking and campaign setup across all channels, so the team has one consistent standard rather than channel-by-channel workarounds. You'll work alongside our channel teams, Client Service, and Analytics as the person who makes sure every campaign is set up correctly, tracked accurately, and launched on time.

This is a hands-on technical role. You'll traffic creatives, build and QA tags, troubleshoot tracking issues, and keep the measurement plumbing clean so the media and analytics teams can trust the data. B2B campaigns often involve long conversion paths, multiple tracking systems, and lead data that has to flow cleanly from ad click to CRM, so you'll need to be comfortable working across ad servers, tag managers, platform pixels, and marketing automation tools.

At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.
We offer:
-Remote-first culture
-Unlimited PTO
-Extended Holiday break (Winter)
-Flexible schedules
-Work from anywhere options*
-100% paid parental leave
-401(k) matching
-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance
-Sponsored life insurance
-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance
-Annual Class Pass credits and more!
The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $70,000 - $80,000, based on consideration of a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits (listed above).
*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions
**While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles, Chicago, and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!
***This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship
Important Notice: Beware of Job Scams
Wpromote recruiting communications will only be sent through our official channels via email addresses. If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on Wpromote.com/careers, it may be a fraudulent posting. We do not require payment or fees during the hiring process nor do we request sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or payment details. Please safeguard yourself against possible scams and contact us if you encounter any suspicious activity.

You Will Be

  • Trafficking all programmatic and direct I/O creatives in Campaign Manager 360, including standard, HTML5, and third-party served creatives, and ensuring every setting is right before launch
  • Building, implementing, and QAing impression trackers, click trackers, and daisy-chained tags across CM360, DSPs, and publisher partners, including passing macros and custom variables through the chain so downstream systems get the data they need
  • Implementing and QAing site-side tracking across Google Tag Manager, GA4, and platform pixels (LinkedIn Insight Tag, Meta, and others), using data layer variables for triggers and troubleshooting when tracking breaks
  • Owning conversion tracking hygiene across channels, including UTM governance, conversion event setup, and coordinating offline conversion imports and CRM or marketing automation integrations with client teams
  • Fielding tagging and tracking requests from Media and Analytics teams, and making sure data lands where it needs to for reporting
  • Serving as the main point of contact for technical issues related to ad serving, verification vendors, and third-party tracking

This position will be a player/coach role, where you will own some implementations yourself, and also build and manage a team.

You are equally comfortable leading strategic calls with revenue cycle executives as you are setting up client instances, handling file transfers, configuring software rules, and validating technical data pipelines.
